"},{"number":878,"text":"[ODD §11.5D](ODD.md#115d-evidence-and-bounded-decisions) and
"},{"number":879,"text":"[§11.7A](ODD.md#117a-conforming-agentic-development),
"},{"number":880,"text":"[UX §7](UX.md#7-carrier-binding) and
"},{"number":881,"text":"[TICKETS §5](TICKETS.md#5-from-carrier-to-execution) and
"},{"number":882,"text":"[§7](TICKETS.md#7-authority-judgment-closure-and-state) (P6).
"},{"number":883,"text":"
"},{"number":884,"text":"The operation that joins AC-010, AC-011 and RF-002, RF-003, RF-004,
"},{"number":885,"text":"RF-014 and RF-017 into one procedure is stated here (P0); each of
"},{"number":886,"text":"those laws is applied here from its owning section in
"},{"number":887,"text":"[AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §4](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#ac-010-material-closure) and
"},{"number":888,"text":"[REFERENCE_FRAME §3](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#3-laws). The method does not require proving
"},{"number":889,"text":"that no undiscovered material relation exists
"},{"number":890,"text":"([RF-003](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-003-material-sufficiency)).
"},{"number":891,"text":"The size measurement of step 3 applies under its stated condition.
"},{"number":892,"text":"Purpose and material relation of that measurement and Acquisition:
"},{"number":893,"text":"finite context makes fit necessary (P0), so a fit against a declared
"},{"number":894,"text":"capacity is measured rather than asserted, while fit and attention stay
"},{"number":895,"text":"separate claims (P6); and an actor without a derived surface for its task
"},{"number":896,"text":"still reaches the sections that decide it, from the exact basis, without
"},{"number":897,"text":"reading the corpus or substituting a stale or mutable copy (P3, P6). The
"},{"number":898,"text":"material relation is whether a context larger than the declared capacity
"},{"number":899,"text":"is read as if it fit, a fit is taken as adequate attention, or a decision
"},{"number":900,"text":"rests on material other than its deciding owners at the selected basis.
"},{"number":901,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":937,"heading":"ACTIVATION/2. Context construction under an envelope/Staleness of derived surfaces","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F2.%20Context%20construction%20under%20an%20envelope%2FStaleness%20of%20derived%20surfaces","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"e03ba44ae809603f12c8ddfc59dc254cdd6b4cf45ac98828cea837d82cb2a705","start_line":902,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":902,"text":"### Staleness of derived surfaces
"},{"number":903,"text":"
"},{"number":904,"text":"This subsection owns when a derived surface (Acquisition above) is current
"},{"number":905,"text":"and when it is stale, for any method and any carrier (P3, P5, P6):
"},{"number":906,"text":"
"},{"number":907,"text":"- A derived surface names the exact identity, such as the path and
"},{"number":908,"text":"  digest, of each source it was derived from and of each source whose
"},{"number":909,"text":"  change can change its content.
"},{"number":910,"text":"- It is current for a selected basis only while every source identity it
"},{"number":911,"text":"  names equals the identity of that source in the selected basis. A change
"},{"number":912,"text":"  to any of them makes it stale.
"},{"number":913,"text":"- A stale derived surface is not used as current for any question. It
"},{"number":914,"text":"  becomes current again only by regeneration from the sources at the
"},{"number":915,"text":"  selected basis, or by an explicit re-acceptance that records the new
"},{"number":916,"text":"  source identities and the finding that its content still matches them;
"},{"number":917,"text":"  until then the actor acquires the deciding owner sections directly
"},{"number":918,"text":"  (Acquisition above).
"},{"number":919,"text":"- Matching source identities establish only that the surface was derived
"},{"number":920,"text":"  from those sources. They establish neither its fidelity to them nor its
"},{"number":921,"text":"  sufficiency for a question; a surface found insufficient for a named
"},{"number":922,"text":"  question is handled as Acquisition above states.
"},{"number":923,"text":"- The owning sections at the selected basis remain the deciding source.
"},{"number":924,"text":"  Whether a current surface is insufficient for a question, or decides
"},{"number":925,"text":"  beyond its own sources, is judged against them (Standalone scope above);
"},{"number":926,"text":"  a derived surface never decides that about itself.
"},{"number":927,"text":"
"},{"number":928,"text":"A packaging or installation carrier refines this rule with its own
"},{"number":929,"text":"identities and re-acceptance procedure, and names this subsection as its
"},{"number":930,"text":"owner; [PRODUCT_DEFINITION §11](PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md#11-one-constitutional-surface-and-version-boundary)
"},{"number":931,"text":"does so for the method's released carriers. Purpose and material relation: an actor that relies on a
"},{"number":932,"text":"derived surface after one of its sources has changed decides from material
"},{"number":933,"text":"that no longer matches its owners, and a matching digest read as fidelity
"},{"number":934,"text":"would let a faithful-looking but wrong surface decide; the material
"},{"number":935,"text":"relation is whether a decision rests on a surface whose sources are not
"},{"number":936,"text":"those of the selected basis. This rule applies to derived surfaces under every selected carrier.
"},{"number":937,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":967,"heading":"ACTIVATION/3. Step results and disposition","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F3.%20Step%20results%20and%20disposition","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"32edac7552c461d5b248d9a395a60e945bf265113beb816bd0005f6ac4adb26d","start_line":938,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":938,"text":"## 3. Step results and disposition
"},{"number":939,"text":"
"},{"number":940,"text":"A step returns its results in the core algebra of
"},{"number":941,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results): each evaluation it
"},{"number":942,"text":"performed returns one core value with its predicate and domain outcome,
"},{"number":943,"text":"and an evaluation it did not perform has no result. The outcomes of
"},{"number":944,"text":"admitting and activating a step, and the step's own outcomes, answer other
"},{"number":945,"text":"questions than its evaluations do. This section owns them as five
"},{"number":946,"text":"refinements of the core. Each names the question it answers and the
"},{"number":947,"text":"predicate its mapping is for, and maps each of its values to exactly one
"},{"number":948,"text":"core value; the predicate travels with the value, so no refinement's
"},{"number":949,"text":"`satisfied` counts toward another predicate
"},{"number":950,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results)).
"},{"number":951,"text":"Purpose and material relation: admission, work, decisions and effects
"},{"number":952,"text":"stand in the one core (P5, P6), so a consumer that combines them cannot
"},{"number":953,"text":"read a refused activation as a step's stop, availability as fitness or
"},{"number":954,"text":"acceptance, a carried ambiguity as resolved, or an unknown effect as none.
"},{"number":955,"text":"
"},{"number":956,"text":"| Refinement | Question | Predicate of the mapping |
"},{"number":957,"text":"|---|---|---|
"},{"number":958,"text":"| admission and activation | may the step begin | the step is lawfully admitted and activated on the exact subject and basis |
"},{"number":959,"text":"| construction availability | did the step yield its output | a candidate is available |
"},{"number":960,"text":"| disposition | what the decision owner does with an assessed candidate | the candidate is accepted at its declared boundary |
"},{"number":961,"text":"| ambiguity outcome | what happened to a declared ambiguity | the declared ambiguity is resolved on the exact basis |
"},{"number":962,"text":"| effects | did an intended external effect occur | the intended effect occurred |
"},{"number":963,"text":"
"},{"number":964,"text":"A profile that refines these values for its own units maps each of its
"},{"number":965,"text":"values to exactly one core value under FOUNDATIONS §4 Results and adds no
"},{"number":966,"text":"core value.
"},{"number":967,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1001,"heading":"ACTIVATION/3. Step results and disposition/Admission and activation","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F3.%20Step%20results%20and%20disposition%2FAdmission%20and%20activation","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"6355ed6c58473d04c13251a2ea6936388f89b4f943c3a15558d995409c720263","start_line":968,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":968,"text":"### Admission and activation
"},{"number":969,"text":"
"},{"number":970,"text":"A step exists only after its contract is admitted (§1, Admission) and its
"},{"number":971,"text":"frame is activated on the exact subject and basis (§2). The outcomes of
"},{"number":972,"text":"admission and of context construction are owned here; each maps for the
"},{"number":973,"text":"predicate "the step is lawfully admitted and activated on the exact
"},{"number":974,"text":"subject and basis", and its cause selects its value (P5, P6; RF-005 for
"},{"number":975,"text":"the basis causes). The outcomes of frame activation are the `activate`
"},{"number":976,"text":"refinement of [REFERENCE_FRAME §5](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#5-method-functions),
"},{"number":977,"text":"which owns their causes, their predicate and their core values. Because
"},{"number":978,"text":"this predicate requires activation, a refused activation decides it with
"},{"number":979,"text":"the value REFERENCE_FRAME §5 gives; the table names those outcomes and
"},{"number":980,"text":"maps none of them again:
"},{"number":981,"text":"
"},{"number":982,"text":"| Outcome | Cause | Core value |
"},{"number":983,"text":"|---|---|---|
"},{"number":984,"text":"| `activated` | the contract is admitted with its admission evidence (§1), Z, R, the required-edge semantics, the basis and the scope are exact and the material closure is finite and unique (§2, step 1), its projection returns a selected context (§2, step 2), and activation returns `activated_frame` | satisfied |
"},{"number":985,"text":"| `admission_refused(authority)` | the work authority the step needs is not admitted: no admission mechanism or explicit human override admits the exact contract, or no durable result and evidence surface is authorised and available; the outcome names the missing authority or surface and its owner | out_of_frame |
"},{"number":986,"text":"| `admission_refused(basis)` | the contract's cited outcome, prerequisite or experiment basis, or the exact subject and basis it names, cannot support it; the outcome names that basis | invalid_basis |
"},{"number":987,"text":"| `closure_unresolved` | the seed set Z, the relation family R, the required-edge semantics, the basis or the scope is not exact, or the material closure is not finite and unique on the exact basis (§2, step 1; AC-010), or the projection of the closure returns a gap or refusal (§2, step 2; AC-011); the outcome names the condition that fails and the basis coordinates that leave it open | invalid_basis |
"},{"number":988,"text":"| `out_of_frame` | no available frame and actor pairing declares a material relation or capability the evaluation needs (§2, Activation), or no fit option of §2 step 3 fits the selected context to an actor's envelope | out_of_frame |
"},{"number":989,"text":"| `activation_refusal` with its cause | a cause REFERENCE_FRAME §5 states | the core value REFERENCE_FRAME §5 maps that cause to |
"},{"number":990,"text":"
"},{"number":991,"text":"These outcomes are not values of construction availability and are not
"},{"number":992,"text":"results of a step. A refused admission or activation creates no step, no
"},{"number":993,"text":"activation of the step's frame and no work result, the closed output of a
"},{"number":994,"text":"constructing actor to its consumer; the outcome returns to the assigning
"},{"number":995,"text":"authority or the declared result carrier, and no consumer records it as a
"},{"number":996,"text":"step's stop state. [EXECUTIVE_BASELINE §5](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#work-result)
"},{"number":997,"text":"applies this rule to the Worker.
"},{"number":998,"text":"Purpose and material relation: a mismatch known before the step begins is
"},{"number":999,"text":"reported with its cause in the one core, so it is neither mistaken for a
"},{"number":1000,"text":"step that stopped nor for one that ran.
"},{"number":1001,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1048,"heading":"ACTIVATION/3. Step results and disposition/Construction availability","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F3.%20Step%20results%20and%20disposition%2FConstruction%20availability","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"f1716d7080e823fa4d3b92070a88c2a2e61dfc9bc96a597b36707c3d5d759e48","start_line":1002,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1002,"text":"### Construction availability
"},{"number":1003,"text":"
"},{"number":1004,"text":"A step's output is a candidate until evaluated (FOUNDATIONS §3, P0): the
"},{"number":1005,"text":"constructed subject of a constructing step, or the closed results of an
"},{"number":1006,"text":"assessing step. Construction availability records whether that output
"},{"number":1007,"text":"exists (P5, P6):
"},{"number":1008,"text":"
"},{"number":1009,"text":"| Value | Core value | Ground |
"},{"number":1010,"text":"|---|---|---|
"},{"number":1011,"text":"| `candidate_ready` | satisfied | an exact candidate and its transition evidence are available |
"},{"number":1012,"text":"| `refused` | falsified | lawful activation occurred, and a governing prohibition or an owner-valid construction refusal defeats the requested construction; the prohibition or refusal is the counterexample |
"},{"number":1013,"text":"| `incomplete` | falsified | the lawfully activated step stopped without its output, because an evaluation the output needs was not performed or could not be decided on the admissible evidence, or bounded execution ended first; the stop basis is the counterexample, and it and the residuals name which |
"},{"number":1014,"text":"| `re_entry_requested(authority)` | out_of_frame | a material decision the step needs lies outside its grant; the value names the owner of that decision |
"},{"number":1015,"text":"| `re_entry_requested(basis)` | invalid_basis | the activated basis can no longer support the work |
"},{"number":1016,"text":"
"},{"number":1017,"text":"The mapping is total and exclusive after lawful activation: the cause of
"},{"number":1018,"text":"the stop selects the value, and payload wording, stop timing or actor
"},{"number":1019,"text":"preference cannot select another. A mismatch known during admission or
"},{"number":1020,"text":"activation is no value of this refinement, because no step exists; it
"},{"number":1021,"text":"takes its outcome under Admission and activation above.
"},{"number":1022,"text":"
"},{"number":1023,"text":"`satisfied` here establishes availability only and never counts toward the
"},{"number":1024,"text":"candidate's fitness or acceptance (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results).
"},{"number":1025,"text":"
"},{"number":1026,"text":"`incomplete` maps to `falsified` only for "a candidate is available", never
"},{"number":1027,"text":"to `indeterminate`. The step's evaluations keep their own results: each
"},{"number":1028,"text":"evaluation it performed returns its core value, `indeterminate` where the
"},{"number":1029,"text":"admissible evidence could not decide; each evaluation it planned and did
"},{"number":1030,"text":"not perform has no result, and its work state (§5) carries it as a
"},{"number":1031,"text":"residual with the capability or the execution left unfinished
"},{"number":1032,"text":"(FOUNDATIONS §4 Results, the third case of the boundary). An evaluation
"},{"number":1033,"text":"not performed thus stays distinct from one whose evidence cannot decide
"},{"number":1034,"text":"(P5, P6).
"},{"number":1035,"text":"
"},{"number":1036,"text":"An assessing step that ends `incomplete` leaves each criterion it did not
"},{"number":1037,"text":"evaluate not performed: no result, never `falsified`. The `falsified` of its
"},{"number":1038,"text":"availability concerns its own output, never the subject under assessment
"},{"number":1039,"text":"(P6).
"},{"number":1040,"text":"
"},{"number":1041,"text":"The cause of a re-entry request is part of its value, because a re-entry
"},{"number":1042,"text":"request without its cause would map to `out_of_frame` or to
"},{"number":1043,"text":"`invalid_basis` according to that cause, and a refined value maps to
"},{"number":1044,"text":"exactly one core value (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results, Refinements). A stop
"},{"number":1045,"text":"with both causes records both and takes `re_entry_requested(basis)`,
"},{"number":1046,"text":"because a decision cannot be taken on a basis that cannot support it (P5,
"},{"number":1047,"text":"P3).
"},{"number":1048,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1086,"heading":"ACTIVATION/3. Step results and disposition/Disposition","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F3.%20Step%20results%20and%20disposition%2FDisposition","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"a5d3394673bb27695f4d42cbae693b65edad57928cf235a2cbc6740cfe198b63","start_line":1049,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1049,"text":"### Disposition
"},{"number":1050,"text":"
"},{"number":1051,"text":"The decision owner disposes an assessed candidate with one of four
"},{"number":1052,"text":"semantic dispositions (§1, Roles and delegation; P6, P5). An assessor may recommend one; the
"},{"number":1053,"text":"recommendation is evidence for the decision owner, never a disposition
"},{"number":1054,"text":"([EVALUATION §4](EVALUATION.md#4-review-results)). The disposition is the
"},{"number":1055,"text":"acceptance result: it consumes the candidate's availability and assessment
"},{"number":1056,"text":"results and stays separate from both (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results). Each maps
"},{"number":1057,"text":"to the core for the predicate "the candidate is accepted at its declared
"},{"number":1058,"text":"boundary":
"},{"number":1059,"text":"
"},{"number":1060,"text":"| Disposition | Condition | Core value |
"},{"number":1061,"text":"|---|---|---|
"},{"number":1062,"text":"| `accept` | the candidate closes its declared cone and preserves every affected governing relation | satisfied |
"},{"number":1063,"text":"| `local_repair` | implementation or proof is locally defective while the governing relation remains coherent | falsified |
"},{"number":1064,"text":"| `re_enter` | the governing outcome, a requirement, an identity, a lifecycle, an authority, a public contract or the accepted design must change | invalid_basis |
"},{"number":1065,"text":"| `reject` | the candidate violates a governing relation or leaves an undisposed competing truth path | falsified |
"},{"number":1066,"text":"
"},{"number":1067,"text":"For `local_repair` the local defect, and for `reject` the violated relation
"},{"number":1068,"text":"or the competing truth path, is the counterexample to accepting this
"},{"number":1069,"text":"candidate; a repaired candidate is a new candidate with its own results.
"},{"number":1070,"text":"For `re_enter` the governing basis the candidate was built and assessed on
"},{"number":1071,"text":"must change, so that basis cannot support acceptance; the change re-enters
"},{"number":1072,"text":"at its owning relation (§4). The core values place
"},{"number":1073,"text":"acceptance in the one core, as FOUNDATIONS §4 Results requires, so that a
"},{"number":1074,"text":"consumer combining results cannot take availability or assessment as
"},{"number":1075,"text":"acceptance (P6).
"},{"number":1076,"text":"
"},{"number":1077,"text":"Global correctness means conserving every global relation affected by the
"},{"number":1078,"text":"bounded action; it does not require proving the whole product inside every
"},{"number":1079,"text":"local action (P4b). Repeated rejection against one unchanged boundary
"},{"number":1080,"text":"requires reassessment of the frame altitude, the causal cone, the common
"},{"number":1081,"text":"components, the design-versus-code placement and the authority
"},{"number":1082,"text":"sufficiency. The method sets no rejection-count threshold, mandatory
"},{"number":1083,"text":"review-round count or review state machine; it prohibits repeating an
"},{"number":1084,"text":"unchanged failed construction relation as if iteration alone could close
"},{"number":1085,"text":"it (P2).
"},{"number":1086,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1113,"heading":"ACTIVATION/3. Step results and disposition/Ambiguity outcome","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F3.%20Step%20results%20and%20disposition%2FAmbiguity%20outcome","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"c70b35a5e59dee1def59b0f50393cc0f400c36fec01c167b09b6fe88f8e0354d","start_line":1087,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1087,"text":"### Ambiguity outcome
"},{"number":1088,"text":"
"},{"number":1089,"text":"A declared ambiguity is resolved, carried, escalated or blocked, and the
"},{"number":1090,"text":"outcome is recorded either way (§4, which also names the hard stops;
"},{"number":1091,"text":"[SPEC_METHOD §5](SPEC_METHOD.md#5-ambiguity-governance-and-lifecycle)
"},{"number":1092,"text":"applies this to the method's chain of authority surfaces). Each outcome
"},{"number":1093,"text":"maps to the core for the predicate "the declared ambiguity is resolved on
"},{"number":1094,"text":"the exact basis" (P5, P6):
"},{"number":1095,"text":"
"},{"number":1096,"text":"| Outcome | Core value | Ground |
"},{"number":1097,"text":"|---|---|---|
"},{"number":1098,"text":"| `resolved` | satisfied | a decision was taken under the policy that permits lawful probabilistic processing, or by human adjudication, and recorded |
"},{"number":1099,"text":"| `carried` | falsified | policy permits work to continue with the ambiguity open; the open ambiguity is the counterexample, and it stays a recorded residual that names the evidence or decision that would resolve it |
"},{"number":1100,"text":"| `escalated` | out_of_frame | policy or risk appetite reserves the decision to human adjudication, an authority the step does not hold; the value names that authority |
"},{"number":1101,"text":"| `blocked` | falsified | the ambiguity stays unresolved, and policy or a hard stop (§4) halts work at it; the open ambiguity is the counterexample, and the value names the halting condition and what would lift it |
"},{"number":1102,"text":"
"},{"number":1103,"text":"An open ambiguity is a known state of the exact basis, so `carried` and
"},{"number":1104,"text":"`blocked` decide the predicate false; neither is `indeterminate`, whose
"},{"number":1105,"text":"evidence cannot decide the predicate. Each keeps its domain outcome with
"},{"number":1106,"text":"the value: `carried` with what would resolve the ambiguity, `blocked` with
"},{"number":1107,"text":"the halting condition and what would lift it (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results,
"},{"number":1108,"text":"Recording). No outcome other than `resolved` maps to `satisfied`, so a
"},{"number":1109,"text":"dependent claim cannot rest on a carried, escalated or blocked ambiguity
"},{"number":1110,"text":"as if it were resolved. The mapping places ambiguity outcomes
"},{"number":1111,"text":"in the one core, which FOUNDATIONS §4 Results requires of every outcome
"},{"number":1112,"text":"(P5, P6).
"},{"number":1113,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1163,"heading":"ACTIVATION/3. Step results and disposition/Effects","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F3.%20Step%20results%20and%20disposition%2FEffects","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"5256dd7b7399fdeb0176decb43623660821eb5ff038867b2193f8b7922e73e29","start_line":1114,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1114,"text":"### Effects
"},{"number":1115,"text":"
"},{"number":1116,"text":"An effectful step's intended external effect has one of three values,
"},{"number":1117,"text":"mapped for the predicate "the intended effect occurred", that is, the
"},{"number":1118,"text":"declared outcome of the effect is attained. The value turns on what the
"},{"number":1119,"text":"admitted evidence establishes about that outcome (P5 with the open-world
"},{"number":1120,"text":"premise, P6):
"},{"number":1121,"text":"
"},{"number":1122,"text":"| Value | Core value | Ground |
"},{"number":1123,"text":"|---|---|---|
"},{"number":1124,"text":"| `completed` | satisfied | evidence about the subject establishes that the intended effect occurred in full and that the effect has ended |
"},{"number":1125,"text":"| `not_effected` | falsified | evidence about the subject establishes that the declared outcome is not attained and that no later completion of the effect can attain it, for example where no effect began, the effect ended short, an interval that the declared outcome bounds has closed with part of it not done, or the part already done has itself made the declared outcome unattainable, as when it destroyed what the outcome needed; any part that did occur is named with the value |
"},{"number":1126,"text":"| `completion_unknown` | indeterminate | neither of the other values is established: the evidence cannot decide whether the intended effect has occurred or will occur, as for a request whose response was lost with no counterexample observed; or the evidence shows the intended effect in full while the effect may still be acting, and the outcome stays undecided until what the effect leaves on the subject is settled; its residual names the observation that would decide |
"},{"number":1127,"text":"
"},{"number":1128,"text":"`not_effected` requires evidence about the subject. A lost response, an
"},{"number":1129,"text":"absent record, or an actor's context that holds no trace of the effect is
"},{"number":1130,"text":"not that evidence, and the value stays `completion_unknown`.
"},{"number":1131,"text":"`completion_unknown` never maps to `completed` or to `not_effected`.
"},{"number":1132,"text":"
"},{"number":1133,"text":"Whether the effect has ended is a second question beside the predicate
"},{"number":1134,"text":"above, and it enters the value only as a conjunct of `completed`. An
"},{"number":1135,"text":"effect has ended where evidence about the subject establishes
"},{"number":1136,"text":"that it no longer acts on the subject or that it never began. Where an
"},{"number":1137,"text":"effect began and the evidence does not establish its end, the end is not
"},{"number":1138,"text":"established, and that is recorded beside the value as a residual naming
"},{"number":1139,"text":"the observation that would establish it. The end never decides a
"},{"number":1140,"text":"`not_effected` value and is never folded into one: when an interval that
"},{"number":1141,"text":"the declared outcome bounds has closed with part not done, the value is
"},{"number":1142,"text":"`not_effected` while the effect may still be acting. The residual does
"},{"number":1143,"text":"not weaken the counterexample, and the counterexample does not resolve
"},{"number":1144,"text":"the residual. `completed` alone requires the end established, so a
"},{"number":1145,"text":"counterexample stands without proof that the effect has ended, while
"},{"number":1146,"text":"success is never claimed for an effect that may still be acting
"},{"number":1147,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results), Standing).
"},{"number":1148,"text":"
"},{"number":1149,"text":"An effect of uncertain completion is one whose value is
"},{"number":1150,"text":"`completion_unknown`, or whose value is `not_effected` with its end not
"},{"number":1151,"text":"established. §5 reconciles it, sufficiently for the next dependent
"},{"number":1152,"text":"action, before any repetition or dependent action. A `not_effected`
"},{"number":1153,"text":"value licenses neither treating the effect as absent nor repeating it
"},{"number":1154,"text":"while its end is not established.
"},{"number":1155,"text":"
"},{"number":1156,"text":"The refinement's material relation is whether an action whose
"},{"number":1157,"text":"external effect may have occurred is repeated or relied on; §4 names a
"},{"number":1158,"text":"lost post-effect response as a case that no added core value solves, and
"},{"number":1159,"text":"this refinement records it in the existing core. Keeping the end of the
"},{"number":1160,"text":"effect beside the value keeps two facts that one value would merge: a
"},{"number":1161,"text":"counterexample already established for the declared outcome, and an
"},{"number":1162,"text":"effect that may still be acting.
"},{"number":1163,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1209,"heading":"ACTIVATION/4. Totality and refinement","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F4.%20Totality%20and%20refinement","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"c3f19c8c4a08708eac7455c16e2d2cee6785f1ea2c689fab9aae6f6407ab87bb","start_line":1164,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1164,"text":"## 4. Totality and refinement
"},{"number":1165,"text":"
"},{"number":1166,"text":"Next moves after any non-satisfied result are named in advance: continue
"},{"number":1167,"text":"within the current contract when supported; refine; recover; yield; re-enter
"},{"number":1168,"text":"the owning relation; terminate. Each admitted condition class has a declared
"},{"number":1169,"text":"next move, including an explicit unknown class. Total handling does not
"},{"number":1170,"text":"claim that every external condition is recognised, that an invoked provider
"},{"number":1171,"text":"terminates, or that every request can be completed. A hanging external call,
"},{"number":1172,"text":"an unsatisfiable demand and a lost post-effect response are three different
"},{"number":1173,"text":"cases and none is solved by adding a value to the algebra.
"},{"number":1174,"text":"
"},{"number":1175,"text":"Claiming the common deterministic kind adds the total-domain and termination
"},{"number":1176,"text":"contract of [AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §5](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#5-traversals-and-functor-kinds).
"},{"number":1177,"text":"This section's total handling does not establish that qualification. Fuel
"},{"number":1178,"text":"exhaustion retains the evaluated predicate; candidate absence, an available
"},{"number":1179,"text":"indeterminate assessment report and an unperformed assessment take the
"},{"number":1180,"text":"different results of [§3](#construction-availability), as the
"},{"number":1181,"text":"[finite cases](examples/DETERMINISTIC_CONTRACTS.md#exhaustion) demonstrate.
"},{"number":1182,"text":"
"},{"number":1183,"text":"Which outcome of [§3 Ambiguity outcome](#ambiguity-outcome) a declared
"},{"number":1184,"text":"ambiguity takes is decided by the applicable ambiguity policy and its risk
"},{"number":1185,"text":"appetite, an added choice; for this method the owner of the default
"},{"number":1186,"text":"policy is [SPEC_METHOD §5](SPEC_METHOD.md#5-ambiguity-governance-and-lifecycle),
"},{"number":1187,"text":"and this section states none. The outcome is recorded either way.
"},{"number":1188,"text":"
"},{"number":1189,"text":"Hard stops. Some conditions are not optional ambiguity decisions and
"},{"number":1190,"text":"remain hard stops regardless of risk appetite. Typical hard-stop classes
"},{"number":1191,"text":"include: a violated invariant or guarantee; an absent required authority
"},{"number":1192,"text":"surface; a missing declared capability for an executional or operational
"},{"number":1193,"text":"stage; an undeclared irreversible side effect; and an explicit policy gate
"},{"number":1194,"text":"requiring human approval. A hard stop halts the work at its condition whatever the policy:
"},{"number":1195,"text":"for a declared ambiguity, with the §3 Ambiguity outcome `blocked`;
"},{"number":1196,"text":"otherwise, as a stop of [§1 Transitions](#transitions), Stops. This
"},{"number":1197,"text":"section owns the hard stops;
"},{"number":1198,"text":"[SPEC_METHOD §5](SPEC_METHOD.md#5-ambiguity-governance-and-lifecycle)
"},{"number":1199,"text":"applies them to the method's chain of authority surfaces (P6, P5).
"},{"number":1200,"text":"
"},{"number":1201,"text":"Reconfiguration. An out_of_frame, invalid_basis, repeated indeterminate or
"},{"number":1202,"text":"incompatible result causes one of: supply the missing admissible evidence;
"},{"number":1203,"text":"select another actor inside the frame's capability envelope; activate
"},{"number":1204,"text":"another existing frame; refine or extend a frame declaration; revise the
"},{"number":1205,"text":"frame set (REFERENCE_FRAME §10); change the evaluation; or re-enter the
"},{"number":1206,"text":"governing product or method relation. The next move follows the cause; a
"},{"number":1207,"text":"difficult evaluation alone does not prove that another frame is required
"},{"number":1208,"text":"(P5, P2).
"},{"number":1209,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1285,"heading":"ACTIVATION/4. Totality and refinement/Refinement","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F4.%20Totality%20and%20refinement%2FRefinement","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"5b33a40f42b5f4449224ffe67bd387dc329f62207e3bf2bea3dc5ceda0810e1d","start_line":1210,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1210,"text":"### Refinement
"},{"number":1211,"text":"
"},{"number":1212,"text":"An outer transformation T: A → X with success predicates P₀ … Pₙ
"},{"number":1213,"text":"is faithfully refined by steps Tᵢ when each admitted input satisfying Pᵢ
"},{"number":1214,"text":"yields an output satisfying Pᵢ₊₁, retains every applicable invariant, exposes
"},{"number":1215,"text":"other outcomes without coercion, and each output satisfies the next step's
"},{"number":1216,"text":"declared domain and preconditions, as typed composition requires (P4a;
"},{"number":1217,"text":"[AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS §5 AC-016](AXIOMATIC_CALCULUS.md#ac-016-typed-composition)).
"},{"number":1218,"text":"The step and end-to-end preservation obligations this refinement discharges, and what a completion-only relation leaves unclaimed, are [FOUNDATIONS §4 Preservation through construction](FOUNDATIONS.md#preservation-through-construction); this section applies them to refinement. Then a successful composite of exact steps carries P₀ to Pₙ by induction;
"},{"number":1219,"text":"a composite that contains an approximate step carries only what its
"},{"number":1220,"text":"end-to-end bound states (Exact and approximate steps below). A refinement
"},{"number":1221,"text":"carries an earlier output to a later step other than the next only through
"},{"number":1222,"text":"a declared adapter, itself a step composed under AC-016, or a declared
"},{"number":1223,"text":"specialised contract, in either case one whose declared domain names what
"},{"number":1224,"text":"is carried; a specialised contract is declared under its owner's exact
"},{"number":1225,"text":"authority, context, basis, scope, preservation, loss, refusal and
"},{"number":1226,"text":"invalidation law (P4a, P4b).
"},{"number":1227,"text":"Coverage of the outer obligations, correctness of the local
"},{"number":1228,"text":"implications and legitimate authority are premises, not conclusions; "each
"},{"number":1229,"text":"step passed" is weaker than "the outer contract was conserved". Required
"},{"number":1230,"text":"coupled relations must fit together in some step; unrelated obligations stay
"},{"number":1231,"text":"outside the selected context. Every seam crossing the affected set includes
"},{"number":1232,"text":"its far side or states why it cannot participate
"},{"number":1233,"text":"([UP-017](DESIGN_MODULE.md#bounded-frame-conservation-up-017)).
"},{"number":1234,"text":"Admission of a material transition is one semantic commit of the complete
"},{"number":1235,"text":"transition within its enclosing relation, or none (the law below). The ODD [graph-function binding](ODD.md#graph-functions) refines one
"},{"number":1236,"text":"outer vector into an inner workflow; this law also applies to other
"},{"number":1237,"text":"realisations. [PROFILES §2](PROFILES.md#2-graph-execution) locates the ODD binding.
"},{"number":1238,"text":"
"},{"number":1239,"text":"Preservation and licensing. A refinement step decomposes a transformation
"},{"number":1240,"text":"into steps, as above. A rewrite step replaces a representation, a step or
"},{"number":1241,"text":"a composite by another that is claimed to keep its meaning, for example
"},{"number":1242,"text":"by partitioning, regrouping, reordering, merging or substituting parts.
"},{"number":1243,"text":"Each refinement layer, the steps that refine one transformation, states
"},{"number":1244,"text":"what it preserves of the layer above, the transformation it refines, and
"},{"number":1245,"text":"discharges that obligation (P4a, P6). A refinement or rewrite step is
"},{"number":1246,"text":"admissible only under the laws declared for its subject. Its licensing law is the declared
"},{"number":1247,"text":"law that permits it, such as an associativity, commutativity or
"},{"number":1248,"text":"equivalence law that the subject's owner declares for the subject. Where
"},{"number":1249,"text":"no law is declared for the subject, only universally valid steps are
"},{"number":1250,"text":"admissible: steps that hold whatever laws the subject has. A step that
"},{"number":1251,"text":"is neither licensed nor universally valid, such as a partition or
"},{"number":1252,"text":"regrouping that no declared law permits, is inadmissible, and so is a
"},{"number":1253,"text":"refinement or rewrite that relies on it (P4a, P1).
"},{"number":1254,"text":"
"},{"number":1255,"text":"Exact and approximate steps. An exact step preserves meaning: under the
"},{"number":1256,"text":"subject's declared interpretation, its output means what the material it
"},{"number":1257,"text":"replaces means, and an exact refinement step carries Pᵢ to Pᵢ₊₁ without
"},{"number":1258,"text":"approximation (P1). Faithful refinement, defined above, requires exact
"},{"number":1259,"text":"steps. An approximate step does not preserve meaning exactly. It
"},{"number":1260,"text":"states its adequacy relation, which says how close its output must be to
"},{"number":1261,"text":"the exact result to be close enough for the outer contract, and the
"},{"number":1262,"text":"composite that contains it states an end-to-end bound, which limits how
"},{"number":1263,"text":"far the whole composite may depart from the outer obligation and is
"},{"number":1264,"text":"argued for that composite. Such a composite is not faithful; it is
"},{"number":1265,"text":"adequate within its end-to-end bound and establishes nothing beyond that
"},{"number":1266,"text":"bound. A fixed tolerance at each step does not compose into an
"},{"number":1267,"text":"end-to-end bound, because deviations that each stay within the tolerance
"},{"number":1268,"text":"can accumulate across steps, so the induction above applies to exact
"},{"number":1269,"text":"steps only. A step that is neither exact nor approximate with its
"},{"number":1270,"text":"adequacy relation and an end-to-end bound for its composite is
"},{"number":1271,"text":"inadmissible: a composite that relies on it is neither faithful nor
"},{"number":1272,"text":"adequate within a bound (P4a, P6).
"},{"number":1273,"text":"
"},{"number":1274,"text":"Purpose and material relation: a decomposition or rewrite that changes
"},{"number":1275,"text":"meaning, or approximations whose deviations accumulate, would let a
"},{"number":1276,"text":"composite whose every step passed violate the outer contract (P4a, P1,
"},{"number":1277,"text":"P6). The material relation is whether the composite still meets the outer
"},{"number":1278,"text":"obligations. Preservation per layer, licensing laws and the per-step law
"},{"number":1279,"text":"for exact and approximate steps, including the inadmissibility of a step
"},{"number":1280,"text":"that is neither, are stated here; the obligation to state an
"},{"number":1281,"text":"adequacy relation and a composition bound, and the end-to-end obligations
"},{"number":1282,"text":"of a composition, are
"},{"number":1283,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4 Preservation through construction](FOUNDATIONS.md#preservation-through-construction),
"},{"number":1284,"text":"which this section applies to refinement steps.
"},{"number":1285,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1337,"heading":"ACTIVATION/4. Totality and refinement/Complete enclosing-relation admission","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F4.%20Totality%20and%20refinement%2FComplete%20enclosing-relation%20admission","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"b411163d4b135911d4e764396b90650184016761e885629ad47b3d9a636735e0","start_line":1286,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1286,"text":"### Complete enclosing-relation admission
"},{"number":1287,"text":"
"},{"number":1288,"text":"For a material transition, each admission owner is independently
"},{"number":1289,"text":"responsible for deriving and validating the complete enclosing relation
"},{"number":1290,"text":"from authoritative inputs (P4b, P6).
"},{"number":1291,"text":"The relation contains every participant and equality join whose identity,
"},{"number":1292,"text":"validity, authority, currentness or transition can affect or be affected by
"},{"number":1293,"text":"admission; each crossing seam includes its relevant far side or
"},{"number":1294,"text":"authoritatively establishes that the far side cannot participate. Caller or
"},{"number":1295,"text":"owner assertions of completeness, validity, prior admission or authority do
"},{"number":1296,"text":"not establish truth.
"},{"number":1297,"text":"
"},{"number":1298,"text":"An owner may consume established facts when their exact subject, basis,
"},{"number":1299,"text":"scope, provenance and validity remain applicable to its relation. Their
"},{"number":1300,"text":"production and invalidation are recoverable; an unsupported assertion of
"},{"number":1301,"text":"prior success is not such a fact. A function, component, role,
"},{"number":1302,"text":"conversation or status boundary alone invalidates none of those coordinates
"},{"number":1303,"text":"and requires no repeated derivation. Material mutation, rollback, changed
"},{"number":1304,"text":"authority or basis, expired validity and an actual trust boundary trigger
"},{"number":1305,"text":"the applicable validation before reliance or effect. Reuse does not
"},{"number":1306,"text":"transfer the owner's admission responsibility, omit a participant or
"},{"number":1307,"text":"satisfy a separately required independent judgment (§7).
"},{"number":1308,"text":"
"},{"number":1309,"text":"Derivation and validation bind one exact admission-valid authoritative
"},{"number":1310,"text":"basis identity through admission. If validity or currentness can advance
"},{"number":1311,"text":"after preflight, admission remains conditional on the declared predecessor
"},{"number":1312,"text":"and currentness law for that basis, or re-enters derivation and validation
"},{"number":1313,"text":"without effect. Participating owners bind an equal basis or a
"},{"number":1314,"text":"design-declared coherent composite basis; independently valid mixed-basis
"},{"number":1315,"text":"judgments cannot combine (FOUNDATIONS §2, Basis).
"},{"number":1316,"text":"
"},{"number":1317,"text":"Every participant and join is validated before any transition effect.
"},{"number":1318,"text":"Internal evaluation order and lawful reuse are implementation-owned, and no
"},{"number":1319,"text":"participant subset or nested constituent becomes admitted truth. Admission
"},{"number":1320,"text":"is one semantic commit of the complete transition, bound to its exact basis
"},{"number":1321,"text":"identity; failure or interruption admits the complete transition or none,
"},{"number":1322,"text":"never a subset. No realisation mechanism or participant count is
"},{"number":1323,"text":"prescribed. Direct and every supported composite or nested boundary
"},{"number":1324,"text":"preserve this law: a partial result cannot substitute for an owner's
"},{"number":1325,"text":"derivation and validation, and a competing same-scope path cannot establish
"},{"number":1326,"text":"the transition outside the governing admission relation. Fresh
"},{"number":1327,"text":"reconstruction and replay over the same basis reproduce the enclosing
"},{"number":1328,"text":"relation, the basis identity and the complete outcome or refusal exactly at
"},{"number":1329,"text":"semantic altitude (P3, P5).
"},{"number":1330,"text":"
"},{"number":1331,"text":"The law is false if completeness is asserted rather than derived; a
"},{"number":1332,"text":"relevant participant, join or seam is omitted; validation and admission use
"},{"number":1333,"text":"an unidentified, stale or incoherently mixed basis; currentness can
"},{"number":1334,"text":"advance without a commit condition or effect-free re-entry; any effect
"},{"number":1335,"text":"precedes complete validation; failure or interruption exposes a subset;
"},{"number":1336,"text":"fresh reconstruction differs; or competing same-scope authority remains.
"},{"number":1337,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1369,"heading":"ACTIVATION/4. Totality and refinement/Standing structural qualification","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F4.%20Totality%20and%20refinement%2FStanding%20structural%20qualification","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"aa16059145efc645f41f62c56407a92de27ebd1a7a4c520055344bf763a1dd20","start_line":1338,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1338,"text":"### Standing structural qualification
"},{"number":1339,"text":"
"},{"number":1340,"text":"Qualification of the admission law is instantiated for every admission
"},{"number":1341,"text":"owner and supported boundary declared by accepted design (P6). Case applicability
"},{"number":1342,"text":"follows the supported input, state and operating or threat model. An
"},{"number":1343,"text":"excluded threat alone cannot create an acceptance predicate or require
"},{"number":1344,"text":"defensive work; a proposed scope expansion returns to its owning authority.
"},{"number":1345,"text":"Supported malformed inputs, stale state and effect boundaries retain their
"},{"number":1346,"text":"required checks:
"},{"number":1347,"text":"
"},{"number":1348,"text":"| Form | Required observation |
"},{"number":1349,"text":"|---|---|
"},{"number":1350,"text":"| direct | the complete direct relation is derived, validated and admitted once |
"},{"number":1351,"text":"| supported composite or nested | every supported constituent and owning boundary satisfies the same law; unsupported forms have a design-grounded `not_applicable` disposition and no weaker or competing path |
"},{"number":1352,"text":"| forged | forged identity, membership, equality or authority reachable within the supported operating or threat model is refused without effect; exclusion requires its owning authority, not a helper's inability to construct the case |
"},{"number":1353,"text":"| ambiguous enclosing relation | unresolved participant, join, seam or relation identity ambiguity is refused without effect |
"},{"number":1354,"text":"| stale or advanced basis | stale input is refused, and basis advancement between preflight and admission causes effect-free re-entry rather than mixed-basis admission |
"},{"number":1355,"text":"| incoherent multi-owner basis | owner judgments on bases that are neither equal nor joined by a design-declared coherent composite basis cannot combine and are refused without effect |
"},{"number":1356,"text":"| competing same-scope admission authority | an undisposed competing same-scope path cannot establish the transition |
"},{"number":1357,"text":"| reconstructed or fresh-process | the same basis reconstructs the same relation, basis identity and outcome or refusal |
"},{"number":1358,"text":"| exact replay equality | replay over the same basis reproduces exactly the enclosing relation, basis identity and complete outcome or refusal |
"},{"number":1359,"text":"| atomic publication failure | after validation succeeds, failure or interruption is observed at every materially distinct commit or publication boundary capable of exposing a subset, followed by fresh reconstruction showing the complete transition or none; named representative observations suffice only under a design-declared dominance or equivalence proof covering the complete partial-failure surface |
"},{"number":1360,"text":"
"},{"number":1361,"text":"For an indivisible commit unit the atomic test establishes that boundary
"},{"number":1362,"text":"and observes failure immediately on both sides. Final-participant
"},{"number":1363,"text":"validation failure does not substitute for post-validation atomic-failure
"},{"number":1364,"text":"evidence. A standing claim is false if an owner or supported boundary is
"},{"number":1365,"text":"omitted, a materially distinct partial-failure boundary lacks an
"},{"number":1366,"text":"observation or a declared coverage proof, a case uses a weaker helper or a
"},{"number":1367,"text":"manufactured refusal, or fresh reconstruction does not compare the complete
"},{"number":1368,"text":"semantic result (EVALUATION §1).
"},{"number":1369,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1457,"heading":"ACTIVATION/5. Work state and restart","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F5.%20Work%20state%20and%20restart","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"9185e022f3ca8c89da7c4ab25b04e83cd7ef4ac55e98315c2157ad47389e1485","start_line":1370,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1370,"text":"## 5. Work state and restart
"},{"number":1371,"text":"
"},{"number":1372,"text":"Work state is the tuple of: the current persistent workspace; the governing
"},{"number":1373,"text":"basis; the applicable closed results and judgments with their invalidators;
"},{"number":1374,"text":"the residuals; and the known uncertainty over external effects. It is an
"},{"number":1375,"text":"object (P3); its carrier (files, an event stream, another admitted owner) is
"},{"number":1376,"text":"a profile or realisation choice. Resumption, checkpointing and the
"},{"number":1377,"text":"progress account of this section are generic procedures
"},{"number":1378,"text":"([SPEC_METHOD §11](SPEC_METHOD.md#11-build-tenant-binding)): they require
"},{"number":1379,"text":"no particular carrier (P1, P6).
"},{"number":1380,"text":"
"},{"number":1381,"text":"Resumption is re-entry of the same method over the current work state,
"},{"number":1382,"text":"starting from the current material state, by a possibly different actor.
"},{"number":1383,"text":"It recovers applicable progress, re-checks the invalidators of each reused
"},{"number":1384,"text":"result (§7), reopens only affected support, and reconciles uncertain
"},{"number":1385,"text":"external effects, sufficiently for the next dependent action, before any
"},{"number":1386,"text":"repetition or dependent action. Resumption does not imply idempotence: an
"},{"number":1387,"text":"action whose external effect may have occurred is not repeated blindly;
"},{"number":1388,"text":"the lawful next moves are reconciliation, yield or stop.
"},{"number":1389,"text":"
"},{"number":1390,"text":"Checkpoint. Acceptance binds one exact checkpoint. The next
"},{"number":1391,"text":"already-authorised bounded action may begin without renewed human approval;
"},{"number":1392,"text":"acceptance does not widen the selected outcome or the affected relation set
"},{"number":1393,"text":"(P6, P2). A preservation checkpoint may retain unfinished or unaccepted
"},{"number":1394,"text":"work under an existing exact operation grant; it identifies its parent or
"},{"number":1395,"text":"predecessor, the included territory, the concurrent-writer disposition and
"},{"number":1396,"text":"the durable evidence location, and it is neither acceptance, promotion nor
"},{"number":1397,"text":"publication. A proposed restart, which reconstructs from less than the
"},{"number":1398,"text":"retained work, identifies why repair of retained work is insufficient,
"},{"number":1399,"text":"which obligations and evidence survive, and which causal assumptions
"},{"number":1400,"text":"change; reconstructability alone does not select reconstruction. The work state and reconciliation
"},{"number":1401,"text":"of uncertain effects preserve the retained progress and unresolved obligations
"},{"number":1402,"text":"(P0, P5 with the open-world premise).
"},{"number":1403,"text":"
"},{"number":1404,"text":"Progress is accepted material movement toward the selected outcome;
"},{"number":1405,"text":"prerequisite work names the obligation it enables; preservation and
"},{"number":1406,"text":"repeated proof are evidence, not new progress; rejected or superseded
"},{"number":1407,"text":"construction is churn; discovering previously hidden distance revises the
"},{"number":1408,"text":"forecast and is not negative progress. Paperwork, code volume, test count,
"},{"number":1409,"text":"commit count and review count are not progress by themselves. These are
"},{"number":1410,"text":"semantic categories, not a numeric progress algorithm; a consumer may
"},{"number":1411,"text":"derive its own progress and churn projections from them (P2). A member,
"},{"number":1412,"text":"profile or project that distinguishes finer categories for its own
"},{"number":1413,"text":"outcome states them as a refinement of these, naming this paragraph and
"},{"number":1414,"text":"mapping each of its categories to one of progress, prerequisite work,
"},{"number":1415,"text":"evidence that is not new progress, churn or forecast revision; a category
"},{"number":1416,"text":"it cannot map is a change to this owner, not a parallel category (P2, P6).
"},{"number":1417,"text":"
"},{"number":1418,"text":"The execution protocol of §1, §3 and this section is false if execution
"},{"number":1419,"text":"proceeds from unreconstructable context; if a constructor's report
"},{"number":1420,"text":"substitutes for required independent live evidence; if a bounded proxy
"},{"number":1421,"text":"changes a governing relation outside its delegation; if unrelated
"},{"number":1422,"text":"incompleteness blocks a closed causal cone; if a same-process test is used
"},{"number":1423,"text":"to prove materially cross-process authority (§7); or if rejected activity
"},{"number":1424,"text":"is reported as accepted progress.
"},{"number":1425,"text":"
"},{"number":1426,"text":"Foundation to law. This family, work state, resumption and reuse, covers
"},{"number":1427,"text":"this section and §7. Its instance premises are: (a) a workspace that
"},{"number":1428,"text":"persists across activations; (b) work that spans activations; (c) actors
"},{"number":1429,"text":"that may change between activations; (d) external effects in an open
"},{"number":1430,"text":"world. They are conditions of the work this family governs, not
"},{"number":1431,"text":"commitments, and do not follow from finite capacity alone. The standing of
"},{"number":1432,"text":"the consequences below is stated in
"},{"number":1433,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §3 Foundation to law](FOUNDATIONS.md#foundation-to-law).
"},{"number":1434,"text":"
"},{"number":1435,"text":"| Premises, with standing | Consequence that follows | Rule in this member that states it | Added domain or policy choice, and its owner | Pillar |
"},{"number":1436,"text":"|---|---|---|---|---|
"},{"number":1437,"text":"| P3 (independent), P0 (recovered); instance premises a, b | By P3 work state binds an exact basis, and by P0 an actor holds only part of it at a time, so work state is an object: the workspace, the governing basis, the applicable closed results and judgments, the residuals and the uncertainty over external effects | [§5](#5-work-state-and-restart), first paragraph | its carrier (files, an event stream, another admitted owner): the profile or realisation | 2, 5 |
"},{"number":1438,"text":"| P0 (recovered), P3 (independent), P4b (derived from P0 and P2, with P0's premise that step-produced facts are not re-acquirable), P6 (independent); instance premises a, c | By P0 an actor's context is bounded and disposable, by P3 the workspace binds the exact state, and by P4b recorded facts persist where the context does not, so the workspace is the truth surface and an actor's context a disposable account of it; current evidence corrects the account; discarding the account resets nothing | [The workspace and an actor's account](#the-workspace-and-an-actors-account) | the observations and reconciliations a resumption needs: the recovery contract, which is the resuming step's intake with the work state | 6, 9 |
"},{"number":1439,"text":"| P5 (derived from P0 and P6, with P0's open-world premise), P6 (independent); instance premise d | By P5 an effect of uncertain completion is undecided, and by P6 repeating an effect needs evidence that it is safe, so an effect of uncertain completion is reconciled before any repetition or dependent action; resumption does not imply idempotence | [§5](#5-work-state-and-restart) Resumption; [§3 Effects](#effects) | none | 4, 5 |
"},{"number":1440,"text":"| P2 (independent), P6 (independent); instance premise b | By P2 progress is movement toward the selected outcome, and by P6 acceptance binds what was evaluated, so acceptance binds one exact checkpoint; a restart states why repair of retained work is insufficient; progress is accepted movement towards the selected outcome, not a count; finer progress categories refine these with a map | [§5](#5-work-state-and-restart) Checkpoint and Progress | progress and churn projections: their consumer | 5 |
"},{"number":1441,"text":"| P4b (derived from P0 and P2, with P0's premise that step-produced facts are not re-acquirable), P0 (recovered), P6 (independent); instance premise c | By P4b and P0 private working context does not survive the actor, and by P6 a reused judgment is not a new independent one, so handoff is by closed results without private working context; reuse checks exact applicability and three invalidators, a material input change (newly acquired material evidence included), a changed basis and a declared revising observation, and a domain trigger is an instance of one of them; a reused judgment does not satisfy a required independent judgment | [§7](#7-closed-result-and-reuse) | the revising observation a result declares, and its other invalidation conditions: the producer of that result | 7, 9 |
"},{"number":1442,"text":"| P5 (derived from P0 and P6, with P0's open-world premise), P6 (independent); instance premise c | By P5 a transition's outcome is undecided without its evidence, and by P6 a proof establishes only the authority it was produced under, so a reviewable transition names its exact candidate, changes, proof and disposition; a same-process proof does not establish a reconstructable authority claim where the loss of process state is a counterexample | [Transition evidence](#transition-evidence) | the representation of transition evidence: its consumer | 9 |
"},{"number":1443,"text":"
"},{"number":1444,"text":"Consumers of these rows, where an actor enters them (FOUNDATIONS §3
"},{"number":1445,"text":"Foundation to law, Consumers), one list per row, each consumer linked to
"},{"number":1446,"text":"its own locus:
"},{"number":1447,"text":"
"},{"number":1448,"text":"- Row 1, work state as an object: [§1 Transitions](#transitions), where the current state is the work state this section records; [FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results), Not performed, and [Assertions and observation](FOUNDATIONS.md#assertions-and-observation), where unresolved work and an unexercised capability are a state of the work, carried as a residual and not a result; [WORLD_MODEL §14](WORLD_MODEL.md#14-results-of-this-profile), where a step's work state carries an unrun verification as a residual; [REFERENCE_FRAME §10 Revision actions](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#revision-actions), where results reopened without a material revision are recorded in the work state; [UX §8 Msg-replay proof](UX.md#msg-replay-proof), whose Msg log is the surface's recorded work state, and the [UX family table](UX.md#foundation-to-law), whose row for continuation and replay imports F4; the [ODD family table](ODD.md#foundation-to-law), whose conservation row imports F4 for records of needed step-produced facts and reconciliation with current workspace evidence.
"},{"number":1449,"text":"- Row 2, the workspace and an actor's account: [§1 Transitions](#transitions), where an actor's context is an account of the current state and not the state itself; [EXECUTIVE_BASELINE §20](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#20-failure-classification), where a compression, summary or prior result that replaces current source authority is evidence substitution and a retained account never overrules current evidence; [UX §8 Msg-replay proof](UX.md#msg-replay-proof), where replay is resumption from the recorded work state; [CONFORMANCE §4](CONFORMANCE.md#4-cases-for-method-discriminators), case CD-03, and [§5](CONFORMANCE.md#5-discriminator-coverage), discriminators 38 and 39.
"},{"number":1450,"text":"- Row 3, resumption and effects of uncertain completion: [§1 Construction relation](#construction-relation), Control, where resumption reacquires current reality and unknown effects are resolved before the next dependent action; [EXECUTIVE_BASELINE §12 step 4](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#4-executive-evaluates-the-work-result), [§7 The executive configuration](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#the-executive-configuration), failure assumptions, and [§13 Handoff projection](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#13-handoff-projection), whose work result names each intended effect with its value, and the [EXECUTIVE_BASELINE family table](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#foundation-to-law), whose row for the effect field imports F4 for the reconciliation; [PRODUCT_DEFINITION §4 Explicit complete consumer update](PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md#explicit-complete-consumer-update), where an update of uncertain completion is reconciled from the presented preimages before any repetition; [SPEC_METHOD §4 Computed classification and treatment](SPEC_METHOD.md#computed-classification-and-treatment), where a retry waits on that reconciliation; [TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE Closed constraint, judgment, residual and stop kinds](TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md#closed-constraint-judgment-residual-and-stop-kinds) and [Mutable-subject effect relation](TRAVERSAL_OCCURRENCE.md#mutable-subject-effect-relation), where an effect whose end is not established is reconciled before any repetition; [FOUNDATIONS §4 Change impact and evidence reuse](FOUNDATIONS.md#change-impact-and-evidence-reuse), where recovery reacquires current reality and need not erase valid work; [CONFORMANCE §4](CONFORMANCE.md#4-cases-for-method-discriminators), case CD-03, and [§5](CONFORMANCE.md#5-discriminator-coverage), discriminators 38 and 39.
