Work state and restart/The workspace and an actor's account","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F5.%20Work%20state%20and%20restart%2FThe%20workspace%20and%20an%20actor%27s%20account","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"124e711463d9a34c1a1d896b1f80c32934bd2dc444b5a3f0e256e97611030f7c","start_line":1458,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1458,"text":"### The workspace and an actor's account
"},{"number":1459,"text":"
"},{"number":1460,"text":"The workspace and its authoritative inputs persist across activations and
"},{"number":1461,"text":"are the continuing truth surface of the work: the surface whose current
"},{"number":1462,"text":"material state decides what the work has and has not done. An actor's
"},{"number":1463,"text":"context is an account of that state. It is bounded, because it is a
"},{"number":1464,"text":"projection of the state (§2); revisable, because an observation can
"},{"number":1465,"text":"correct it; and disposable, because a step records its closed results and
"},{"number":1466,"text":"step-produced facts before it returns (§1 Admission; P4b). An account is
"},{"number":1467,"text":"never a second truth surface, and no later activation needs a prior
"},{"number":1468,"text":"actor's context: its intake reconstructs the governing relations without
"},{"number":1469,"text":"it (§1 Intake) (P0, P3, P6).
"},{"number":1470,"text":"
"},{"number":1471,"text":"Acquisition ([§2](#2-context-construction-under-an-envelope)) observes the
"},{"number":1472,"text":"current subject and its authoritative inputs. Where they materially
"},{"number":1473,"text":"disagree with a cached belief, a retained summary or a prior result, the
"},{"number":1474,"text":"actor reconciles the disagreement: current evidence corrects the account,
"},{"number":1475,"text":"and what the evidence cannot decide stays an explicit unknown. A stored
"},{"number":1476,"text":"belief, a summary or a successful prior result never overrules contrary
"},{"number":1477,"text":"current evidence. A prior result is relied on only after its
"},{"number":1478,"text":"applicability and invalidators are checked against the current subject
"},{"number":1479,"text":"and inputs (§7). The actor corrects its account within its grant; where
"},{"number":1480,"text":"resolving the disagreement needs an operation, a territory or a decision
"},{"number":1481,"text":"outside the grant, the step stops with `re_entry_requested(authority)`,
"},{"number":1482,"text":"naming the owner of what it needs (§3 Construction availability) (P5,
"},{"number":1483,"text":"P6).
"},{"number":1484,"text":"
"},{"number":1485,"text":"Discarding an actor's private context resets nothing: the workspace, the
"},{"number":1486,"text":"applicable valid work and the outstanding obligations remain as the work
"},{"number":1487,"text":"state records them. A missing trace in a context, a memory or a summary is
"},{"number":1488,"text":"no evidence about the subject. It shows neither that work was not done
"},{"number":1489,"text":"nor that an external effect did not occur, nor that it ended; an effect
"},{"number":1490,"text":"of uncertain completion keeps the value `completion_unknown`, or its end
"},{"number":1491,"text":"stays not established beside its `not_effected` value, until evidence
"},{"number":1492,"text":"about the subject decides it (§3 Effects) (P5).
"},{"number":1493,"text":"
"},{"number":1494,"text":"Work that an interruption left partly written is part of the current
"},{"number":1495,"text":"material state from which resumption (above) starts, and is assessed as
"},{"number":1496,"text":"it stands; an assessment that was not performed has no result and is
"},{"number":1497,"text":"never recorded as performed
"},{"number":1498,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results); §3 Construction
"},{"number":1499,"text":"availability). The method imposes no universal reset and no obligation to
"},{"number":1500,"text":"replay the complete history. The recovery contract that applies, which is
"},{"number":1501,"text":"the resuming step's intake with the work state, determines which
"},{"number":1502,"text":"observations and which effect reconciliations the next dependent action
"},{"number":1503,"text":"needs. Handoff between actors is by closed results, which carry no private
"},{"number":1504,"text":"working context and keep their validity and independence conditions (§7)
"},{"number":1505,"text":"(P0, P4b).
"},{"number":1506,"text":"
"},{"number":1507,"text":"Purpose and material relation: finite context (P0) means an actor's
"},{"number":1508,"text":"context ends or is replaced while the work continues, and discarding it is
"},{"number":1509,"text":"safe only because the step-produced facts the outer contract needs are
"},{"number":1510,"text":"recorded (P4b). Treating the account as the truth surface would let a
"},{"number":1511,"text":"stale account overrule the workspace; treating a discarded account as a
"},{"number":1512,"text":"reset would erase progress or repeat an effect that occurred (P5, P6). The
"},{"number":1513,"text":"material relation is whether a decision relies on an account that current
"},{"number":1514,"text":"evidence contradicts, or reads a missing record as undone work or an
"},{"number":1515,"text":"absent effect.  The workspace, the
"},{"number":1516,"text":"work state and the closed results carry it, and no further carrier is
"},{"number":1517,"text":"required.
"},{"number":1518,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1626,"heading":"ACTIVATION/6. Cost and proportionality","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F6.%20Cost%20and%20proportionality","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"05edae9beedbd3efdb614464841896c7300a5580b45d8347850ed7b38bc76218","start_line":1519,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1519,"text":"## 6. Cost and proportionality
"},{"number":1520,"text":"
"},{"number":1521,"text":"Proportionality is the relation between semantic ambiguity removed and
"},{"number":1522,"text":"effective reasoning complexity introduced. A method obligation is
"},{"number":1523,"text":"proportional when its contraction of the admissible interpretation space
"},{"number":1524,"text":"justifies the additional concepts, relations, projections and evidence an
"},{"number":1525,"text":"actor must hold together to reach a correct decision (P2, P0).
"},{"number":1526,"text":"
"},{"number":1527,"text":"Effective reasoning complexity includes independent concepts and authority
"},{"number":1528,"text":"surfaces, cross-document joins, exceptions and branching, states and
"},{"number":1529,"text":"transitions, duplicated representations requiring reconciliation, and the
"},{"number":1530,"text":"detail required to decide the governed question. It is not raw line count,
"},{"number":1531,"text":"artifact count or context-window size. A detailed algebra or semantic
"},{"number":1532,"text":"design view may be highly proportional when it eliminates rival
"},{"number":1533,"text":"interpretations; a short additional ticket, receipt or summary may be
"},{"number":1534,"text":"disproportionate when it creates another truth surface without reducing
"},{"number":1535,"text":"uncertainty.
"},{"number":1536,"text":"
"},{"number":1537,"text":"A proportional method deliberately constrains the admissible reasoning and
"},{"number":1538,"text":"realisation space. Each constraint identifies the semantic ambiguity it
"},{"number":1539,"text":"removes and contracts enough of the admissible interpretation space to
"},{"number":1540,"text":"justify the reasoning complexity it introduces. Rival authority,
"},{"number":1541,"text":"uncertainty over failure classification and evidence uncertainty count only
"},{"number":1542,"text":"where they leave materially distinct admissible semantic, authority,
"},{"number":1543,"text":"outcome or acceptance interpretations; they measure or evidence the same
"},{"number":1544,"text":"interpretation space removed and are not independent proportional
"},{"number":1545,"text":"benefits. The method does not prescribe an internal decomposition, search,
"},{"number":1546,"text":"collaboration, tool or synthesis procedure when variation in that procedure
"},{"number":1547,"text":"cannot affect a governed semantic, authority, evidence, safety or release
"},{"number":1548,"text":"property. Increased actor capability may enlarge the bounded relation an
"},{"number":1549,"text":"actor can resolve; it grants no authority, an instance of
"},{"number":1550,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §2 Authority kinds](FOUNDATIONS.md#authority-kinds), What
"},{"number":1551,"text":"creates no authority, and it weakens no invariant and waives no
"},{"number":1552,"text":"acceptance (P6). The owning law may justify one coherent constraint
"},{"number":1553,"text":"family once; no rationale field, receipt or repeated audit is required for
"},{"number":1554,"text":"every clause or consumer application.
"},{"number":1555,"text":"
"},{"number":1556,"text":"For symbolic design, materially divergent implementation paths, runtime
"},{"number":1557,"text":"states, tests, reviews and reconciliation joins are counterfactual evidence
"},{"number":1558,"text":"of the semantic alternatives the design contracts; they are not an
"},{"number":1559,"text":"independent numerator. When one bounded symbolic model can resolve those
"},{"number":1560,"text":"material alternatives within effective reasoning capacity, resolving it at
"},{"number":1561,"text":"design altitude is proportional even when the model is detailed. A prior
"},{"number":1562,"text":"design surface that removes no material semantic alternative is
"},{"number":1563,"text":"disproportionate. A method addition is disproportionate when it duplicates
"},{"number":1564,"text":"truth, increases reconciliation paths or expands the bounded reasoning
"},{"number":1565,"text":"surface without materially reducing ambiguity; existing obligations should
"},{"number":1566,"text":"absorb new detail where they can without weakening ownership or meaning.
"},{"number":1567,"text":"
"},{"number":1568,"text":"Apply this relation to the method's own execution: repeated source
"},{"number":1569,"text":"acquisition, context assembly, hashing, activation preparation, status
"},{"number":1570,"text":"recording, review and evidence generation serve an identified change,
"},{"number":1571,"text":"decision or assurance need. Reuse stays subject to exact applicability and
"},{"number":1572,"text":"invalidation (§7); repetition alone supplies neither validity nor
"},{"number":1573,"text":"independence. Where this work materially affects the supported outcome, its
"},{"number":1574,"text":"operational assumptions are qualified under UP-019 below. No universal
"},{"number":1575,"text":"resource quota or separate accounting carrier follows. The delivery
"},{"number":1576,"text":"priority this relation yields for a product outcome is SPEC_METHOD §8.
"},{"number":1577,"text":"
"},{"number":1578,"text":"Cost is selected, not universal. Where a cost claim is the governed
"},{"number":1579,"text":"question, the activation declares its allowance and reports its spend,
"},{"number":1580,"text":"measured under the selected execution binding or recorded as unmeasured
"},{"number":1581,"text":"(P0; Resource limits below). The size of an activation's
"},{"number":1582,"text":"context is measured and fitted under §2 step 3, which refines the
"},{"number":1583,"text":"resource-limit law below for the context dimension. Separate material startup, framework
"},{"number":1584,"text":"processing, external computation, transport and assurance costs so that
"},{"number":1585,"text":"one cannot conceal another; declare supported input dimensions and
"},{"number":1586,"text":"workloads before qualification
"},{"number":1587,"text":"([UP-019](DESIGN_MODULE.md#computational-realisation-projection-up-019)).
"},{"number":1588,"text":"Report volume is not model traffic; a cost claim over transferred context
"},{"number":1589,"text":"counts the context transferred to every delegated actor, not only to the
"},{"number":1590,"text":"coordinator. No universal quota, ticket count, actor count or accounting
"},{"number":1591,"text":"carrier follows.
"},{"number":1592,"text":"
"},{"number":1593,"text":"Foundation to law. This family, proportionality and cost, covers this
"},{"number":1594,"text":"section, with Resource limits below, and the delivery priority of
"},{"number":1595,"text":"SPEC_METHOD §8. Its instance premises
"},{"number":1596,"text":"are: (a) a selected outcome; (b) method obligations that each add
"},{"number":1597,"text":"reasoning complexity; (c) where one is the governed question, a cost
"},{"number":1598,"text":"claim; (d) an activation that consumes bounded resources, such as
"},{"number":1599,"text":"context, attention, time or spend. They are conditions of the work this family governs, not
"},{"number":1600,"text":"commitments, and do not follow from finite capacity alone. The standing of
"},{"number":1601,"text":"the consequences below is stated in
"},{"number":1602,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §3 Foundation to law](FOUNDATIONS.md#foundation-to-law).
"},{"number":1603,"text":"
"},{"number":1604,"text":"| Premises, with standing | Consequence that follows | Rule in this member that states it | Added domain or policy choice, and its owner | Pillar |
"},{"number":1605,"text":"|---|---|---|---|---|
"},{"number":1606,"text":"| P2 (independent), P0 (recovered); instance premise b | By P2 an obligation is justified only by its route to the outcome, and by P0 reasoning capacity is finite, so a method obligation is proportional only when the ambiguity it removes justifies the reasoning complexity it adds, and that complexity is not raw size | [§6](#6-cost-and-proportionality), first three paragraphs | the justification of a constraint family: its owning law, once for the family | 6, 7 |
"},{"number":1607,"text":"| P2 (independent), P0 (recovered), P1 (independent); instance premise b | By P2 and P0 detail is justified where it resolves alternatives the actor can hold, and by P1 a duplicate of truth is a second representation, not more truth, so a detailed symbolic design that resolves material alternatives within reasoning capacity is proportional; an addition that duplicates truth or adds reconciliation paths without reducing ambiguity is not | [§6](#6-cost-and-proportionality), symbolic-design paragraph | none | 4, 6 |
"},{"number":1608,"text":"| P2 (independent), P0 (recovered), P6 (independent); instance premise b | By P2 the method's own steps need an identified purpose, and by P6 and P0 repetition adds neither validity nor independence, so the method's own acquisition, hashing, review and evidence serve an identified need; repetition supplies neither validity nor independence | [§6](#6-cost-and-proportionality), method's own execution | none | 7, 9 |
"},{"number":1609,"text":"| P0 (recovered), P2 (independent); instance premise c | By P0 and P2 spend is part of what a finite actor's work costs the outcome, so a cost claim declares its allowance and reports spend measured under the selected execution binding, or recorded as unmeasured; costs that could conceal one another are kept apart; no universal quota follows | [§6](#6-cost-and-proportionality), Cost is selected | the allowance: the activation that makes the claim; the measurement units and boundaries of the cost components: the selected execution binding, under [Resource limits](#resource-limits) | 8 |
"},{"number":1610,"text":"| P0 (recovered), P5 (derived from P0 and P6, with P0's open-world premise), P6 (independent), P2 (independent); instance premise d | By P0 limits bind only as declared and measured, by P5 an unmeasured consumption supports no claim of fit, and by P6 and P2 staying within a limit establishes no adequacy, so a resource limit binds only where it is declared, with its unit and measurement boundary, and no universal quota follows; consumption outside the measured boundary supports no fit; pressure on a limit never licenses omission, so the activation refines, sequences, reassigns or stops with a named value; staying within limits shows no adequacy and grants no authority | [Resource limits](#resource-limits) | the value of each limit and the units and boundaries the environment can measure: the selected execution binding, for a build tenant [SPEC_METHOD §11](SPEC_METHOD.md#11-build-tenant-binding) | 8, 7 |
"},{"number":1611,"text":"| P2 (independent), P0 (recovered); instance premise a | By P2 delivery serves the outcome, and by P0 an actor can pursue only part of it at a time, so delivery for a product outcome is prioritised by this relation over likelihood, impact, reversibility, dependency and delayed feedback; probability waives no hard stop | [SPEC_METHOD §8](SPEC_METHOD.md#8-bounded-execution-in-this-method), outside this member | the default priority, the smallest supported product path first: SPEC_METHOD §8 | 1, 5 |
"},{"number":1612,"text":"
"},{"number":1613,"text":"Consumers of these rows, where an actor enters them (FOUNDATIONS §3
"},{"number":1614,"text":"Foundation to law, Consumers), one list per row, each consumer linked to
"},{"number":1615,"text":"its own locus:
"},{"number":1616,"text":"
"},{"number":1617,"text":"- Row 1, the proportionality relation: [§1 Configuration](#configuration), whose explanation of an allocation is proportional, and [Roles and delegation](#roles-and-delegation), where a review or ceremony that no law requires adds reasoning cost without removing ambiguity; [§7 Transition evidence](#transition-evidence), whose proof cadence uses the cheapest focused proof unless the affected risk makes whole-candidate proof necessary; [DESIGN_MODULE §5](DESIGN_MODULE.md#5-ontology-first-design), its opening, and [Proportional design sequencing](DESIGN_MODULE.md#proportional-design-sequencing), where the relation selects between co-evolution and a design gate; [§6 Boundary and governance cost (UP-005)](DESIGN_MODULE.md#boundary-and-governance-cost-up-005), which applies the relation to Prime contraction; [Capability and foundation selection (UP-023)](DESIGN_MODULE.md#capability-and-foundation-selection-up-023), whose selection pass is applied proportionally; [CONFORMANCE §1](CONFORMANCE.md#1-counterexample-cases), case C-12, and [§5](CONFORMANCE.md#5-discriminator-coverage), discriminator 41.
"},{"number":1618,"text":"- Row 2, symbolic design and the disproportion test: [DESIGN_MODULE §5 Proportional design sequencing](DESIGN_MODULE.md#proportional-design-sequencing), where the realisation space a bounded symbolic model removes is counterfactual evidence and a gate that removes no material alternative adds ceremony; [§6 Boundary and governance cost (UP-005)](DESIGN_MODULE.md#boundary-and-governance-cost-up-005), where a contraction that adds authority centres or truth surfaces does not succeed; [CONFORMANCE §5](CONFORMANCE.md#5-discriminator-coverage), discriminator 11.
"},{"number":1619,"text":"- Row 3, the method's own execution: [EXECUTIVE_BASELINE §6 Event-driven attention](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#event-driven-attention), where repeated polling or repair on an unchanged basis is no reassessment and reduced churn introduces no universal cost gate; [FOUNDATIONS §4 Change impact and evidence reuse](FOUNDATIONS.md#change-impact-and-evidence-reuse), where the selection of checks after a change weighs acquisition, execution and assessment costs against the required assurance.
"},{"number":1620,"text":"- Row 4, cost is selected: [§1 Intake](#intake), where an intake whose governed question is a cost claim declares the allowance and how spend will be measured; [REFERENCE_FRAME §4 Frame-set selection](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#frame-set-selection), where frame selection creates no universal resource ledger and this section is the cost control where a cost claim is the governed question; [FOUNDATIONS §4 Change impact and evidence reuse](FOUNDATIONS.md#change-impact-and-evidence-reuse), where anticipated costs are distinguished from measurements; [DESIGN_MODULE §7 Computational realisation projection (UP-019)](DESIGN_MODULE.md#computational-realisation-projection-up-019), which takes the separation of startup, framework, external, transport and assurance costs from here; [EVALUATION §7 Method self-qualification](EVALUATION.md#method-self-qualification), where mechanical and operational claims carry the workload and operational assumptions declared here; [CONFORMANCE §1](CONFORMANCE.md#1-counterexample-cases), cases C-01 and C-06.
"},{"number":1621,"text":"- Row 5, resource limits: [§1 Configuration](#configuration), where each assumed limit is declared as this subsection states, and [§2](#2-context-construction-under-an-envelope), step 3, which refines the law for the context dimension and measures over the boundary the execution binding states; [SPEC_METHOD §11](SPEC_METHOD.md#11-build-tenant-binding), whose binding sets the values, units and boundaries; [EXECUTIVE_BASELINE §7 The executive configuration](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#the-executive-configuration), whose assumed limits are declared, measured and honoured as this subsection states, and the [EXECUTIVE_BASELINE family table](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#foundation-to-law), whose row for that configuration imports F5 for them; [EVALUATION §7 Frame qualification](EVALUATION.md#frame-qualification), where time, spend and other limits are the execution binding's under this law and not of the fit test; [REFERENCE_FRAME §4 Frame-set selection](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#frame-set-selection), where a resource control applies only through a selected frame; [CONFORMANCE §2](CONFORMANCE.md#2-construction-trials), whose total-work budget is a limit declared under this subsection.
"},{"number":1622,"text":"- Row 6, delivery priority: [EXECUTIVE_BASELINE §8 Steel-thread delivery](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#steel-thread-delivery), whose sequencing around the smallest runnable path is this priority as profile law; [ASSURANCE §13 Obligations](ASSURANCE.md#obligations), where an early sunny thread establishes bounded evidence while unexercised claims stay open, the sequencing heuristic of SPEC_METHOD §8.
"},{"number":1623,"text":"
"},{"number":1624,"text":"Each consumer applies the rule and decides nothing the owning section does
"},{"number":1625,"text":"not (P2, P6).
"},{"number":1626,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1680,"heading":"ACTIVATION/6. Cost and proportionality/Resource limits","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F6.%20Cost%20and%20proportionality%2FResource%20limits","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"92ab379aae0fb61566894e2278729d41919f8363f6e4cf174388865fe6165bfe","start_line":1627,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1627,"text":"### Resource limits
"},{"number":1628,"text":"
"},{"number":1629,"text":"A resource limit bounds a resource that an activation consumes: context,
"},{"number":1630,"text":"attention, wall time, spend, human effort, communication or a machine
"},{"number":1631,"text":"resource (P0). This subsection owns the law for every such limit. It sets
"},{"number":1632,"text":"no value (P0, P2, P5, P6):
"},{"number":1633,"text":"
"},{"number":1634,"text":"- Declaration. A limit applies to an activation only where its intake,
"},{"number":1635,"text":"  its actor's capability envelope or the selected execution binding
"},{"number":1636,"text":"  declares it, because a resource control applies only through a selected
"},{"number":1637,"text":"  frame and its owning scope
"},{"number":1638,"text":"  ([REFERENCE_FRAME §4 Frame-set selection](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#frame-set-selection)).
"},{"number":1639,"text":"  A declared limit states its unit and the boundary over which it is
"},{"number":1640,"text":"  measured: which inputs, actors, processes and repeated reads it counts.
"},{"number":1641,"text":"  No universal quota, budget or measurement gate follows.
"},{"number":1642,"text":"- Measurement. A declared limit is measured in its unit over its boundary
"},{"number":1643,"text":"  where the obligation it serves needs the measurement; consumption
"},{"number":1644,"text":"  outside the boundary is recorded as not measured, and no claim against
"},{"number":1645,"text":"  the limit covers it. A context limit bounds the material held in active
"},{"number":1646,"text":"  context at once, including material acquired during the activation, so
"},{"number":1647,"text":"  the bytes supplied at its start, the cumulative bytes it acquires,
"},{"number":1648,"text":"  counting repeated reads, and the bound on what it holds at once are
"},{"number":1649,"text":"  reported separately; §2 step 3 refines this for the measurement of the
"},{"number":1650,"text":"  selected context before it is read. Measures that answer different
"},{"number":1651,"text":"  questions, such as the cost components of Cost is selected above, are
"},{"number":1652,"text":"  reported separately.
"},{"number":1653,"text":"- Exhaustion. Pressure on a declared limit never licenses omitting or
"},{"number":1654,"text":"  truncating a material obligation or input. Before a limit would be
"},{"number":1655,"text":"  exceeded, the activation refines the task, sequences activations,
"},{"number":1656,"text":"  reassigns the work to an actor whose limits fit, or stops with the
"},{"number":1657,"text":"  applicable value of §3, naming the limit, such as `incomplete` where
"},{"number":1658,"text":"  bounded execution ends first; a stop keeps the unresolved outcome
"},{"number":1659,"text":"  ([§1 Transitions](#transitions), Stops). Enlarging a limit re-enters the
"},{"number":1660,"text":"  owner of the grant or binding that set it.
"},{"number":1661,"text":"- Values. The value of each limit, and the units and boundaries the
"},{"number":1662,"text":"  selected environment can measure, are set by the selected execution
"},{"number":1663,"text":"  binding, which binds this law; for a build tenant that binding is the
"},{"number":1664,"text":"  one [SPEC_METHOD §11](SPEC_METHOD.md#11-build-tenant-binding) defines.
"},{"number":1665,"text":"  A value is stated before the activation it limits.
"},{"number":1666,"text":"- Standing. An activation that stays within its limits is not thereby
"},{"number":1667,"text":"  adequate, and an actor's larger limits grant no authority and waive no
"},{"number":1668,"text":"  invariant (P2, P6).
"},{"number":1669,"text":"
"},{"number":1670,"text":"Purpose and material relation: the configuration (§1), context
"},{"number":1671,"text":"construction (§2) and frame qualification
"},{"number":1672,"text":"([EVALUATION §7](EVALUATION.md#frame-qualification)) rely on resource
"},{"number":1673,"text":"limits, so the law for declaring, measuring and honouring them is stated
"},{"number":1674,"text":"once in tier 1, and only their values are left to the execution binding.
"},{"number":1675,"text":"The material relation is whether an undeclared, unmeasured or exceeded
"},{"number":1676,"text":"limit is read as fitting, or forces a silent omission. The rule applies
"},{"number":1677,"text":"RF-014's prohibition of silent omission, REFERENCE_FRAME §4's rule that a
"},{"number":1678,"text":"resource control applies only through a selected frame, and UP-014's
"},{"number":1679,"text":"selection rule.
"},{"number":1680,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1749,"heading":"ACTIVATION/7. Closed result and reuse","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F7.%20Closed%20result%20and%20reuse","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"65d2435bbfa386121d2de9806fe4d910d63e0e4889bd1373a4dab676690a4dd4","start_line":1681,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1681,"text":"## 7. Closed result and reuse
"},{"number":1682,"text":"
"},{"number":1683,"text":"A closed result identifies the frame and its activation, the subject, the
"},{"number":1684,"text":"basis, the evaluation, the actor, the evidence, the verdict, the residual
"},{"number":1685,"text":"uncertainty and the invalidation conditions (the minimal shape is
"},{"number":1686,"text":"REFERENCE_FRAME §13). The frame's internal working context need not be
"},{"number":1687,"text":"transferred when the closed result and its provenance are sufficient for
"},{"number":1688,"text":"the consuming decision; it may still be attached, for audit or otherwise,
"},{"number":1689,"text":"without changing the result. Independent evaluations may share valid
"},{"number":1690,"text":"mechanical evidence under the declared independence conditions of
"},{"number":1691,"text":"[EVALUATION §3](EVALUATION.md#3-independent-assessment), which owns that
"},{"number":1692,"text":"permission (P4b, P0).
"},{"number":1693,"text":"
"},{"number":1694,"text":"The sufficiency of a handed-off result or reference for subsequent decisions
"},{"number":1695,"text":"is [FOUNDATIONS §4 Observation sufficiency](FOUNDATIONS.md#assertions-and-observation)'s
"},{"number":1696,"text":"consumer-relative claim. Reuse preserves the material standing and
"},{"number":1697,"text":"continuation distinctions, including unassessed versus indeterminate; a
"},{"number":1698,"text":"role change alone requires no full-history scan or new representation.
"},{"number":1699,"text":"
"},{"number":1700,"text":"The selection of affected results after a change and the conditions for
"},{"number":1701,"text":"retaining evidence on a new subject are
"},{"number":1702,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4 Change impact and evidence reuse](FOUNDATIONS.md#change-impact-and-evidence-reuse);
"},{"number":1703,"text":"this section applies them to closed results and handoffs, and the three
"},{"number":1704,"text":"invalidators below are kinds of change Δ, and a closed result is affected
"},{"number":1705,"text":"when its dependencies `D*(t)` meet the impact cover `I(Δ)` (P3, P6).
"},{"number":1706,"text":"
"},{"number":1707,"text":"A closed result is reused by an unchanged consumer that checks exact
"},{"number":1708,"text":"applicability; a role, conversation or resumption change alone invalidates
"},{"number":1709,"text":"nothing. An invalidator invalidates the affected result before reliance,
"},{"number":1710,"text":"even where the subject's own bytes are unchanged, preserving its
"},{"number":1711,"text":"predecessor/successor relation and any demonstrably independent surviving
"},{"number":1712,"text":"results. Invalidation withdraws the result from direct reliance; whether
"},{"number":1713,"text":"its evidence is retained on the new basis is decided by `retain_applicable`
"},{"number":1714,"text":"of FOUNDATIONS §4 Change impact and evidence reuse, and the changed
"},{"number":1715,"text":"coordinate alone establishes neither that the claim fails nor that it
"},{"number":1716,"text":"holds. The invalidators are three:
"},{"number":1717,"text":"
"},{"number":1718,"text":"- a material input change: a change to the result's subject or to an
"},{"number":1719,"text":"  input it rests on, including the admissible evidence that bears on its
"},{"number":1720,"text":"  predicate; newly acquired or changed admissible evidence is such a
"},{"number":1721,"text":"  change when it is material to the result as
"},{"number":1722,"text":"  [FOUNDATIONS §2](FOUNDATIONS.md#2-ontology) defines material, that is,
"},{"number":1723,"text":"  when it could change the result's value;
"},{"number":1724,"text":"- a changed basis: a change to any coordinate of the basis the result
"},{"number":1725,"text":"  binds (FOUNDATIONS §2, Basis);
"},{"number":1726,"text":"- a declared revising observation: an observation that the result or
"},{"number":1727,"text":"  judgment itself names as one that would revise it, once it occurs.
"},{"number":1728,"text":"
"},{"number":1729,"text":"A changed source, task or actor condition is a changed basis where the
"},{"number":1730,"text":"basis binds it, and otherwise a material input change; a role change that
"},{"number":1731,"text":"alters a required actor condition is such a change, while a role,
"},{"number":1732,"text":"conversation or resumption change that alters none of these invalidates
"},{"number":1733,"text":"nothing (P3, P6).
"},{"number":1734,"text":"
"},{"number":1735,"text":"Judgment continuity names the basis and the evidence; Return A Closed
"},{"number":1736,"text":"Result names inputs and the observation. A member, profile or project
"},{"number":1737,"text":"that names a trigger for its own domain, such as a changed projection,
"},{"number":1738,"text":"rule or configuration, names it as an instance of one of these three and
"},{"number":1739,"text":"states no parallel list (P3, P4b, P6). A reused judgment does not
"},{"number":1740,"text":"satisfy a separately required independent judgment; the independent assessor
"},{"number":1741,"text":"acquires its own evidence and supplies its own judgment. [TICKETS §7](TICKETS.md#recorded-judgment-and-owner-ruling-continuity)
"},{"number":1742,"text":"uses the same evidence invalidator. Naming these kinds once gives every
"},{"number":1743,"text":"consumer the same triggers. The
"},{"number":1744,"text":"material relation is whether a result is relied on after a change that
"},{"number":1745,"text":"could alter it (P3, P6). Whether a revision of a frame needs a new
"},{"number":1746,"text":"revision coordinate is
"},{"number":1747,"text":"[REFERENCE_FRAME §10](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#revision-actions)'s question;
"},{"number":1748,"text":"whether a result it touches stays valid is this section's.
"},{"number":1749,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1769,"heading":"ACTIVATION/7. Closed result and reuse/Transition evidence","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md#ACTIVATION%2F7.%20Closed%20result%20and%20reuse%2FTransition%20evidence","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","sha256":"ad70853fcee20640a133dabe87587319c3b31ddaa64534d79eac66c913062ed5","start_line":1750,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/ACTIVATION.md","lines":[{"number":1750,"text":"### Transition evidence
"},{"number":1751,"text":"
"},{"number":1752,"text":"A reviewable transition identifies the exact candidate, the affected
"},{"number":1753,"text":"relations, the changed realisation paths, the authority paths added or
"},{"number":1754,"text":"removed, the retained and open seams, the focused proof, any required
"},{"number":1755,"text":"integration proof, the explicit non-changes, and, where an assessor was
"},{"number":1756,"text":"activated, the assessor's recommended disposition, with the decision
"},{"number":1757,"text":"owner's disposition beside it once one is made (§3). Consumers
"},{"number":1758,"text":"choose the representation. Transition evidence is a read
"},{"number":1759,"text":"model; it does not become specification, design or admission authority
"},{"number":1760,"text":"(P6, P4b).
"},{"number":1761,"text":"
"},{"number":1762,"text":"Construction uses the cheapest focused proof capable of falsifying the
"},{"number":1763,"text":"active relation. Expensive whole-candidate qualification occurs at a
"},{"number":1764,"text":"declared candidate boundary rather than after every local edit, unless the
"},{"number":1765,"text":"affected risk makes whole-candidate proof necessary (§6). A durable or
"},{"number":1766,"text":"reconstructable authority claim is not established solely by a same-process
"},{"number":1767,"text":"proof when loss of incidental process state is a material counterexample:
"},{"number":1768,"text":"the proof destroys or excludes the incidental authority and compares the
"},{"number":1769,"text":"reconstructed semantic outcomes (P5, P6).
"}]},{"end_line":8,"heading":"SDLC default frame guidance","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/SDLC_DEFAULTS.md#SDLC%20default%20frame%20guidance","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/SDLC_DEFAULTS.md","sha256":"ad787fc53516ffdaba9b28ba20ab34b9ac01a54cc41ba7282b2fbeccfad14aff","start_line":1,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/SDLC_DEFAULTS.md","lines":[{"number":1,"text":"# SDLC default frame guidance
"},{"number":2,"text":"
"},{"number":3,"text":"This is a selectable projection of existing method law for ordinary software
"},{"number":4,"text":"work. It connects the current work reference and bounded context to QA,
"},{"number":5,"text":"diagnosis, re-entry, verification and durable continuation;
"},{"number":6,"text":"the linked sections remain the single deciding owners. It adds no result,
"},{"number":7,"text":"actor, workflow engine, permission or mandatory Executive configuration.
"},{"number":8,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":27,"heading":"SDLC default frame guidance/Selection and binding","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/SDLC_DEFAULTS.md#SDLC%20default%20frame%20guidance%2FSelection%20and%20binding","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/SDLC_DEFAULTS.md","sha256":"c69fb2c0d4153cdd8418c5399bdab21a549b1777fbfe2ed9b0feb30166621c7b","start_line":9,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/SDLC_DEFAULTS.md","lines":[{"number":9,"text":"## Selection and binding
"},{"number":10,"text":"
"},{"number":11,"text":"Select this guidance in the accepted Project Reference-Frame Basis, binding
"},{"number":12,"text":"its exact source identity and the governing method cut. The
"},{"number":13,"text":"[basis template](templates/PROJECT_REFERENCE_FRAME_BASIS_TEMPLATE.md#sdlc-default-selection)
"},{"number":14,"text":"proposes it ready for adoption. An existing Product may select it through its
"},{"number":15,"text":"own authorized basis change; merely installing or finding it selects nothing.
"},{"number":16,"text":"Keep the Product's policy values, explicit gates and accepted alternatives.
"},{"number":17,"text":"No numeric priority cutoff, review ratio or additional gate is supplied here.
"},{"number":18,"text":"
"},{"number":19,"text":"Bind the exact claim, affected subject and basis, existing grant, carrier,
"},{"number":20,"text":"applicable obligations, actors and decision owner, evidence and stop conditions.
"},{"number":21,"text":"Use a sufficient direct Writer where the accepted configuration permits one.
"},{"number":22,"text":"Use coordination only for the material authority, dependency, capability or
"},{"number":23,"text":"attention boundary that requires it; adopt the optional Executive profile
"},{"number":24,"text":"separately. Sources: [ACTIVATION §1](ACTIVATION.md#1-the-step),
"},{"number":25,"text":"[TICKETS §5](TICKETS.md#5-from-carrier-to-execution) and
"},{"number":26,"text":"[EXECUTIVE_BASELINE §3](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#3-engagement-applicability).
"},{"number":27,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":65,"heading":"SDLC default frame guidance/Selected default flow","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/SDLC_DEFAULTS.md#SDLC%20default%20frame%20guidance%2FSelected%20default%20flow","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/SDLC_DEFAULTS.md","sha256":"211b0f2000f2f1dd26ccde8ecff7567017ba76d24b571626da6e33989babc71c","start_line":28,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/SDLC_DEFAULTS.md","lines":[{"number":28,"text":"## Selected default flow
"},{"number":29,"text":"
"},{"number":30,"text":"1. **Recover the work reference and construct bounded context.** Start from
"},{"number":31,"text":"   the exact admitted ticket, sprint entry or run contract. Bind its current
"},{"number":32,"text":"   question, subject/basis, grant, result/evidence routes and surviving
"},{"number":33,"text":"   obligations. Apply [work continuity](#work-reference-context-and-continuation)
"},{"number":34,"text":"   below before relying on a summary or prior result. A new session alone
"},{"number":35,"text":"   neither resets progress nor requires another ticket.
"},{"number":36,"text":"2. **Construct and perform incremental QA.** Check the admitted step against
"},{"number":37,"text":"   its requirement/design and the smallest adequate falsifier. State the
"},{"number":38,"text":"   observed predicate, subject, oracle, coverage and residuals. A local pass
"},{"number":39,"text":"   supports that bounded predicate; it supplies no unnamed Product acceptance,
"},{"number":40,"text":"   qualification or release claim. Preserve selected gates and mandatory
"},{"number":41,"text":"   conditions. Sources: [ASSURANCE](ASSURANCE.md),
"},{"number":42,"text":"   [EVALUATION §1](EVALUATION.md#1-claims) and
"},{"number":43,"text":"   [EVALUATION §5](EVALUATION.md#landing-closure-and-release).
"},{"number":44,"text":"3. **Triage a discrepancy before selecting a repair.** Use the causal routes
"},{"number":45,"text":"   below and retain plausible unresolved causes. Repeated failure, escalating
"},{"number":46,"text":"   repair cost or growing review context calls for bounded diagnosis of the
"},{"number":47,"text":"   frame and capability; it authorizes neither another code patch nor an
"},{"number":48,"text":"   upstream change. Source: [SPEC_METHOD intake](SPEC_METHOD.md#universal-intake-triage).
"},{"number":49,"text":"4. **Re-enter at the owning layer.** Record the change intent/class, affected
"},{"number":50,"text":"   Product boundary, first changed layer, downstream impact and whether release
"},{"number":51,"text":"   scope changes. Reuse the admitted ticket, sprint entry or run intake when
"},{"number":52,"text":"   it still covers the work. A changed requested outcome or territory needs
"},{"number":53,"text":"   owner re-entry and admission before dependent effects. Select `stdo-ticket`
"},{"number":54,"text":"   only when its durable-state need and effect grant hold; an unrelated finding
"},{"number":55,"text":"   does not silently enlarge this work. Sources: [change classes](SPEC_METHOD.md#change-classes),
"},{"number":56,"text":"   [TICKETS carrier selection](TICKETS.md#carrier-selection).
"},{"number":57,"text":"5. **Repair, verify and dispose the bounded result.** Reconcile the affected
"},{"number":58,"text":"   requirement, design, implementation, tests and displaced path; retain
"},{"number":59,"text":"   unaffected valid support. Apply the verification and stopping rules below.
"},{"number":60,"text":"   The authorized decision owner chooses `accept`, `local_repair`, `re_enter`
"},{"number":61,"text":"   or `reject` under [ACTIVATION §3](ACTIVATION.md#disposition). Preserve the
"},{"number":62,"text":"   result and lawful next action through the named durable surface before
"},{"number":63,"text":"   return. A new scope or missing authority returns to that owner before
"},{"number":64,"text":"   continuation.
"},{"number":65,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":106,"heading":"SDLC default frame guidance/Work reference, context and continuation","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/SDLC_DEFAULTS.md#SDLC%20default%20frame%20guidance%2FWork%20reference%2C%20context%20and%20continuation","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/SDLC_DEFAULTS.md","sha256":"6254c300a205eaa68b831b70a5c0a95a8915b69534410820b46137cbb0c8666f","start_line":66,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/SDLC_DEFAULTS.md","lines":[{"number":66,"text":"## Work reference, context and continuation
"},{"number":67,"text":"
"},{"number":68,"text":"The selected ticket is the enduring reference for its unit of work, under
"},{"number":69,"text":"[TICKETS records](TICKETS.md#ticket-records) and
"},{"number":70,"text":"[one-truth state](TICKETS.md#one-truth-state-projection-and-drift-refusal-up-009).
"},{"number":71,"text":"Retain a sufficient sprint or run carrier where
"},{"number":72,"text":"[carrier selection](TICKETS.md#carrier-selection) permits it. Work-state
"},{"number":73,"text":"authority, governing meaning and current material evidence remain distinct;
"},{"number":74,"text":"a context summary or index supplies none of them by itself.
"},{"number":75,"text":"
"},{"number":76,"text":"Acquire the deciding owners and current material subject needed by the next
"},{"number":77,"text":"bounded decision. An accessible qualified reference must preserve the
"},{"number":78,"text":"consumer's subject/basis, assessment standing, provenance, active obligations
"},{"number":79,"text":"and invalidators. If a derived surface is stale or insufficient, re-enter the
"},{"number":80,"text":"exact owning sections. Where the selected envelope declares context capacity,
"},{"number":81,"text":"record the required measurement, capacity and comparison before reading.
"},{"number":82,"text":"Without complete active inputs or a supported upper bound, complete-fit
"},{"number":83,"text":"judgment remains unresolved unless a measured excess falsifies it. Where no
"},{"number":84,"text":"capacity is declared, no measurement gate is added. Source:
"},{"number":85,"text":"[ACTIVATION §2](ACTIVATION.md#2-context-construction-under-an-envelope).
"},{"number":86,"text":"
"},{"number":87,"text":"Before return, a permitted Writer records the closed result, step-produced
"},{"number":88,"text":"facts needed later, evidence, unresolved work, original owner rulings and the
"},{"number":89,"text":"next authorized action or owner re-entry in the existing named durable
"},{"number":90,"text":"result/evidence surface. Keep references with the owning work. This projection
"},{"number":91,"text":"adds no second state ledger or per-tool logging requirement. An actor without those effects
"},{"number":92,"text":"returns to the permitted Writer; Executive still performs no file or Git
"},{"number":93,"text":"mutation in that role. Sources:
"},{"number":94,"text":"[ACTIVATION admission](ACTIVATION.md#admission),
"},{"number":95,"text":"[closed results](ACTIVATION.md#7-closed-result-and-reuse),
"},{"number":96,"text":"[TICKETS continuity](TICKETS.md#recorded-judgment-and-owner-ruling-continuity).
"},{"number":97,"text":"
"},{"number":98,"text":"Resume from current material state, correct a contrary retained account,
"},{"number":99,"text":"check exact applicability and invalidators, and reopen only affected support.
"},{"number":100,"text":"Reconcile uncertain external effects before a retry or dependent action;
"},{"number":101,"text":"unresolved completion remains unresolved. Handoff needs sufficient closed
"},{"number":102,"text":"results and references, not the prior actor's private conversation. Sources:
"},{"number":103,"text":"[ACTIVATION state and restart](ACTIVATION.md#5-work-state-and-restart),
"},{"number":104,"text":"[actor account](ACTIVATION.md#the-workspace-and-an-actors-account) and
"},{"number":105,"text":"[reuse](ACTIVATION.md#7-closed-result-and-reuse).
"},{"number":106,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":138,"heading":"SDLC default frame guidance/Causal triage","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/SDLC_DEFAULTS.md#SDLC%20default%20frame%20guidance%2FCausal%20triage","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/SDLC_DEFAULTS.md","sha256":"368d7417cc5028e041920bfeb399397f8774a0884723beea8794567817d3eee3","start_line":107,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/SDLC_DEFAULTS.md","lines":[{"number":107,"text":"## Causal triage
"},{"number":108,"text":"
"},{"number":109,"text":"The four causes are owned by
"},{"number":110,"text":"[ACTIVATION feedback and diagnosis](ACTIVATION.md#construction-relation) and
"},{"number":111,"text":"applied by [SPEC_METHOD intake](SPEC_METHOD.md#universal-intake-triage).
"},{"number":112,"text":"Use evidence that distinguishes causes over the same exact subject and basis:
"},{"number":113,"text":"
"},{"number":114,"text":"| Supported cause | Lawful next action |
"},{"number":115,"text":"|---|---|
"},{"number":116,"text":"| Defective realisation under adequate unchanged law | Repair the realised surface within its grant; assert and verify no upstream drift. |
"},{"number":117,"text":"| Inadequate governing requirement or design | Return to the first inadequate owner; admit its changed truth, then derive affected downstream work and evidence. A failed candidate alone does not establish this cause. |
"},{"number":118,"text":"| Inaccurate predictive model | Return to the model's owner, identify the failed prediction and supported replacement/intervention, then re-evaluate the dependent claims. Do not relabel an outcome mismatch as a code defect without evidence. |
"},{"number":119,"text":"| Insufficient observation | Acquire the missing admissible observation through its authorized route, or retain `indeterminate` and withhold the dependent claim. Repetition of the same uninformative check supplies no missing evidence. |
"},{"number":120,"text":"
"},{"number":121,"text":"If diagnosis or repair cannot fit the current capability/complexity envelope,
"},{"number":122,"text":"apply [REFERENCE_FRAME diagnostic order](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#diagnostic-order):
"},{"number":123,"text":"check the activated family, exact subject/basis, actor capability and available
"},{"number":124,"text":"evidence before missing variables, joins, families or another frame. Then
"},{"number":125,"text":"revise, decompose or request the capable evaluation through its owner. State
"},{"number":126,"text":"the missing relation/capability, next discriminating evidence and bounded
"},{"number":127,"text":"return condition. This route changes no requirement merely to make work pass.
"},{"number":128,"text":"
"},{"number":129,"text":"Keep technical severity and causal confidence separate from Product priority,
"},{"number":130,"text":"promotion effect and disposition. The Reviewer supplies supported triage and
"},{"number":131,"text":"explicit uncertainty; the Product decision owner decides its consequence under
"},{"number":132,"text":"the actual mandate. Under an adopted Executive profile that owner is the
"},{"number":133,"text":"Executive. Use the selected scale and preserve historical grades; severity
"},{"number":134,"text":"does not itself grant or forbid an operation. Sources:
"},{"number":135,"text":"[EVALUATION results](EVALUATION.md#result-and-triage-projection),
"},{"number":136,"text":"[blocking](EVALUATION.md#when-a-finding-blocks-promotion) and
"},{"number":137,"text":"[Executive triage](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#technical-triage-severity-priority-and-boundary-effect).
"},{"number":138,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":181,"heading":"SDLC default frame guidance/Verification and stopping","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/SDLC_DEFAULTS.md#SDLC%20default%20frame%20guidance%2FVerification%20and%20stopping","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/SDLC_DEFAULTS.md","sha256":"89fb33e1f97ab44ed4c96e73f5061055629215cfe43763a43a7bd28880e03c6d","start_line":139,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/SDLC_DEFAULTS.md","lines":[{"number":139,"text":"## Verification and stopping
"},{"number":140,"text":"
"},{"number":141,"text":"Bind a review to one exact claim, subject, coverage population, exclusions,
"},{"number":142,"text":"capability and time/attention envelope. A budget cannot shrink a declared
"},{"number":143,"text":"claim or make missing coverage satisfied. Return its finite findings and
"},{"number":144,"text":"residuals; do not keep expanding the review until no possible issue remains.
"},{"number":145,"text":"Sources: [EVALUATION assessment](EVALUATION.md#3-independent-assessment),
"},{"number":146,"text":"[REFERENCE_FRAME closure](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-012-closed-results).
"},{"number":147,"text":"
"},{"number":148,"text":"Where the accepted basis selects
"},{"number":149,"text":"[EXECUTIVE_BASELINE QA cadence](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#qa-cadence-and-repair-rechecks),
"},{"number":150,"text":"a mechanically decidable repair may close on a reproduction failing before
"},{"number":151,"text":"and passing after, its declared suite and the other applicable conditions.
"},{"number":152,"text":"Use an independent bounded recheck when the governing boundary requires or
"},{"number":153,"text":"claims independence, the repair concerns a hard stop or material capture
"},{"number":154,"text":"fidelity, there is no reproducing test, or selected review left declared
"},{"number":155,"text":"coverage incomplete. Required independence follows
"},{"number":156,"text":"[EVALUATION §3](EVALUATION.md#3-independent-assessment); another actor name
"},{"number":157,"text":"or a fresh context does not establish it. Other adopted configurations retain
"},{"number":158,"text":"their own recheck conditions. Tests never impersonate required assessment.
"},{"number":159,"text":"
"},{"number":160,"text":"Close the repair/work claim when its applicable conjunction is satisfied and
"},{"number":161,"text":"no active non-closure condition remains; otherwise return the precise missing
"},{"number":162,"text":"condition, owner and re-entry. Stop at the activation's return boundary.
"},{"number":163,"text":"Authorized landing, work closure and named acceptance/release keep their
"},{"number":164,"text":"separate conditions. A later material finding is new input to a new bounded
"},{"number":165,"text":"disposition, not standing permission to reopen every repair or broaden review.
"},{"number":166,"text":"An adjacent observation outside the claim is retained for its lawful owner.
"},{"number":167,"text":"Sources: [TICKETS closure](TICKETS.md#condition-based-closure-and-reuse),
"},{"number":168,"text":"[QA cadence](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#qa-cadence-and-repair-rechecks).
"},{"number":169,"text":"
"},{"number":170,"text":"Before reuse, check exact question, subject/basis, support and invalidators.
"},{"number":171,"text":"Re-evaluate affected claims after changed material inputs, basis or capability;
"},{"number":172,"text":"retain demonstrably independent valid evidence. Required independent judgment
"},{"number":173,"text":"is not replaced by reused constructor judgment. A material frame revision
"},{"number":174,"text":"reopens every result bound to its old revision until applicability is checked.
"},{"number":175,"text":"Sources: [ACTIVATION reuse](ACTIVATION.md#7-closed-result-and-reuse),
"},{"number":176,"text":"[REFERENCE_FRAME revision](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#revision-actions),
"},{"number":177,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS change impact](FOUNDATIONS.md#change-impact-and-evidence-reuse).
"},{"number":178,"text":"
"},{"number":179,"text":"[Worked cases](examples/SDLC_DEFAULTS.md) illustrate these routes. Their
"},{"number":180,"text":"expected outcomes explain the projection; they are not evidence of actual use
"},{"number":181,"text":"or qualification of an actor, host or release.
"}]},{"end_line":26,"heading":"TICKETS","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"851f0cb40cd11e8d95a16faac69587d1586d2df68fce7118ada560b168189473","start_line":1,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":1,"text":"# TICKETS
"},{"number":2,"text":"
"},{"number":3,"text":"Tier 2. Owns the work carriers of the method: goals, tickets, sprints,
"},{"number":4,"text":"comments and execution contracts as one model; the default layout and the
"},{"number":5,"text":"bindings that locate the carriers; the sprint rules; the ticket rules,
"},{"number":6,"text":"including triage-first intake, the change class the ticket records and the
"},{"number":7,"text":"upward propagation check; the selection of the smallest lawful carrier for
"},{"number":8,"text":"a piece of work and the carrier side of execution-contract admission; the
"},{"number":9,"text":"separation of execution from verification authority; the continuity of
"},{"number":10,"text":"recorded judgment and owner rulings; condition-based closure and reuse;
"},{"number":11,"text":"test case authority; the implementation-migration ticket category with its
"},{"number":12,"text":"declaration, checklist and review rules; one-truth state projection; the
"},{"number":13,"text":"recommended ticket and sprint shape; the operating mode. It is realised
"},{"number":14,"text":"from [FOUNDATIONS](FOUNDATIONS.md), [ACTIVATION](ACTIVATION.md) and
"},{"number":15,"text":"[EVALUATION](EVALUATION.md) and is the T area named by
"},{"number":16,"text":"[SPEC_METHOD §1](SPEC_METHOD.md#method-identity): nothing here is
"},{"number":17,"text":"foundational, every clause names the principle that requires it (P0 to P6,
"},{"number":18,"text":"FOUNDATIONS §3), and each mechanism could be realised differently under the
"},{"number":19,"text":"same principles. The change classes a ticket records are
"},{"number":20,"text":"[SPEC_METHOD §4](SPEC_METHOD.md#change-classes), which is the triage target
"},{"number":21,"text":"of every clause here that names a class; the step side of admission is
"},{"number":22,"text":"[ACTIVATION §1](ACTIVATION.md#admission); the generic law of claims,
"},{"number":23,"text":"independent assessment and acceptance is EVALUATION §1, §3 and §5; the
"},{"number":24,"text":"testing law is ASSURANCE. This member defines none of those twice. Its
"},{"number":25,"text":"family table (F13) opens §5.
"},{"number":26,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":28,"heading":"TICKETS/1. Work carriers","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F1.%20Work%20carriers","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"a0451b5b44e91cdea9e1234b8f9e82d52867e1210ab12ed045835d2b9572c0a3","start_line":27,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":27,"text":"## 1.
