Work carriers/Goals","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F1.%20Work%20carriers%2FGoals","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"c8ae39729971c06153cecf2da2066e65de2ef74c9c6402c2f5c0531ad7faf68a","start_line":29,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":29,"text":"### Goals
"},{"number":30,"text":"
"},{"number":31,"text":"The product definition's `ticketing.goals` binding locates the current epic
"},{"number":32,"text":"layer; `GOALS.md` is the default file (PRODUCT_DEFINITION §1). Goals are
"},{"number":33,"text":"broader than one ticket, narrower and more current than the intent surface,
"},{"number":34,"text":"and the place to state the active work wave and what matters now. Goals are
"},{"number":35,"text":"not the durable unit of execution tracking (P2, P3).
"},{"number":36,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":44,"heading":"TICKETS/1. Work carriers/Ticket records","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F1.%20Work%20carriers%2FTicket%20records","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"3aa3e0f935cd4290f1d96d90578065a1333d5540a510822113381fc372e465b4","start_line":37,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":37,"text":"### Ticket records
"},{"number":38,"text":"
"},{"number":39,"text":"Tickets are the enduring work records. Each ticket is one durable record,
"},{"number":40,"text":"one markdown file being the default carrier; the source of truth for that
"},{"number":41,"text":"unit of work; durable across sessions; and typed, so that bugs and features
"},{"number":42,"text":"share one system. A ticket is used when work needs independent durable
"},{"number":43,"text":"identity: feature work, bug tracking, spikes and chores (P3, P4b).
"},{"number":44,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":63,"heading":"TICKETS/1. Work carriers/Sprints","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F1.%20Work%20carriers%2FSprints","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"a36054307ba0e05eece8b05e96e3af199b8eb23fd755f9b0b5110277bf8e2f78","start_line":45,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":45,"text":"### Sprints
"},{"number":46,"text":"
"},{"number":47,"text":"Sprints are bounded execution batches. Each sprint is one manifest under
"},{"number":48,"text":"the product definition's optional `ticketing.sprints.root` binding,
"},{"number":49,"text":"`.ai-workspace/sprints/` being the default; a control surface for a bounded
"},{"number":50,"text":"body of work; a place to batch repeated authority references, closure law,
"},{"number":51,"text":"evidence expectations and deferred local compliance debt; and closed by an
"},{"number":52,"text":"explicit sprint-close review. Sprints are not constitutional authority: they
"},{"number":53,"text":"operate under SPEC_METHOD and the project surfaces they cite
"},{"number":54,"text":"([SPEC_METHOD §4](SPEC_METHOD.md#sprint-execution-boundary) states the
"},{"number":55,"text":"sprint boundary; this member states the mechanics) (P2, P6).
"},{"number":56,"text":"
"},{"number":57,"text":"A sprint may contain durable tickets, manifest-local iteration entries, or
"},{"number":58,"text":"both. Tickets carry work items that need durable identity across sessions;
"},{"number":59,"text":"manifest-local iteration entries carry small changes whose only independent
"},{"number":60,"text":"value is traceability inside the sprint. The sprint is the batch authority;
"},{"number":61,"text":"it does not erase the need for paydown tickets when close review finds debt
"},{"number":62,"text":"that must survive past the sprint (P2, P4b).
"},{"number":63,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":75,"heading":"TICKETS/1. Work carriers/Comments","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F1.%20Work%20carriers%2FComments","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"357389984abe6ab4f29a6ff95804f9bb71fe047b1ec7269f0894d95ca6ed4cd3","start_line":64,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":64,"text":"### Comments
"},{"number":65,"text":"
"},{"number":66,"text":"The product definition's `ticketing.comments.root` binding is the message
"},{"number":67,"text":"board; `.ai-workspace/comments/` is the default. Comments are for publishing
"},{"number":68,"text":"ideas, strategy notes, reviews, handoffs, closure summaries, and decisions
"},{"number":69,"text":"with their reasoning. Comments are not task status authority. A comment
"},{"number":70,"text":"is a post of [POSTING_GUIDE](POSTING_GUIDE.md), which states what it
"},{"number":71,"text":"carries, its structure and its discussion state. A decision recorded in a
"},{"number":72,"text":"comment takes its authority from the surface that owns the decision, once
"},{"number":73,"text":"it is adopted there ([POSTING_GUIDE §9](POSTING_GUIDE.md#9-ratification)),
"},{"number":74,"text":"and has none of its own (P6, P3).
"},{"number":75,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":100,"heading":"TICKETS/1. Work carriers/Execution contracts","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F1.%20Work%20carriers%2FExecution%20contracts","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"4b669e9d653755d91002e307a2c8d2f5ed68c235da6ba26bd13fa217c431bb8e","start_line":76,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":76,"text":"### Execution contracts
"},{"number":77,"text":"
"},{"number":78,"text":"Tickets are durable work authority. An execution contract is the run-scoped
"},{"number":79,"text":"admitted work surface derived from a ticket, from a sprint manifest plus an
"},{"number":80,"text":"included ticket or iteration entry, or drafted during intake when no durable
"},{"number":81,"text":"or sprint-local work identity is required. The three lifetimes differ: a
"},{"number":82,"text":"ticket survives sessions and work waves; a sprint survives one bounded
"},{"number":83,"text":"execution batch and its close review; an execution contract is the current
"},{"number":84,"text":"admitted execution function for one run. Execution contracts are not a
"},{"number":85,"text":"rival backlog or a second planning surface (P0, P3).
"},{"number":86,"text":"
"},{"number":87,"text":"They exist so that the system can classify the work before execution; admit
"},{"number":88,"text":"or reject the drafted classification against deterministic criteria; record
"},{"number":89,"text":"the admitted execution basis on the selected durable work carrier, including
"},{"number":90,"text":"an event log where the execution binding requires one; assemble prompts
"},{"number":91,"text":"from admitted work law instead of from raw user phrasing; and evaluate
"},{"number":92,"text":"closure against the same admitted criteria. The intended loop: work
"},{"number":93,"text":"arrives; the system selects the smallest lawful work carrier for its
"},{"number":94,"text":"required lifetime (§5); an agent drafts one run-scoped execution contract
"},{"number":95,"text":"from that carrier; the system validates and admits or rejects the contract
"},{"number":96,"text":"(ACTIVATION §1, Admission); execution may proceed in the same invocation
"},{"number":97,"text":"under the admitted contract; closure is checked against that same contract;
"},{"number":98,"text":"the resulting state still flows through normal proof, gap analysis and
"},{"number":99,"text":"repricing (P6, P2).
"},{"number":100,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":117,"heading":"TICKETS/1. Work carriers/Milestones and phase-scoped truth (UP-006)","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F1.%20Work%20carriers%2FMilestones%20and%20phase-scoped%20truth%20%28UP-006%29","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"0fc924c643f8d1cc170514d5261425710bafab1248e424cdadd9d5e5cbc15ab6","start_line":101,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":101,"text":"### Milestones and phase-scoped truth (UP-006)
"},{"number":102,"text":"
"},{"number":103,"text":"A ticket may contain several closure-bearing milestones without becoming
"},{"number":104,"text":"several tickets. Each milestone has stable identity, a bounded claim,
"},{"number":105,"text":"relevant dependencies, current state, required evidence, and an explicit
"},{"number":106,"text":"relation to ticket closure (P3).
"},{"number":107,"text":"
"},{"number":108,"text":"Milestone acceptance proves only its declared claim. Accepted design does
"},{"number":109,"text":"not satisfy implementation, installed proof, qualification or release.
"},{"number":110,"text":"Ticket completion requires every closure-bearing milestone to be accepted;
"},{"number":111,"text":"optional or deferred work requires an explicit disposition and owner. Each
"},{"number":112,"text":"milestone is a work claim under §7 Condition-based closure and reuse, so
"},{"number":113,"text":"its acceptance follows that condition for its own declared claim, and a
"},{"number":114,"text":"ticket is complete only when the condition holds for each of them.
"},{"number":115,"text":"Commentary and generated summaries cannot mutate milestone or ticket truth
"},{"number":116,"text":"(P6, P4b).
"},{"number":117,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":119,"heading":"TICKETS/2. Layout and authority","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F2.%20Layout%20and%20authority","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"49c84a02bc7fb5e8b80f3f8e9427e7a579e79fafbda7fcf0da1d2760a29585a9","start_line":118,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":118,"text":"## 2. Layout and authority
"},{"number":119,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":147,"heading":"TICKETS/2. Layout and authority/Default layout","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F2.%20Layout%20and%20authority%2FDefault%20layout","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"ae5c5200138f4fc49340a76d7a9fce18c22fe999d20cd7f88a7b702c501ca0f5","start_line":120,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":120,"text":"### Default layout
"},{"number":121,"text":"
"},{"number":122,"text":"The starter file layout (P2, P3):
"},{"number":123,"text":"
"},{"number":124,"text":"```text
"},{"number":125,"text":"stdo_default.json
"},{"number":126,"text":"
"},{"number":127,"text":"specification/
"},{"number":128,"text":"├── GOALS.md
"},{"number":129,"text":"
"},{"number":130,"text":".ai-workspace/
"},{"number":131,"text":"├── sprints/
"},{"number":132,"text":"├── tickets/
"},{"number":133,"text":"│   ├── backlog/
"},{"number":134,"text":"│   ├── active/
"},{"number":135,"text":"│   └── completed/
"},{"number":136,"text":"└── comments/
"},{"number":137,"text":"    └── <agent-id>/
"},{"number":138,"text":"```
"},{"number":139,"text":"
"},{"number":140,"text":"The applicable product definition resolves POSTING_GUIDE and this member
"},{"number":141,"text":"from its exact shared installed basis (PRODUCT_DEFINITION §4); their
"},{"number":142,"text":"absence from the project tree is not absence from the governing method. A
"},{"number":143,"text":"conforming `stdo_<label>.json` definition may bind the same ticket, comment
"},{"number":144,"text":"and sprint roles to existing directories, repository resources, tracker
"},{"number":145,"text":"collections, API endpoints or product-scoped queries without restructuring
"},{"number":146,"text":"the project (PRODUCT_DEFINITION §1).
"},{"number":147,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":164,"heading":"TICKETS/2. Layout and authority/Bindings and projections","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F2.%20Layout%20and%20authority%2FBindings%20and%20projections","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"6e6d4157e444f7d6fe6d852ce16cc6cc0b3a144b11bb643a079801e77a69acc3","start_line":148,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":148,"text":"### Bindings and projections
"},{"number":149,"text":"
"},{"number":150,"text":"The bindings (P6, P3): `ticketing.goals` locates the epic
"},{"number":151,"text":"layer; `ticketing.sprints.root`, when present, is the bounded
"},{"number":152,"text":"execution-batch and sprint-close review layer;
"},{"number":153,"text":"`ticketing.tickets.lanes.backlog`, `.active` and `.completed` locate the
"},{"number":154,"text":"ticket authority; `ticketing.comments.root` locates the discussion and
"},{"number":155,"text":"publication layer. The paths of the default layout are the bindings
"},{"number":156,"text":"supplied by `stdo_default.json`. The definition locates these carriers and
"},{"number":157,"text":"does not own their ticket or comment content.
"},{"number":158,"text":"
"},{"number":159,"text":"There is no separate mandatory `ACTIVE_TASKS.md` in this model. A project
"},{"number":160,"text":"that wants a board view may generate one from the bound ticket authority;
"},{"number":161,"text":"that board is a projection only and does not become the source of truth
"},{"number":162,"text":"unless the product definition explicitly rebinds the ticket authority to
"},{"number":163,"text":"that carrier and no rival remains (§7).
"},{"number":164,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":178,"heading":"TICKETS/2. Layout and authority/Carrier substitution","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F2.%20Layout%20and%20authority%2FCarrier%20substitution","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"9c49c5756f266df059aa23a1c64363aaf3c724b43c920e1fee8edd1fc5c8f1d1","start_line":165,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":165,"text":"### Carrier substitution
"},{"number":166,"text":"
"},{"number":167,"text":"The durable local-file model is the default and remains valid whenever it
"},{"number":168,"text":"is selected. Another carrier is not required to reproduce its folders, but
"},{"number":169,"text":"it preserves the same ticket authority and refusal laws (§3 and §4, one
"},{"number":170,"text":"durable record). Growth the model admits includes a generated active board,
"},{"number":171,"text":"ticket dependency checks, links from tickets to scenario, requirement or
"},{"number":172,"text":"ADR surfaces, external sync with a real ticketing system, and message-board
"},{"number":173,"text":"integration through a standard tool-protocol capability. Under the bindings
"},{"number":174,"text":"above, a generated board is a projection, and a tracker that holds tickets
"},{"number":175,"text":"is lawful only as an explicit rebinding of the ticket authority by the
"},{"number":176,"text":"product definition with no rival surface remaining, so neither growth
"},{"number":177,"text":"changes the authority or refusal laws (P2, P6).
"},{"number":178,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":180,"heading":"TICKETS/3. Sprint rules","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F3.%20Sprint%20rules","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"5ed16b4facbb89dbc2f67bf5522689bbdddaeb337165f876fef3e963e6794c36","start_line":179,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":179,"text":"## 3. "},{"number":182,"text":"
"},{"number":183,"text":"Each sprint has one durable manifest record; the default carrier is one
"},{"number":184,"text":"markdown file. Another bound carrier preserves the same identity, required
"},{"number":185,"text":"fields, history, closure law and one-truth relation (P3, P4b). For a local file, the filename should
"},{"number":186,"text":"carry a stable id and a short slug. Recommended local-file naming:
"},{"number":187,"text":"`SPRINT-2026-04-30-process-navigator.md` and
"},{"number":188,"text":"`SPRINT-2026-05-12-dashboard-density.md`.
"},{"number":189,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":208,"heading":"TICKETS/3. Sprint rules/Manifest fields","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F3.%20Sprint%20rules%2FManifest%20fields","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"b28e0e61f91d604a15ace854bcbf49ad13f2eff5d5aebf2069d65eb299530b28","start_line":190,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":190,"text":"### Manifest fields
"},{"number":191,"text":"
"},{"number":192,"text":"Each sprint manifest records at least `id`, `title`, `status`, `goal`,
"},{"number":193,"text":"`opened_at`, `updated_at`, `authority_refs`, `scope`, `excluded_boundaries`,
"},{"number":194,"text":"`expected_change_classes`, `included_tickets` or `iterations`,
"},{"number":195,"text":"`closure_trigger`, `closure_law`, `proof_surface`, `deferred_compliance`,
"},{"number":196,"text":"`non_closure_conditions` and `paydown_policy` (P4b, P2).
"},{"number":197,"text":"
"},{"number":198,"text":"`authority_refs` names the upstream goals, intent, product, requirement,
"},{"number":199,"text":"design or other governing surfaces the sprint operates under.
"},{"number":200,"text":"`excluded_boundaries` names what the sprint is not allowed to change;
"},{"number":201,"text":"typical exclusions are product truth, data contracts, runtime semantics,
"},{"number":202,"text":"governance and closure law, public carrier shape and release criteria.
"},{"number":203,"text":"`deferred_compliance` names any local proof, review, accessibility,
"},{"number":204,"text":"screenshot, walkthrough, test, design wording or trace cleanup
"},{"number":205,"text":"intentionally deferred until sprint close. `paydown_policy` states how
"},{"number":206,"text":"deferred debt becomes accepted, ticketed, repriced or removed during close
"},{"number":207,"text":"review (P6).
"},{"number":208,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":219,"heading":"TICKETS/3. Sprint rules/Sprint status","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F3.%20Sprint%20rules%2FSprint%20status","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"494e312105699ebc62b6e3d77bb9ebd07b48b7cbd0a8ad9d8f1c457d0a32a5e0","start_line":209,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":209,"text":"### Sprint status
"},{"number":210,"text":"
"},{"number":211,"text":"The minimum sprint status model is `active`, `closing`, `closed` and
"},{"number":212,"text":"`superseded` (P5, P3). `active`: iteration is admitted
"},{"number":213,"text":"inside the sprint boundary. `closing`: new iteration is frozen while close
"},{"number":214,"text":"review and paydown classification run. `closed`: close review finished and
"},{"number":215,"text":"all remaining debt is accepted, ticketed, repriced or removed.
"},{"number":216,"text":"`superseded`: the sprint boundary was wrong and a new authority surface,
"},{"number":217,"text":"sprint or ticket set replaced it. A project may add `planned` or
"},{"number":218,"text":"`cancelled`; those states do not replace close review.
"},{"number":219,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":233,"heading":"TICKETS/3. Sprint rules/Sprint admission","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F3.%20Sprint%20rules%2FSprint%20admission","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"2b66fff59a421052a64fd25213f34190f2794825f9388f50740c2bc35c5f1aca","start_line":220,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":220,"text":"### Sprint admission
"},{"number":221,"text":"
"},{"number":222,"text":"A sprint may admit work only when the manifest makes the boundary
"},{"number":223,"text":"reviewable. Admission requires a bounded scope, cited authority, expected
"},{"number":224,"text":"change classes, explicit excluded boundaries, a closure law, non-closure
"},{"number":225,"text":"conditions, and a paydown policy for deferred compliance (P6, P2).
"},{"number":226,"text":"
"},{"number":227,"text":"The sprint may batch repeated closure criteria that would otherwise be
"},{"number":228,"text":"copied into every included ticket. It may not batch away intake triage:
"},{"number":229,"text":"substantive included tickets still record their lawful `change_class` and
"},{"number":230,"text":"`re_entry_point` (§4, Triage metadata). Manifest-local iteration entries
"},{"number":231,"text":"may rely on the sprint's declared class only while they remain inside the
"},{"number":232,"text":"sprint scope and excluded boundaries (P4b).
"},{"number":233,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":260,"heading":"TICKETS/3. Sprint rules/Compliance escrow","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F3.%20Sprint%20rules%2FCompliance%20escrow","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"7d8c06737f18bf38209d33c69285fe8c3791af3b3a2e8263ccbac32b63cfdec4","start_line":234,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":234,"text":"### Compliance escrow
"},{"number":235,"text":"
"},{"number":236,"text":"A sprint may defer local compliance proof only when the manifest names the
"},{"number":237,"text":"deferred proof or cleanup class; the debt is local to the sprint's admitted
"},{"number":238,"text":"surface; the expected correction cost is lower than the per-change proof
"},{"number":239,"text":"cost; the sprint is short enough that the debt remains reviewable; and the
"},{"number":240,"text":"close review classifies and pays down the debt. Deferred compliance is not
"},{"number":241,"text":"silent debt: it is escrow held by the sprint, and
"},{"number":242,"text":"[SPEC_METHOD §4](SPEC_METHOD.md#sprint-execution-boundary) states that
"},{"number":243,"text":"escrow satisfies no method, release or product closure until paid down,
"},{"number":244,"text":"accepted or repriced (P2, P4b, P6).
"},{"number":245,"text":"
"},{"number":246,"text":"The following may be eligible for escrow when the governing method allows
"},{"number":247,"text":"it: screenshots or
"},{"number":248,"text":"walkthrough capture; visual review; accessibility cleanup; replay proof for
"},{"number":249,"text":"product-meaningful user-interface interactions; design wording cleanup; trace cleanup;
"},{"number":250,"text":"local realisation cleanup. The following may not be hidden in escrow: new
"},{"number":251,"text":"product truth; new
"},{"number":252,"text":"or changed data contracts; new runtime, governance, closure, provenance or
"},{"number":253,"text":"evidence semantics; missing constructive carriers; changed public
"},{"number":254,"text":"published-function or public carrier contracts; law-changing work that
"},{"number":255,"text":"needs `goal_reprice`, `intent_reprice`, `product_reprice`,
"},{"number":256,"text":"`requirement_reprice` or `design_reframe`. If one of those appears during
"},{"number":257,"text":"the sprint, the sprint records the finding and the work exits the sprint
"},{"number":258,"text":"path through a standalone ticket, a repricing action or sprint supersession
"},{"number":259,"text":"(P6).
"},{"number":260,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":324,"heading":"TICKETS/3. Sprint rules/Close review","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F3.%20Sprint%20rules%2FClose%20review","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"33c990decea01bb9b815dc2d50cfc53fc5f7e4c897865328740e241df5dc0e87","start_line":261,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":261,"text":"### Close review
"},{"number":262,"text":"
"},{"number":263,"text":"Sprint close begins by moving the manifest to `status: closing`. While
"},{"number":264,"text":"closing: new iteration inside that sprint is frozen; every included ticket
"},{"number":265,"text":"or iteration entry is reviewed against the manifest; accumulated evidence
"},{"number":266,"text":"is checked for durability; changed surfaces are walked against cited
"},{"number":267,"text":"authority; deferred compliance is classified; paydown tickets are opened
"},{"number":268,"text":"where debt must survive past the close review (P6, P4b).
"},{"number":269,"text":"
"},{"number":270,"text":"Each reviewed item is classified as one of `accepted` (compliant under the
"},{"number":271,"text":"sprint authority), `local_paydown` (local debt remains and is captured by a
"},{"number":272,"text":"paydown ticket), `design_reframe` (the work needs design repricing),
"},{"number":273,"text":"`requirement_reprice` (the work needs requirement repricing),
"},{"number":274,"text":"`product_reprice` (the work changes product definition) or `remove` (the
"},{"number":275,"text":"work should be backed out or kept out of closure) (P5). A sprint may move to
"},{"number":276,"text":"`closed` only when every item and every debt entry is classified and the
"},{"number":277,"text":"resulting paydown or repricing work is durable. Sprint close can accept
"},{"number":278,"text":"local paydown debt only when the governing method allows that debt to
"},{"number":279,"text":"survive as explicit follow-up; it cannot accept hidden authority drift
"},{"number":280,"text":"(P6).
"},{"number":281,"text":"
"},{"number":282,"text":"Close classifications and the core. A close classification is the
"},{"number":283,"text":"outcome of close review for one reviewed item, made against the sprint
"},{"number":284,"text":"authority the manifest cites; the close review must classify, under that
"},{"number":285,"text":"authority. The classification uses
"},{"number":286,"text":"[ACTIVATION §3 Disposition](ACTIVATION.md#disposition) only for its
"},{"number":287,"text":"result mapping: the candidate is the reviewed item, its boundary is the
"},{"number":288,"text":"sprint's close under the cited authority, and the classification consumes
"},{"number":289,"text":"the core results of the item's review and stays separate from them, as
"},{"number":290,"text":"acceptance stays separate from assessment
"},{"number":291,"text":"([FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results)). Each classification
"},{"number":292,"text":"takes exactly one core value, for the predicate "the reviewed item is
"},{"number":293,"text":"accepted as compliant under the sprint authority", and the table names
"},{"number":294,"text":"the disposition whose condition it matches, where one does (P5, P6):
"},{"number":295,"text":"
"},{"number":296,"text":"| Classification | Matching disposition | Core value | Ground, and how it narrows or differs from the disposition's condition |
"},{"number":297,"text":"|---|---|---|---|
"},{"number":298,"text":"| `accepted` | `accept` | satisfied | the item is compliant under the sprint authority |
"},{"number":299,"text":"| `local_paydown` | `local_repair` | falsified | local debt remains and is captured by a paydown ticket; the debt is the counterexample. The governing relation stays coherent, because an item whose governing authority must change takes a repricing classification instead. It differs from `local_repair` in where the repair is carried: by the paydown ticket, which survives the close where the method allows that debt to survive |
"},{"number":300,"text":"| `design_reframe` | `re_enter` | invalid_basis | the accepted design that governs the item must change, so the authority the sprint cites cannot support accepting it |
"},{"number":301,"text":"| `requirement_reprice` | `re_enter` | invalid_basis | a governing requirement must change, with the same consequence |
"},{"number":302,"text":"| `product_reprice` | `re_enter` | invalid_basis | the work changes the product definition, which the authority the sprint cites cannot support |
"},{"number":303,"text":"| `remove` | none | falsified | the work is backed out or kept out of closure; the reason for removal is the counterexample. No disposition of ACTIVATION §3 has this condition, because removal does not require a violated governing relation or a competing truth path |
"},{"number":304,"text":"
"},{"number":305,"text":"The layer that `design_reframe`, `requirement_reprice` and
"},{"number":306,"text":"`product_reprice` name is a declared fact, not a further result: it is
"},{"number":307,"text":"the change class of [SPEC_METHOD §4](SPEC_METHOD.md#change-classes) at
"},{"number":308,"text":"which the work re-enters, and it travels with the core value as the
"},{"number":309,"text":"domain outcome (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results, Recording). The outcome of a
"},{"number":310,"text":"debt entry, accepted, ticketed, repriced or removed (Sprint status,
"},{"number":311,"text":"`closed`), is likewise classified by the close review and mapped at the
"},{"number":312,"text":"close boundary, for the predicate "the debt entry is accepted under the
"},{"number":313,"text":"sprint authority": accepted matches `accept` (`satisfied`), ticketed
"},{"number":314,"text":"matches `local_repair` (`falsified`), removed takes `falsified` with no
"},{"number":315,"text":"matching disposition, and repriced matches `re_enter`
"},{"number":316,"text":"(`invalid_basis`), on the grounds of `accepted`, `local_paydown`,
"},{"number":317,"text":"`remove` and the repricing classifications respectively. The mappings
"},{"number":318,"text":"add no disposition and no core value. The condition for `closed`
"},{"number":319,"text":"above requires an outcome for every item and debt entry, not a
"},{"number":320,"text":"`satisfied` one. 
"},{"number":321,"text":"Purpose and material relation: a consumer that combines close outcomes
"},{"number":322,"text":"with other results cannot read remaining debt, needed repricing or
"},{"number":323,"text":"removal as compliance (P5, P6).
"},{"number":324,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":326,"heading":"TICKETS/4. Ticket rules","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F4.%20Ticket%20rules","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"af393b4c1fc0663d81edef1bbce14e16f15ce356445dd685f60ba816d5c6a7b5","start_line":325,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":325,"text":"## 4. Ticket rules
"},{"number":326,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":339,"heading":"TICKETS/4. Ticket rules/One durable record per ticket","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F4.%20Ticket%20rules%2FOne%20durable%20record%20per%20ticket","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"ec86e51e8af1f7a46ecd388a187e38a27df14dde5bc3634b18f459486cac0427","start_line":327,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":327,"text":"### One durable record per ticket
"},{"number":328,"text":"
"},{"number":329,"text":"Each ticket has one durable authoritative record; the default carrier is
"},{"number":330,"text":"one markdown file. A repository or external tracker carrier is lawful only
"},{"number":331,"text":"when it preserves the required ticket contract, history, state transition,
"},{"number":332,"text":"stable identity, searchability and closure semantics without a co-equal
"},{"number":333,"text":"local copy (P3, P4b). For a local
"},{"number":334,"text":"file, the filename should carry a stable id and a short slug. Recommended
"},{"number":335,"text":"local-file naming:
"},{"number":336,"text":"`T-001-add-product-layer.md`, `B-002-fix-reset-manifest-id.md`,
"},{"number":337,"text":"`S-003-evaluate-integration-capability.md`,
"},{"number":338,"text":"`C-004-clean-up-trace-tags.md`.
"},{"number":339,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":386,"heading":"TICKETS/4. Ticket rules/Multi-build-tenant independence","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F4.%20Ticket%20rules%2FMulti-build-tenant%20independence","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"16e37dffd298e0a19ec78869656b90150ca21b3bf6e0577d6e6b4235660daa55","start_line":340,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":340,"text":"### Multi-build-tenant independence
"},{"number":341,"text":"
"},{"number":342,"text":"This clause consumes the build-tenancy bounded context
"},{"number":343,"text":"`urn:stdo:bounded-context:build-tenancy` declared by PRODUCT_DEFINITION §8.
"},{"number":344,"text":"This member owns the multi-build-tenant work-item and ticket-lifecycle
"},{"number":345,"text":"relation inside that context; it does not redefine build-tenant identity or
"},{"number":346,"text":"realisation meaning (P3, P1).
"},{"number":347,"text":"
"},{"number":348,"text":"A multi-build-tenant work item is one admitted upstream work item with more
"},{"number":349,"text":"than one build-tenant execution line. The upstream authority and each
"},{"number":350,"text":"tenant-local ticket retain distinct identities and lifecycles. If one
"},{"number":351,"text":"source, product or design work item must be realised in more than one build
"},{"number":352,"text":"tenant, its tenant realisations are not tracked inside one ticket
"},{"number":353,"text":"lifecycle. The rule governs backlog and active tickets; it is not
"},{"number":354,"text":"retroactive for completed tickets unless a completed ticket is reopened or
"},{"number":355,"text":"explicitly repriced. It does not make every ticket multi-tenant: tenant
"},{"number":356,"text":"duplication is used only when the same admitted work item genuinely has
"},{"number":357,"text":"more than one tenant execution line (P3).
"},{"number":358,"text":"
"},{"number":359,"text":"The three lawful cases: an upstream-only ticket (source, product or design
"},{"number":360,"text":"authority only; no tenant duplicate yet); a single-tenant ticket (one
"},{"number":361,"text":"tenant-local execution line; no sibling duplicate required); a multi-tenant
"},{"number":362,"text":"work item (one upstream authority ticket and one suffixed tenant-local
"},{"number":363,"text":"ticket per tenant execution line). For the multi-tenant case: keep the
"},{"number":364,"text":"upstream source, product or design ticket as its own authority surface;
"},{"number":365,"text":"duplicate the work item into one tenant-local ticket per build tenant;
"},{"number":366,"text":"append a build-tenant mnemonic to the base ticket id and filename; keep
"},{"number":367,"text":"status, proof, closure and reopen logic independent for each tenant.
"},{"number":368,"text":"Recommended examples: `B-030-publish-capability-profile...` as the
"},{"number":369,"text":"source ticket,
"},{"number":370,"text":"`B-030-T1-publish-capability-profile...` and
"},{"number":371,"text":"`B-030-T2-publish-capability-profile...` as the tenant tickets.
"},{"number":372,"text":"
"},{"number":373,"text":"The law: one ticket does not claim closure for more than one build-tenant
"},{"number":374,"text":"lifecycle; a tenant-local blocker or false closure in one tenant is not
"},{"number":375,"text":"hidden by green status in another; tenant-local proof, repricing and
"},{"number":376,"text":"reopening remain tenant-local (P3, P6). If a tenant-local duplicate
"},{"number":377,"text":"exists, it should record `source_ticket` and `build_tenant`. The
"},{"number":378,"text":"`build_tenant` value identifies the
"},{"number":379,"text":"applicable entry in the product's `how.build_tenants` definition; a path
"},{"number":380,"text":"name, display alias or tracker label does not replace that identity unless
"},{"number":381,"text":"the product definition binds it as the identity. The unsuffixed base ticket
"},{"number":382,"text":"may remain the upstream product or design authority. If the work item is
"},{"number":383,"text":"multi-tenant, tenant execution and closure for backlog and active work live
"},{"number":384,"text":"on the suffixed duplicates; if it is single-tenant, no sibling duplicate is
"},{"number":385,"text":"required.
"},{"number":386,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":407,"heading":"TICKETS/4. Ticket rules/Required fields","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F4.%20Ticket%20rules%2FRequired%20fields","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"53f0aa90552029aa7e49134b6585bebcae51fa8aefe78d3503545fd171896751","start_line":387,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":387,"text":"### Required fields
"},{"number":388,"text":"
"},{"number":389,"text":"Each ticket records at least `id`, `title`, `type`, `ticket_category`,
"},{"number":390,"text":"`status`, `goal`, `change_intent`, `change_class`, `re_entry_point`,
"},{"number":391,"text":"`triaged_at`, `created_at` and `updated_at` (P4b, P3). Recommended additional fields: `priority`,
"},{"number":392,"text":"`dependencies`, `links`, `intake_source`, `affected_boundary`,
"},{"number":393,"text":"`source_ticket` when the ticket duplicates or derives from another ticket,
"},{"number":394,"text":"and `build_tenant` when the ticket is tenant-local.
"},{"number":395,"text":"
"},{"number":396,"text":"For `ticket_category: implementation_migration` the ticket also carries
"},{"number":397,"text":"`migration_strategy` and `library_usage`; `governing_library` when
"},{"number":398,"text":"`library_usage` is `consume` or `extend`; and `library_rationale` when
"},{"number":399,"text":"`library_usage` is `none` (§6). A tenant-local implementation migration
"},{"number":400,"text":"also carries `build_tenant`, and `source_ticket` when it duplicates or
"},{"number":401,"text":"derives from an upstream source, product or design ticket.
"},{"number":402,"text":"
"},{"number":403,"text":"For execution-contract admission the runtime-drafted contract should also
"},{"number":404,"text":"carry, at minimum, `target_truth`, `superseded_truth` when relevant,
"},{"number":405,"text":"`closure_law`, `evaluation_criteria`, `non_closure_conditions` and
"},{"number":406,"text":"`proof_surface` (§5).
"},{"number":407,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":414,"heading":"TICKETS/4. Ticket rules/Types","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F4.%20Ticket%20rules%2FTypes","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"0e76a7066ccccc3c71e071f53b5359832c7e022ff7881d89d7d515737837a587","start_line":408,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":408,"text":"### Types
"},{"number":409,"text":"
"},{"number":410,"text":"The minimum common set of ticket types is `feature`, `bug`, `spike` and
"},{"number":411,"text":"`chore`. A project may add more; the default set should be enough for
"},{"number":412,"text":"most cases
"},{"number":413,"text":"(P3).
"},{"number":414,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":429,"heading":"TICKETS/4. Ticket rules/Category","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F4.%20Ticket%20rules%2FCategory","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"38b57140e8797e7666363f8114ec4fa8da93dec432fcf13c63438b2304f07388","start_line":415,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":415,"text":"### Category
"},{"number":416,"text":"
"},{"number":417,"text":"Ticket category is orthogonal to ticket type: type answers what kind of
"},{"number":418,"text":"work record this is; category answers what execution or migration
"},{"number":419,"text":"discipline governs the ticket (P3, P1). The minimum
"},{"number":420,"text":"common set is `ordinary` and `implementation_migration`, so a `feature`,
"},{"number":421,"text":"`bug`, `spike` or `chore` may carry either. `implementation_migration` is
"},{"number":422,"text":"used when the ticket is not "change code until tests pass" but a governed
"},{"number":423,"text":"replacement of one implementation truth path with another across producers,
"},{"number":424,"text":"consumers, projections and proof surfaces: a bug ticket that replaces an old
"},{"number":425,"text":"tracker or read-model family with one new authoritative carrier; a feature
"},{"number":426,"text":"ticket that introduces a new public interface and requires every producer
"},{"number":427,"text":"and consumer to migrate before closure; a refactor ticket that removes a
"},{"number":428,"text":"bridge path or compatibility facade from an authoritative contract family.
"},{"number":429,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":445,"heading":"TICKETS/4. Ticket rules/Inside-out sequencing","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F4.%20Ticket%20rules%2FInside-out%20sequencing","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"de25586f41cf86d9ab367c9c707fa0eb485b8e9fdd41939f1a8113a5fa6f56cb","start_line":430,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":430,"text":"### Inside-out sequencing
"},{"number":431,"text":"
"},{"number":432,"text":"For `ticket_category: implementation_migration`, ticket sequencing reflects
"},{"number":433,"text":"the inside-out rule of
"},{"number":434,"text":"[SPEC_METHOD §7](SPEC_METHOD.md#inside-out-first-sequencing) (P4b, P6). Tickets that publish or admit
"},{"number":435,"text":"the new authoritative source carrier are the upstream tickets in the wave.
"},{"number":436,"text":"Tickets that harden prompt assembly, projections, reports, dossiers, review
"},{"number":437,"text":"surfaces or other downstream consumers depend on those upstream source
"},{"number":438,"text":"tickets. A downstream ticket may carry exploratory work while the source
"},{"number":439,"text":"ticket is active, but that work is non-closure evidence until the source
"},{"number":440,"text":"carrier is admitted and authoritative. A downstream ticket does not close
"},{"number":441,"text":"while its upstream source-carrier ticket remains open. When one migration
"},{"number":442,"text":"wave introduces a new source carrier and then its prompt, projection or
"},{"number":443,"text":"read-model consumers, the dependency chain runs `source carrier ->
"},{"number":444,"text":"downstream consumers`, never the reverse.
"},{"number":445,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":467,"heading":"TICKETS/4. Ticket rules/Change class","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F4.%20Ticket%20rules%2FChange%20class","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"333ed79e25c2aa34728f97c8c2d2150f472cfb623b36da5f017ba06a0aacbf84","start_line":446,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":446,"text":"### Change class
"},{"number":447,"text":"
"},{"number":448,"text":"Ticket type and change class are orthogonal: type answers what kind of
"},{"number":449,"text":"work record this is; change class answers where the change lawfully
"},{"number":450,"text":"re-enters the constitutional chain. A ticket records the `change_class`
"},{"number":451,"text":"declared by intake triage, using the classes of
"},{"number":452,"text":"[SPEC_METHOD §4](SPEC_METHOD.md#change-classes) (P4b, P2).
"},{"number":453,"text":"
"},{"number":454,"text":"Common pairings: `feature` with `goal_reprice`, `intent_reprice`,
"},{"number":455,"text":"`product_reprice`, `requirement_reprice` or `design_reframe`; `bug` with
"},{"number":456,"text":"`requirement_reprice`, `design_reframe` or `realization_refactor`; `chore`
"},{"number":457,"text":"with `design_reframe` or `realization_refactor`; `spike` as exploratory
"},{"number":458,"text":"work that still carries the current triage class and should terminate
"},{"number":459,"text":"either in a more specific downstream ticket or in an explicit decision
"},{"number":460,"text":"that no further substantive change is required.
"},{"number":461,"text":"
"},{"number":462,"text":"Ticket category and change class are also orthogonal: `change_class`
"},{"number":463,"text":"governs lawful constitutional re-entry; `ticket_category` governs ticket
"},{"number":464,"text":"execution and closure discipline. A ticket may therefore be `type: bug`,
"},{"number":465,"text":"`ticket_category: implementation_migration`, `change_class: design_reframe`
"},{"number":466,"text":"without contradiction (P3).
"},{"number":467,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":507,"heading":"TICKETS/4. Ticket rules/Upward propagation check","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F4.%20Ticket%20rules%2FUpward%20propagation%20check","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"6b07cc59a69d2d6c7c19d53089ca6d7828266f084a6ded0b7a0b858599bacc8d","start_line":468,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":468,"text":"### Upward propagation check
"},{"number":469,"text":"
"},{"number":470,"text":"Triage consumes the computed classification of
"},{"number":471,"text":"[SPEC_METHOD §4](SPEC_METHOD.md#computed-classification-and-treatment) for
"},{"number":472,"text":"the declared owner and layer traversal, the complete relevant public
"},{"number":473,"text":"membership and value delta, the accepted-design scope and trace coverage,
"},{"number":474,"text":"and the rule-determined treatment. The owning work carrier references that
"},{"number":475,"text":"exact result and its residuals; a new role does not repeat an unchanged
"},{"number":476,"text":"walk (P4b, P2).
"},{"number":477,"text":"
"},{"number":478,"text":"Before declaring `realization_refactor` for a bug, establish that the
"},{"number":479,"text":"current requirement and the accepted realising design govern the affected
"},{"number":480,"text":"behaviour and remain sufficient for the authorised outcome. Their presence
"},{"number":481,"text":"proves no coverage. Missing or ambiguous evidence leaves the affected
"},{"number":482,"text":"treatment unknown; it is not proof that the governing layer itself is
"},{"number":483,"text":"absent (P6).
"},{"number":484,"text":"
"},{"number":485,"text":"The re-entry rule is SPEC_METHOD §4's: the
"},{"number":486,"text":"[change classes](SPEC_METHOD.md#change-classes) with their re-entry
"},{"number":487,"text":"points, and the smallest lawful re-entry that step 4 of
"},{"number":488,"text":"[Computed classification and treatment](SPEC_METHOD.md#computed-classification-and-treatment)
"},{"number":489,"text":"exposes, with the paragraph after the four steps: a candidate's public
"},{"number":490,"text":"violation does not select a new contract, and the governing owner is
"},{"number":491,"text":"re-entered only for an explicitly changed desired outcome or an
"},{"number":492,"text":"established governing insufficiency. For a bug, this check
"},{"number":493,"text":"refines that rule into an upward walk from the realised surface that
"},{"number":494,"text":"checks each layer and stops at the highest layer found missing or
"},{"number":495,"text":"insufficient for the authorised outcome, and the class is the one that
"},{"number":496,"text":"re-enters there:
"},{"number":497,"text":"
"},{"number":498,"text":"| Where the walk stops | Change class | Action |
"},{"number":499,"text":"|---|---|---|
"},{"number":500,"text":"| the governing requirement is missing or insufficient | `requirement_reprice` | re-enter the requirement's owner |
"},{"number":501,"text":"| the requirement is sufficient, and the realising design is missing or insufficient | `design_reframe` | re-enter Design |
"},{"number":502,"text":"| an actual upstream Goal, Intent or Product change | `goal_reprice`, `intent_reprice` or `product_reprice` | follow the change to its owner rather than stopping at a familiar file |
"},{"number":503,"text":"| the current requirement and accepted design suffice, and the implementation deviates | `realization_refactor` | repair or reject the candidate |
"},{"number":504,"text":"
"},{"number":505,"text":"Unresolved meaning remains J and a reserved choice remains O, as that
"},{"number":506,"text":"paragraph states (P2, P6).
"},{"number":507,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":516,"heading":"TICKETS/4. "},{"number":509,"text":"
"},{"number":510,"text":"Because tickets are the durable authority surface for work tracking, a
"},{"number":511,"text":"ticket for substantive work carries the minimum metadata required by the
"},{"number":512,"text":"intake triage of [SPEC_METHOD §4](SPEC_METHOD.md#universal-intake-triage):
"},{"number":513,"text":"the declared `change_intent`, the lawful `change_class`, the lawful
"},{"number":514,"text":"`re_entry_point`, and when triage occurred in `triaged_at` (P4b, P2). The recorded values are those intake triage declared
"},{"number":515,"text":"(Change class and Upward propagation check above).
"},{"number":516,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":535,"heading":"TICKETS/4. Ticket rules/Status","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F4.%20Ticket%20rules%2FStatus","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"be47599b7605c08341618c1a27a9b5cece5061c400a212479a7788154e2e21d5","start_line":517,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":517,"text":"### Status
"},{"number":518,"text":"
"},{"number":519,"text":"The minimum ticket status model is `backlog`, `active` and `completed`. A
"},{"number":520,"text":"project may add `blocked`, `cancelled` or other explicit local states; the
"},{"number":521,"text":"base method starts with the three (P5, P3).
"},{"number":522,"text":"
"},{"number":523,"text":"The ticket statuses, any local state a project adds, the lanes below, the
"},{"number":524,"text":"sprint statuses of §3 and the `migration_strategy` and `library_usage`
"},{"number":525,"text":"values of §6 are declared states of their carriers, not results, and map
"},{"number":526,"text":"to no core value; the recorded `change_class` is a declared state under
"},{"number":527,"text":"[SPEC_METHOD §4](SPEC_METHOD.md#change-classes). The close
"},{"number":528,"text":"classifications and debt-entry outcomes of §3
"},{"number":529,"text":"Close review are results, mapped there. An evaluation that reads a
"},{"number":530,"text":"declared state returns its own core value with its predicate under
"},{"number":531,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results). Purpose and material
"},{"number":532,"text":"relation: a declared state is never combined as an evaluation result, so
"},{"number":533,"text":"a ticket marked `completed`, or a sprint marked `closed`, cannot stand in
"},{"number":534,"text":"for a `satisfied` result (P5, P1).
"},{"number":535,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":578,"heading":"TICKETS/4. Ticket rules/Review findings and bug items","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F4.%20Ticket%20rules%2FReview%20findings%20and%20bug%20items","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"7cee83c6fbf62249ba04cd00ccaed3faf2f746b5fd81aba9ba7e6c09093edc15","start_line":536,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":536,"text":"### Review findings and bug items
"},{"number":537,"text":"
"},{"number":538,"text":"When findings from a review need a durable work carrier, record one linked bug
"},{"number":539,"text":"report for that review, with one entry per finding: stable identity, original
"},{"number":540,"text":"Reviewer severity and triage, exact subject/basis, violated claim, location and
"},{"number":541,"text":"chaseable evidence. Link it to the work item that issued the review. With no
"},{"number":542,"text":"findings, create no bug report. A sufficient existing direct-work carrier may
"},{"number":543,"text":"carry the same relations without a redundant ticket (P3, P2).
"},{"number":544,"text":"
"},{"number":545,"text":"The Reviewer may record this report only when its activation grants the exact
"},{"number":546,"text":"artifact identity/path and effects. Otherwise it returns the findings and a
"},{"number":547,"text":"lawful Writer records them. Recording creates no repair, priority, admission or
"},{"number":548,"text":"closure authority. Keep the report within its evidence/read and visibility
"},{"number":549,"text":"restrictions: findings derived from a withheld capture are withheld from the
"},{"number":550,"text":"same recipients, including any report projection that reveals them. The
"},{"number":551,"text":"Product may bind a recognizable report naming pattern and exclusion route to
"},{"number":552,"text":"its actual access mechanism; a filename or separate lane alone enforces
"},{"number":553,"text":"nothing and grants no additional read (P6).
"},{"number":554,"text":"
"},{"number":555,"text":"After Executive or other authorized decision-owner triage, the reviewed work
"},{"number":556,"text":"item carries a linked Bug items section. Each item records its identity,
"},{"number":557,"text":"original severity, assigned priority and reason, cause group, responsible owner,
"},{"number":558,"text":"source report/finding, disposition and state. The report remains the technical
"},{"number":559,"text":"finding source; the item is the decision and repair ledger. An actor/session
"},{"number":560,"text":"index, where used, points the Reviewer to its report and the triage/repair work
"},{"number":561,"text":"to the reviewed work item's ledger, rather than duplicating that truth (P3).
"},{"number":562,"text":"
"},{"number":563,"text":"| Item state | Required trace |
"},{"number":564,"text":"|---|---|
"},{"number":565,"text":"| open | Finding and triage/disposition, with unresolved work named. |
"},{"number":566,"text":"| fixed | Exact repaired subject (commit or equivalent immutable identity) and repair evidence; not yet a claim of verification. |
"},{"number":567,"text":"| verified | The satisfied repair predicate and exact evidence; identify tests and, when required, the independent recheck/report. Tests alone are not labelled independent review. |
"},{"number":568,"text":"
"},{"number":569,"text":"These are carrier states, not core evaluation results or acceptance. A required
"},{"number":570,"text":"recheck keeps its affected items unverified until the required result is
"},{"number":571,"text":"available and applicable. A test-verified fix needs no invented Reviewer when
"},{"number":572,"text":"the governing basis requires none; the optional Executive cadence is
"},{"number":573,"text":"[EXECUTIVE_BASELINE §12](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#qa-cadence-and-repair-rechecks).
"},{"number":574,"text":"Retained or deferred findings stay linked until their selected boundary, or
"},{"number":575,"text":"transfer with owner, disposition and destination when the work item closes.
"},{"number":576,"text":"Changing priority does not erase the original severity or the obligation (P6,
"},{"number":577,"text":"P4b).
"},{"number":578,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":592,"heading":"TICKETS/4. "},{"number":580,"text":"
"},{"number":581,"text":"Backlog tickets live at the product definition's
"},{"number":582,"text":"`ticketing.tickets.lanes.backlog` binding, by default
"},{"number":583,"text":"`.ai-workspace/tickets/backlog/`; active tickets at
"},{"number":584,"text":"`ticketing.tickets.lanes.active`, by default `.ai-workspace/tickets/active/`;
"},{"number":585,"text":"completed tickets move to `ticketing.tickets.lanes.completed`, by default
"},{"number":586,"text":"`.ai-workspace/tickets/completed/` (P0, P3). `backlog`
"},{"number":587,"text":"is accepted durable work that should remain visible but is not part of the
"},{"number":588,"text":"current execution focus; `active` is the current bounded execution set;
"},{"number":589,"text":"`completed` is closed work retained as history. The lanes keep the live
"},{"number":590,"text":"execution set small enough that `rg` remains fast and readable without
"},{"number":591,"text":"forcing deferred work into comments or goals.
"},{"number":592,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":607,"heading":"TICKETS/5. From carrier to execution
"},{"number":594,"text":"
"},{"number":595,"text":"If a derived surface or projected frame of this member is insufficient,
"},{"number":596,"text":"the actor reads this member only for the named unresolved lifecycle or
"},{"number":597,"text":"proof question and cites the clauses used (P2, P6; prompt construction is
"},{"number":598,"text":"[ACTIVATION §2](ACTIVATION.md#2-context-construction-under-an-envelope)).
"},{"number":599,"text":"
"},{"number":600,"text":"Before the derivation table, the deciding routes are
"},{"number":601,"text":"[Carrier selection](#carrier-selection) for the work record and its lifetime;
"},{"number":602,"text":"[Execution contract admission](#execution-contract-admission) for execution;
"},{"number":603,"text":"[Recorded judgment and owner-ruling continuity](#recorded-judgment-and-owner-ruling-continuity)
"},{"number":604,"text":"for reusable judgments and repricing; and
"},{"number":605,"text":"[Condition-based closure and reuse](#condition-based-closure-and-reuse) for
"},{"number":606,"text":"completion. The table traces these owners; it does not decide their questions.
"},{"number":607,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":671,"heading":"TICKETS/5. "},{"number":609,"text":"
"},{"number":610,"text":"This family (F13 in the index of
"},{"number":611,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §3 Foundation to law](FOUNDATIONS.md#foundation-to-law))
"},{"number":612,"text":"decides which record carries a piece of work, what that record may claim
"},{"number":613,"text":"and when the work closes. Its instance premises, which the commitments do
"},{"number":614,"text":"not supply, are named in the rows as follows: lifetimes, work and its
"},{"number":615,"text":"obligations last one run, one bounded batch or longer; several surfaces,
"},{"number":616,"text":"goals, tickets, comments, boards and summaries can each appear to state
"},{"number":617,"text":"the same work state; several tenants, one work item may be realised in
"},{"number":618,"text":"more than one build tenant; migrations, some work replaces one
"},{"number":619,"text":"authoritative truth path with another across producers, consumers and
"},{"number":620,"text":"proofs; carriers vary, a project may keep its carriers in files, trackers
"},{"number":621,"text":"or services. Each commitment's standing is written as the table of
"},{"number":622,"text":"commitments in FOUNDATIONS §3 states it.
"},{"number":623,"text":"
"},{"number":624,"text":"| Premises, with standing | Consequence that follows | Rule in this member that states it | Added domain or policy choice, and its owner | Pillar |
"},{"number":625,"text":"|---|---|---|---|---|
"},{"number":626,"text":"| P4b (derived from P0 and P2, with P0's premise that step-produced facts are not re-acquirable); P3 (independent); P2 (independent); P6 (independent); P0 (recovered); instance: lifetimes | By P0 an actor's context does not outlive its run, and by P4b a step-produced fact that is not recorded is lost, so an obligation that must outlive the run is recorded on a carrier whose lifetime covers it before the run returns. By P2 nothing is added that the outcome does not need, so every execution runs under one run-scoped contract drawn from the smallest such carrier (an admitted ticket, a sprint entry or the run itself), and a durable ticket is created only for state that must survive; by P6 creating one needs ticket-state authority. | [Carrier selection](#carrier-selection); §1 [Goals](#goals), [Ticket records](#ticket-records), [Execution contracts](#execution-contracts) | the carrier kinds and the selection table, which apply this order to named lifetimes: a policy of this member; where each carrier lives: the product definition ([PRODUCT_DEFINITION §8](PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md#8-what-how-and-work-carriers)) | 1, 8, 9 |
"},{"number":627,"text":"| P6 (independent); P2 (independent); P4b (derived from P0 and P2, with P0's premise that step-produced facts are not re-acquirable); P3 (independent); instance: lifetimes | By P6 work needs an admitted authority, and a record's presence or prose creates none, so work executes only under admitted upstream work authority, and a carrier's presence, lane, status or prose is neither the admission of a contract nor the admission of a growth basis. By P3 execution and closure bind one exact basis, so both read the same admitted contract, which shows what counts as completion and what still counts as failure. | [Carrier selection](#carrier-selection); [Execution contract admission](#execution-contract-admission); [Evaluation criteria and non-closure conditions](#evaluation-criteria-and-non-closure-conditions) | the contract's minimum fields: this member; the admission mechanism and the result and evidence surface: the product definition. The step side of admission is law at [ACTIVATION §1](ACTIVATION.md#admission), not a choice | 1, 8, 9 |
"},{"number":628,"text":"| P6 (independent); P3 (independent); P4b (derived from P0 and P2, with P0's premise that step-produced facts are not re-acquirable); P2 (independent); P5 (derived from P0 and P6, with P0's open-world premise); P0 (recovered); instance: several surfaces, carriers vary | By P3 one state binds one authority and basis, and by P6 a projection is not authority, so work state has one authority chain: goals own the work wave, the ticket owns its state and milestone authority its milestones, and a board, comment, index or summary is a projection that answers one question. By P5 contradictory authorities cannot both be read as satisfied, so contradiction among them blocks closure; by P4b a milestone's acceptance establishes only its own claim. A comment is a post: provisional until its content is adopted into the owning surface, with its own discussion state. Another carrier is lawful only as an explicit rebinding with no rival left. | [One-truth state projection and drift refusal (UP-009)](#one-truth-state-projection-and-drift-refusal-up-009); §1 [Comments](#comments), [Milestones and phase-scoped truth (UP-006)](#milestones-and-phase-scoped-truth-up-006); §2 [Default layout](#default-layout), [Bindings and projections](#bindings-and-projections), [Carrier substitution](#carrier-substitution); §4 [Status](#status), [Lanes](#lanes); §9 [Relationship to other surfaces](#relationship-to-other-surfaces); [POSTING_GUIDE §2](POSTING_GUIDE.md#2-boundary), [§7](POSTING_GUIDE.md#7-discussion-state-and-mutability), [§9](POSTING_GUIDE.md#9-ratification) | the default layout, the lanes and the minimum status sets: domain choices of this member, which a project may extend; a rebinding of ticket authority: the product definition; the post categories, structure and discussion states: [POSTING_GUIDE](POSTING_GUIDE.md) | 1, 6, 9 |
"},{"number":629,"text":"| P2 (independent); P4b (derived from P0 and P2, with P0's premise that step-produced facts are not re-acquirable); P6 (independent); P5 (derived from P0 and P6, with P0's open-world premise); P3 (independent); instance: lifetimes | By P2 closure law repeated over one bounded scope can be applied once, so a sprint batches it; by P4b a deferred proof persists until paid, and by P6 closure needs its evidence, so a sprint defers only declared local proof, as escrow paid down at close review, and never batches away triage. Law-changing work re-enters at its own layer (P2), so it leaves the sprint. By P5 each close outcome is a result, so the sprint closes only when the close review has classified every item and debt entry, each classification mapped into the core, and the follow-up work is durable. | [§3](#3-sprint-rules); §1 [Sprints](#sprints) | the manifest fields, the sprint statuses, the escrow lists and the six close classifications and the debt outcomes with their mappings: domain choices of this member; whether debt may survive as follow-up: the governing method; the decision to offer a sprint as a batching carrier at all: a policy of this member | 1, 3, 9 |
"},{"number":630,"text":"| P4b (derived from P0 and P2, with P0's premise that step-produced facts are not re-acquirable); P2 (independent); P6 (independent); P3 (independent); P1 (independent) | By P4b the reason a ticket exists must survive the run, so a ticket records the triage that admitted it: change intent, change class and re-entry point. By P2 work re-enters where the authorised outcome is unmet, and by P1 a familiar file carries no authority, so the upward walk checks each layer and re-enters at the highest layer found missing or insufficient, never at a familiar file. | §4 [Required fields](#required-fields), [Types](#types), [Category](#category), [Change class](#change-class), [Upward propagation check](#upward-propagation-check), [Triage metadata](#triage-metadata), [One durable record per ticket](#one-durable-record-per-ticket) | the required fields and the minimum types and categories: domain choices of this member, which a project may extend; the change classes: domain choices of [SPEC_METHOD §4](SPEC_METHOD.md#4-change-management) | 1, 9 |
"},{"number":631,"text":"| P3 (independent); P6 (independent); P1 (independent); instance: several tenants | By P3 a lifecycle binds one exact subject, and each build tenant realises a separate subject, so one ticket closes at most one build-tenant lifecycle, and proof, closure, repricing and reopening stay tenant-local. By P6 one subject's evidence decides nothing for another, so one tenant's green status hides no other tenant's blocker. | §4 [Multi-build-tenant independence](#multi-build-tenant-independence); §6 [Multi-build-tenant review](#multi-build-tenant-review) | the suffixed ticket identifier and the `source_ticket` and `build_tenant` fields: domain choices of this member; tenant identity: the product definition's tenant registry | 1, 8, 9 |
"},{"number":632,"text":"| P6 (independent); P4b (derived from P0 and P2, with P0's premise that step-produced facts are not re-acquirable); P3 (independent); P5 (derived from P0 and P6, with P0's open-world premise); P2 (independent); P4a (independent); P1 (independent); instance: migrations | By P6 two truth paths cannot both hold authority over one scope, and by P5 an absence is shown only by evidence, so a migration ticket closes only when the old truth path no longer holds authority in its declared scope, shown by negative or structural proof. By P2 each further local rebuild adds cost with no new route to the outcome, and by P3 similar code does not establish one identity, so a credible recurrence forces an explicit library or commonisation review, never an automatic merge. | §6 [Declaration and checklist](#declaration-and-checklist), [Closure of a migration ticket](#closure-of-a-migration-ticket), [Strategy requirements](#strategy-requirements), [Recurring realisation and library declaration](#recurring-realisation-and-library-declaration), [Review disambiguation](#review-disambiguation), [Impacted interface review checklist](#impacted-interface-review-checklist), [Break order and break-to-closure map](#break-order-and-break-to-closure-map), [Mixed-state negative proof](#mixed-state-negative-proof); §4 [Inside-out sequencing](#inside-out-sequencing) | the declaration, the checklist, the strategy and library values, the recurrence thresholds, the review questions and the break order: domain choices of this member. The migration law is [SPEC_METHOD §7](SPEC_METHOD.md#7-migration), not a choice | 4, 9 |
"},{"number":633,"text":"| P6 (independent); P1 (independent); P4b (derived from P0 and P2, with P0's premise that step-produced facts are not re-acquirable); P5 (derived from P0 and P6, with P0's open-world premise); P0 (recovered); P2 (independent); P3 (independent) | By P6 authority to author is not independent authority to verify. By P1 and P3 a verdict means only the claim it binds, so a review verdict is bounded by its claim and traceable to it. By P0 and P4b a judgment or ruling must survive a change of actor, so it is recorded once, in its original terms, and reused while it applies; by P5 changed evidence invalidates what it affects. | §7 [Execution and verification authority separation (UP-007)](#execution-and-verification-authority-separation-up-007), [Recorded judgment and owner-ruling continuity](#recorded-judgment-and-owner-ruling-continuity) | the four repricing dispositions and the predicate and refinement for a material repricing decision: this member. The assessment protocol and the reuse law are [EVALUATION §3](EVALUATION.md#3-independent-assessment) and [ACTIVATION §7](ACTIVATION.md#7-closed-result-and-reuse), not choices | 7, 9 |
"},{"number":634,"text":"| P6 (independent); P5 (derived from P0 and P6, with P0's open-world premise); P2 (independent); P4b (derived from P0 and P2, with P0's premise that step-produced facts are not re-acquirable) | By P5 a claim is satisfied only by valid evidence for each obligation, under the conjunction of FOUNDATIONS §4, so a work claim is complete only when every applicable obligation is satisfied and no non-closure condition remains. "},{"number":637,"text":"
"},{"number":638,"text":"The standing of these consequences is stated in
"},{"number":639,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §3 Foundation to law](FOUNDATIONS.md#foundation-to-law).
"},{"number":640,"text":"The table accounts for §1 to §9, and for POSTING_GUIDE §2, §7 and §9,
"},{"number":641,"text":"which have no family table of their own.
"},{"number":642,"text":"
"},{"number":643,"text":"Consumers of these rows, where an actor enters them (FOUNDATIONS §3
"},{"number":644,"text":"Foundation to law, Consumers), one list per row, each consumer linked to
"},{"number":645,"text":"its own locus:
"},{"number":646,"text":"
"},{"number":647,"text":"- Row 1, the carrier for a lifetime: [SPEC_METHOD §4 Carriers](SPEC_METHOD.md#carriers), which selects a change's carrier for its required lifetime and takes the smallest lawful carrier from Carrier selection; [PRODUCT_DEFINITION §8](PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md#8-what-how-and-work-carriers), which binds where each carrier kind lives and selects none; [CONFORMANCE §5](CONFORMANCE.md#5-discriminator-coverage), discriminator 41, where a proposed change to work carriers is judged under Carrier selection; [Recorded judgment and owner-ruling continuity](#recorded-judgment-and-owner-ruling-continuity), whose record lives in the carrier selected under §5.
"},{"number":648,"text":"- Row 2, execution under admitted authority: [ACTIVATION §1 Admission](ACTIVATION.md#admission), where a contract carries the states this section names and a carrier's presence, lane or label is never admission; the [ODD family table](ODD.md#foundation-to-law), whose row for the manual walkthrough imports F13 for admission against deterministic criteria.
"},{"number":649,"text":"- Row 3, one authority chain and its projections: [PRODUCT_DEFINITION §8](PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md#8-what-how-and-work-carriers), whose `ticketing` bindings locate the carriers and keep the work wave with goals, ticket state with the ticket and commentary outside authority; [§8](#8-recommended-shapes), where another shape is bound under §2 only with the same fields.
