"},{"number":650,"text":"- Row 4, sprints as batches: [SPEC_METHOD §4 Sprint execution boundary](SPEC_METHOD.md#sprint-execution-boundary), whose close review takes its mechanics, escrow and classifications from §3, and [Change classes](SPEC_METHOD.md#change-classes), where a close classification that names a layer is a result mapped at §3 and carries the class at which the work re-enters; [UX §12 UX sprint compliance escrow](UX.md#ux-sprint-compliance-escrow), where each finding takes one of the six close classifications, [UX §15](UX.md#15-results-of-this-profile), which maps none of them again, and the [UX family table](UX.md#foundation-to-law), whose row for scaffold, exemption and escrow imports F13; [CONFORMANCE §5](CONFORMANCE.md#5-discriminator-coverage), discriminator 48, where a sprint status or classification decides no admission, compliance or closure; [Status](#status), where the sprint statuses are declared states and the close classifications are results mapped at §3; [Condition-based closure and reuse](#condition-based-closure-and-reuse), where sprint-close law still applies to a result recorded without review; [§8](#8-recommended-shapes), whose sprint manifest carries the fields of §3.
"},{"number":651,"text":"- Row 5, the triage a ticket records and the upward walk: [SPEC_METHOD §4 Change classes](SPEC_METHOD.md#change-classes), which has the class recorded on the carrier under §4 Change class; [Sprint admission](#sprint-admission), whose included tickets still record their triage metadata; [Carrier selection](#carrier-selection), whose ticket-shaped contract carries the required fields of §4; [§8](#8-recommended-shapes), whose ordinary ticket carries the required fields and triage metadata.
"},{"number":652,"text":"- Row 6, tenant-local lifecycles: [SPEC_METHOD §11](SPEC_METHOD.md#11-build-tenant-binding), Development of several tenants, where the independence of each tenant's ticket lifecycle and the review of its tickets are this section's; [PRODUCT_DEFINITION §8](PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md#8-what-how-and-work-carriers), which names the multi-build-tenant work-item relation in the build-tenancy context and whose tenant registry supplies tenant identity.
"},{"number":653,"text":"- Row 7, migration tickets: [DESIGN_MODULE §10 Recurrence extraction](DESIGN_MODULE.md#recurrence-extraction), which refines the recurrence rule of Recurring realisation and library declaration as a design-review obligation for a Product that adopts that profile; [Status](#status), where `migration_strategy` and `library_usage` are declared states of their carriers; [§8](#8-recommended-shapes), whose migration ticket carries the declaration and checklist of §6.
"},{"number":654,"text":"- Row 8, authority to author, to verify and to rule: [EVALUATION §3](EVALUATION.md#3-independent-assessment), which takes from UP-007 the boundaries at which independent assessment is required and relabels no self-review in a fresh context; [EXECUTIVE_BASELINE §10](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#10-derived-reviewer-frame), [§12 step 4](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#4-executive-evaluates-the-work-result) and [§17](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#17-actor-binding-and-independence), and the [EXECUTIVE_BASELINE family table](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#foundation-to-law), whose row for the Reviewer imports F13 for when independent assessment is required; [SPEC_METHOD §4 Computed classification and treatment](SPEC_METHOD.md#computed-classification-and-treatment), where the recorded J and O continuity rules are Recorded judgment and owner-ruling continuity's; [Recurring realisation and library declaration](#recurring-realisation-and-library-declaration), where a repricing input blocks no bounded claim unless the owning authority admits the follow-up.
"},{"number":655,"text":"- Row 9, closure by condition and test authority: [SPEC_METHOD §4 Consistency gate](SPEC_METHOD.md#consistency-gate), which applies the closure condition as the gate over a change span and the ticket-local test-case rule to a code and test mismatch, and [§9](SPEC_METHOD.md#9-evidence), which names the evidence the condition requires for a realisation claim; [EXECUTIVE_BASELINE §22](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#22-closure), where a work item closes by this condition, and the [EXECUTIVE_BASELINE family table](EXECUTIVE_BASELINE.md#foundation-to-law), whose row for qualification and closure imports F13 for the closure condition; [ASSURANCE §3](ASSURANCE.md#3-test-authority), where the derivation of each test case from admitted work authority is Test case authority's; [Milestones and phase-scoped truth (UP-006)](#milestones-and-phase-scoped-truth-up-006), where each milestone is a work claim under the closure condition.
"},{"number":656,"text":"- Row 10, term binding: no separate consumer applies. The resolution law a ticket's terms resolve under is [PRODUCT_DEFINITION §5](PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md#5-bounded-context-semantic-resolution)'s, as the choice column states; the block on admission and closure acts inside Execution contract admission and Condition-based closure and reuse of this member, and no section of another member names this binding.
"},{"number":657,"text":"- Row 11, carrier shape and reading this member: no separate consumer applies. A project's carrier layout is bound under [PRODUCT_DEFINITION §8](PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md#8-what-how-and-work-carriers) and scaffolded by [§12](PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md#12-bootstrap), which name their own defaults and not these shapes; the reading rule applies ACTIVATION §2 Acquisition, as the choice column states, and no other section applies it.
"},{"number":658,"text":"
"},{"number":659,"text":"Each consumer applies the rule and decides nothing the owning section does
"},{"number":660,"text":"not (P2, P6).
"},{"number":661,"text":"
"},{"number":662,"text":"The [Review findings and bug items](#review-findings-and-bug-items) refinement
"},{"number":663,"text":"applies the same P3/P4b identity and retained-obligation premises to findings
"},{"number":664,"text":"that outlive review. P6 keeps the assessment source, decision ledger and
"},{"number":665,"text":"artifact effects distinct, and P2 avoids an empty report or redundant ticket.
"},{"number":666,"text":"One report per finding-bearing review, the item fields and the three item
"},{"number":667,"text":"states are explicit carrier choices of §4. Verification still uses EVALUATION
"},{"number":668,"text":"and the applicable cadence rather than treating a state label as proof. The
"},{"number":669,"text":"consumers are EVALUATION §4's report effect, EXECUTIVE_BASELINE §5/§12's triage
"},{"number":670,"text":"and repair decisions, §7's closure and §8's ticket shape.
"},{"number":671,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":745,"heading":"TICKETS/5. From carrier to execution/Carrier selection","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F5.%20From%20carrier%20to%20execution%2FCarrier%20selection","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"4c7d1b12ae2b558ebcdb523f01e2cd8589c2550557f13b0266de7a91aa05597c","start_line":672,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":672,"text":"### Carrier selection
"},{"number":673,"text":"
"},{"number":674,"text":"Every execution governed by this method uses one run-scoped execution
"},{"number":675,"text":"contract. The required lifetime of the work or obligation selects the
"},{"number":676,"text":"smallest lawful source carrier: first establish the applicable upstream
"},{"number":677,"text":"work authority, then select the first matching row below. For work inside
"},{"number":678,"text":"an admitted sprint the local carrier boundary is that sprint; otherwise it
"},{"number":679,"text":"is the current run (P2, P4b, P6).
"},{"number":680,"text":"
"},{"number":681,"text":"| Condition | Execution-contract source | Durable-ticket decision |
"},{"number":682,"text":"|---|---|---|
"},{"number":683,"text":"| no applicable upstream work authority exists | no execution contract is admitted | do not create a ticket as substitute authority; stop or re-enter |
"},{"number":684,"text":"| applicable authority exists and an existing admitted ticket covers the exact work | derive the run-scoped contract from that ticket | reuse it; do not create another ticket |
"},{"number":685,"text":"| applicable authority exists, no exact admitted ticket covers the work, and the work or an open obligation needs independent state beyond the local carrier boundary | one durable ticket plus the run-scoped contract | create or update the ticket only under ticket-state authority |
"},{"number":686,"text":"| applicable authority exists, no exact admitted ticket covers the work, and the work stays inside one admitted sprint with no state required after sprint close | the sprint manifest plus one manifest-local iteration entry | do not create a durable ticket |
"},{"number":687,"text":"| applicable authority exists, no exact admitted ticket or sprint covers the work, and the work ends in the current run with no independent surviving state | an intake-drafted run-scoped contract | do not create a durable ticket |
"},{"number":688,"text":"
"},{"number":689,"text":""Ticket-shaped" describes the categorisation, closure criteria, proof
"},{"number":690,"text":"surface, non-closure conditions and the other required execution-contract
"},{"number":691,"text":"fields (§4, Required fields). It creates no durable ticket identity and no
"},{"number":692,"text":"ticket-lane state (P3).
"},{"number":693,"text":"
"},{"number":694,"text":"Absence of a durable ticket neither requires nor authorises creating one.
"},{"number":695,"text":"An exact product-authorised work instruction may supply the upstream work
"},{"number":696,"text":"authority for a one-run contract; a generic request or a model-widened
"},{"number":697,"text":"scope cannot. A durable ticket is created or updated only when the table
"},{"number":698,"text":"requires surviving state and the actor holds ticket-state authority. An
"},{"number":699,"text":"explicit instruction from ticket-state authority to create a durable record
"},{"number":700,"text":"selects that durability; it does not admit an execution contract or widen
"},{"number":701,"text":"its upstream work authority (P6, P2).
"},{"number":702,"text":"
"},{"number":703,"text":"The step side of admission is [ACTIVATION §1](ACTIVATION.md#admission) and
"},{"number":704,"text":"is defined there once: drafting versus admission inside one invocation, the
"},{"number":705,"text":"condition under which execution may begin, what admission may never be
"},{"number":706,"text":"inferred from (including ticket or sprint presence, lane placement and
"},{"number":707,"text":"`active` status), the coordinates an admitted result carries, the recording
"},{"number":708,"text":"of every result, withheld closure and residual obligation before return,
"},{"number":709,"text":"and refusal when no durable result and evidence surface is available. This
"},{"number":710,"text":"member adds the carrier side (P6, P4b). The admission mechanism and the
"},{"number":711,"text":"durable result and evidence surface are the ones the product definition
"},{"number":712,"text":"binds. When that surface is the ticket or the sprint manifest, the admitted
"},{"number":713,"text":"result with its coordinates is recorded there. A carrier's lane, status or
"},{"number":714,"text":"prose that asserts admission without those coordinates is not admission
"},{"number":715,"text":"evidence, and the contract it describes remains drafted or rejected.
"},{"number":716,"text":"
"},{"number":717,"text":"When admission is absent or rejected, ACTIVATION §1 returns the missing
"},{"number":718,"text":"work authority without execution. Before that return, an obligation that
"},{"number":719,"text":"must survive the run is carried as follows (P4b, P6): it becomes a
"},{"number":720,"text":"sprint-local entry when its lifetime stays inside the admitted sprint;
"},{"number":721,"text":"otherwise it is recorded as a durable ticket, only under ticket-state
"},{"number":722,"text":"authority; where that authority is absent, it is retained in the
"},{"number":723,"text":"contract's named durable result and evidence surface or in an
"},{"number":724,"text":"already-authorised enclosing carrier, closure is marked withheld on
"},{"number":725,"text":"ticket-state authority, and the required re-entry is returned.
"},{"number":726,"text":"
"},{"number":727,"text":"Execution and closure use the same admitted categorisation, criteria,
"},{"number":728,"text":"proof surface and non-closure conditions. The resulting state still flows
"},{"number":729,"text":"through proof, gap analysis and repricing (P6, P2).
"},{"number":730,"text":"
"},{"number":731,"text":"The selected carrier is also the work reference for context construction and
"},{"number":732,"text":"continuation: bind its current question, subject and basis, result and evidence
"},{"number":733,"text":"references, and surviving obligations. Apply
"},{"number":734,"text":"[ACTIVATION §2](ACTIVATION.md#2-context-construction-under-an-envelope) to that
"},{"number":735,"text":"bounded acquisition, [§5](ACTIVATION.md#5-work-state-and-restart) to current
"},{"number":736,"text":"work state, the disposable actor account and resumption, and
"},{"number":737,"text":"[§7](ACTIVATION.md#7-closed-result-and-reuse) to closed results and reuse.
"},{"number":738,"text":"The ticket retains its [work-state authority](#one-truth-state-projection-and-drift-refusal-up-009);
"},{"number":739,"text":"an actor's account cannot replace the carrier, governing sources or current
"},{"number":740,"text":"evidence. Preserve results, step-produced facts and owner rulings through
"},{"number":741,"text":"the named result and evidence surface under existing admission and
"},{"number":742,"text":"[continuity](#recorded-judgment-and-owner-ruling-continuity) law. This applies
"},{"number":743,"text":"those owners to the selected carrier; it creates no additional carrier
"},{"number":744,"text":"requirement and confers no ticket-state authority (P0, P3, P4b, P6).
"},{"number":745,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":769,"heading":"TICKETS/5. From carrier to execution/Execution contract admission","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F5.%20From%20carrier%20to%20execution%2FExecution%20contract%20admission","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"1a5f34e60354c3985908e5c623a655b8d8e36c4983f7029a6ef0755e02ccb130","start_line":746,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":746,"text":"### Execution contract admission
"},{"number":747,"text":"
"},{"number":748,"text":"The runtime execution flow should treat a ticket, a sprint entry or a
"},{"number":749,"text":"drafted work contract as an admission candidate, never as automatic truth;
"},{"number":750,"text":"the contract carries at minimum the states named in ACTIVATION §1
"},{"number":751,"text":"(drafted, admitted, rejected, superseded). An admitted execution contract
"},{"number":752,"text":"should be recorded on the selected durable work carrier, including an event log
"},{"number":753,"text":"where the execution binding requires one. It is available to prompt assembly
"},{"number":754,"text":"where applicable, and to later closure checking, so that execution and
"},{"number":755,"text":"closure read the same admitted basis. A binding that requires an event log
"},{"number":756,"text":"still requires that log; a human or mixed binding may select another durable
"},{"number":757,"text":"carrier under [SPEC_METHOD §11](SPEC_METHOD.md#11-build-tenant-binding)
"},{"number":758,"text":"(P6, P4b). The refusal of self-certification
"},{"number":759,"text":"is ACTIVATION §1.
"},{"number":760,"text":"
"},{"number":761,"text":"Admission validates a contract against its cited product outcome,
"},{"number":762,"text":"prerequisite or experiment basis and does not admit that basis (ACTIVATION
"},{"number":763,"text":"§1). Admission or renewal of the basis belongs to the authority owning the
"},{"number":764,"text":"selected goals work wave, or its explicitly bounded proxy, and stays
"},{"number":765,"text":"durably legible in the existing goals or ticket authority
"},{"number":766,"text":"([SPEC_METHOD §3](SPEC_METHOD.md#3-outcome-conservation)). A ticket's
"},{"number":767,"text":"`active` status, its lane, or an admitted or retained contract is therefore
"},{"number":768,"text":"never the admission of a growth basis (P6, P2).
"},{"number":769,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":791,"heading":"TICKETS/5. From carrier to execution/Evaluation criteria and non-closure conditions","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F5.%20From%20carrier%20to%20execution%2FEvaluation%20criteria%20and%20non-closure%20conditions","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"322c1e81234b1e8868ab38b0aafd36bab61da41819527f9ee8ea04d7e7e7aa46","start_line":770,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":770,"text":"### Evaluation criteria and non-closure conditions
"},{"number":771,"text":"
"},{"number":772,"text":"An execution contract should expose both what counts as progress or
"},{"number":773,"text":"completion and what still counts as failure even when some local proof is
"},{"number":774,"text":"green. At minimum it should make `evaluation_criteria` and
"},{"number":775,"text":"`non_closure_conditions` visible. These are the local gain function for
"},{"number":776,"text":"the work (P6, P2).
"},{"number":777,"text":"
"},{"number":778,"text":"For implementation migrations, typical non-closure conditions are: the old
"},{"number":779,"text":"authoritative path still passes in normal execution within the declared
"},{"number":780,"text":"affected scope; mixed old and new proof is still accepted; a proxy or
"},{"number":781,"text":"partial interface implementation still stands in the acceptance path;
"},{"number":782,"text":"competing or ambiguous executable authority remains reachable on the
"},{"number":783,"text":"claimed product acceptance path; ticket wording, product wording and proof
"},{"number":784,"text":"wording are not reconciled. These conditions are not optional commentary;
"},{"number":785,"text":"they are the anti-self-deception surface for execution (P6).
"},{"number":786,"text":"
"},{"number":787,"text":"Residual implementation debt outside the claimed acceptance path is not by
"},{"number":788,"text":"itself a non-closure condition. It may be deferred only under the
"},{"number":789,"text":"path-relative authority and explicit disposition rules of
"},{"number":790,"text":"[SPEC_METHOD §7](SPEC_METHOD.md#constitutional-migration-options) (P2).
"},{"number":791,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":810,"heading":"TICKETS/5. From carrier to execution/Bounded-context term binding","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F5.%20From%20carrier%20to%20execution%2FBounded-context%20term%20binding","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"6fc6057453c6323a494937a8085bab5d72b7f8ff4fc1d334ddeea572d34c6c0b","start_line":792,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":792,"text":"### Bounded-context term binding
"},{"number":793,"text":"
"},{"number":794,"text":"Ticket and work-instruction terms resolve under the bounded-context
"},{"number":795,"text":"semantic resolution of PRODUCT_DEFINITION §5. A ticket may use an
"},{"number":796,"text":"unqualified term when its cited product, re-entry surface, execution basis
"},{"number":797,"text":"and affected scope select exactly one bounded-context meaning (P1, P3).
"},{"number":798,"text":"
"},{"number":799,"text":"When a ticket spans contexts, or a material term has competing meanings,
"},{"number":800,"text":"the ticket cites the applicable product-definition disambiguation or the
"},{"number":801,"text":"owner-authorised import, translation, equivalence or disambiguation
"},{"number":802,"text":"carrier; it may reference that relation rather than duplicate it. Ticket
"},{"number":803,"text":"prose, actor familiarity, a matching glossary heading, tenant placement or
"},{"number":804,"text":"comment context cannot select meaning or transfer authority (P1, P6).
"},{"number":805,"text":"
"},{"number":806,"text":"An unresolved or multiply resolved material term blocks execution-contract
"},{"number":807,"text":"admission and closure for the affected claim. Opening or updating the
"},{"number":808,"text":"ticket records the pressure and does not cure it; resolution re-enters at
"},{"number":809,"text":"the authority that owns the missing context or semantic relation (P1, P5).
"},{"number":810,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":812,"heading":"TICKETS/6. Implementation migration","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F6.%20Implementation%20migration","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"2b292f509c260cfb1fd054aa9356c6b449bdf6ab37fcb1a0786cf5e54740b1a7","start_line":811,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":811,"text":"## 6. Implementation migration
"},{"number":812,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":867,"heading":"TICKETS/6. Implementation migration/Declaration and checklist","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F6.%20Implementation%20migration%2FDeclaration%20and%20checklist","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"877da360bfa22bc563dc24eec450d805801490d7ebcc78effe70dc8639aaf8cb","start_line":813,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":813,"text":"### Declaration and checklist
"},{"number":814,"text":"
"},{"number":815,"text":"A ticket with `ticket_category: implementation_migration` carries both an
"},{"number":816,"text":"explicit migration declaration block and a hard migration checklist. Both
"},{"number":817,"text":"are part of the ticket authority, not optional commentary.
"},{"number":818,"text":"[SPEC_METHOD §7](SPEC_METHOD.md#7-migration) defines the migration law;
"},{"number":819,"text":"this category defines the minimum ticket-local declaration and checklist
"},{"number":820,"text":"that a reviewer can check before accepting a closure claim on one concrete
"},{"number":821,"text":"work item, and is the local enforcement surface for the inside-out
"},{"number":822,"text":"migration law of SPEC_METHOD §7 (P6, P4b, P3).
"},{"number":823,"text":"
"},{"number":824,"text":"The declaration states: the migration strategy used for this work item; the
"},{"number":825,"text":"exact affected migration scope; every explicitly excluded or disjoint
"},{"number":826,"text":"product or compatibility scope with its deterministic routing relation; the
"},{"number":827,"text":"old truth path or superseded contract; the new truth path or authoritative
"},{"number":828,"text":"contract; the producer set for the old and the new path; the consumer set
"},{"number":829,"text":"for the old and the new path; every projection, report, status surface and
"},{"number":830,"text":"proof surface derived from that contract family; and the closure law for
"},{"number":831,"text":"the migration.
"},{"number":832,"text":"
"},{"number":833,"text":"The ticket carries at least this checklist in live markdown form:
"},{"number":834,"text":"
"},{"number":835,"text":"```md
"},{"number":836,"text":"## Migration Checklist
"},{"number":837,"text":"
"},{"number":838,"text":"- [ ] exact affected migration scope is named
"},{"number":839,"text":"- [ ] excluded or disjoint Product and compatibility scopes are named with deterministic routing
"},{"number":840,"text":"- [ ] old truth path is named explicitly
"},{"number":841,"text":"- [ ] new truth path is named explicitly
"},{"number":842,"text":"- [ ] producer set for the new truth is listed
"},{"number":843,"text":"- [ ] consumer set for the new truth is listed
"},{"number":844,"text":"- [ ] projection/read-model surfaces are listed
"},{"number":845,"text":"- [ ] old truth path is removed or explicitly demoted from authority within the affected scope
"},{"number":846,"text":"- [ ] mixed-state behavior is no longer accepted as closure evidence
"},{"number":847,"text":"- [ ] tests proving mixed old/new behavior are removed or repriced
"},{"number":848,"text":"- [ ] recurring realization patterns are checked against existing library/commonization surfaces
"},{"number":849,"text":"- [ ] ticket declares library usage and names the governing library or rationale
"},{"number":850,"text":"- [ ] if the work exists in more than one build tenant, this backlog/active ticket carries only one tenant lifecycle and any sibling tenant work lives on its own suffixed ticket
"},{"number":851,"text":"- [ ] ticket wording, product wording, and proof claims are reconciled before closure
"},{"number":852,"text":"```
"},{"number":853,"text":"
"},{"number":854,"text":"Where no excluded or disjoint scope exists, the second item is satisfied by
"},{"number":855,"text":"declaring that absence explicitly, as the migration example of §8 writes
"},{"number":856,"text":"it; silence does not satisfy it (P6).
"},{"number":857,"text":"
"},{"number":858,"text":"The required fields are `migration_strategy`, with the values
"},{"number":859,"text":"`inside_out_hard_break` and `fundamental_re_adoption`, and
"},{"number":860,"text":"`library_usage`, with the values `none`, `consume` and `extend`. When
"},{"number":861,"text":"`library_usage` is `consume` or `extend`, the ticket names the governing
"},{"number":862,"text":"reusable library or commonisation surface in `governing_library`. When it
"},{"number":863,"text":"is `none`, the ticket explains in `library_rationale` that no existing
"},{"number":864,"text":"reusable surface applies, or that the pattern is still boundary-specific,
"},{"number":865,"text":"or that it is not yet a lawful recurrence or commonisation candidate (P3,
"},{"number":866,"text":"P2).
"},{"number":867,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":897,"heading":"TICKETS/6. Implementation migration/Closure of a migration ticket","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F6.%20Implementation%20migration%2FClosure%20of%20a%20migration%20ticket","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"e6a577464f0594fc8b5c9bea5a81a01ee3e4bb6a01d817e0110571c5152ba4b2","start_line":868,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":868,"text":"### Closure of a migration ticket
"},{"number":869,"text":"
"},{"number":870,"text":"Closure is blocked while the old authoritative interface still passes in
"},{"number":871,"text":"normal execution within the declared affected scope, unless the ticket
"},{"number":872,"text":"explicitly declares a retained compatibility feature. A deterministically
"},{"number":873,"text":"routed, non-overlapping product scope outside the declared affected scope
"},{"number":874,"text":"remains governed by its own current authority (P6, P3). Accordingly: the
"},{"number":875,"text":"old path may not remain silently authoritative within the affected scope;
"},{"number":876,"text":"mixed old and new green tests do not count as migration completion; any
"},{"number":877,"text":"retained old path within the affected scope is named as compatibility
"},{"number":878,"text":"rather than current native truth; retained compatibility is justified in
"},{"number":879,"text":"the ticket itself, never inferred from surviving code; proxy or partial
"},{"number":880,"text":"implementations do not satisfy migration closure; and if a ticket was
"},{"number":881,"text":"marked `completed` and later review shows checked closure items are false
"},{"number":882,"text":"on the current tree, the ticket is reopened or an explicitly linked
"},{"number":883,"text":"successor ticket is created, because a false closure claim is a
"},{"number":884,"text":"ticket-method defect, not only a code defect (P6, P4b).
"},{"number":885,"text":"
"},{"number":886,"text":"An intermediate product-slice milestone inside an open migration ticket may
"},{"number":887,"text":"be accepted under the path-relative promotion rule of SPEC_METHOD §7, which
"},{"number":888,"text":"also states how the slice's identity and acceptance criteria derive and
"},{"number":889,"text":"that ticket wording cannot narrow that authority away. The ticket-local
"},{"number":890,"text":"consequence: the ticket remains active and does not claim migration
"},{"number":891,"text":"closure until the migration checklist and the final closure law are
"},{"number":892,"text":"satisfied; its `active` status renews none of the accepted slice's
"},{"number":893,"text":"exhausted growth authority; and removal, demotion and closure-proof work
"},{"number":894,"text":"may continue within the bound SPEC_METHOD §7 states, further material
"},{"number":895,"text":"producer or consumer growth requiring another basis admitted under
"},{"number":896,"text":"SPEC_METHOD §3 (P2, P6; §1, Milestones).
"},{"number":897,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":917,"heading":"TICKETS/6. Implementation migration/Strategy requirements","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F6.%20Implementation%20migration%2FStrategy%20requirements","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"c87eb3e9fe69382146ec81eaaa9ce022b7eebe80a48e321bcd0ba79bb25c3988","start_line":898,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":898,"text":"### Strategy requirements
"},{"number":899,"text":"
"},{"number":900,"text":"When `migration_strategy: inside_out_hard_break`, the ticket carries a full
"},{"number":901,"text":"best-guess interface inventory for the migrating contract family; the
"},{"number":902,"text":"ordered break sequence from the deepest source truth outward; the old seam
"},{"number":903,"text":"each break intentionally severs; and the negative proof expected for each
"},{"number":904,"text":"break (P4b, P6).
"},{"number":905,"text":"
"},{"number":906,"text":"When `migration_strategy: fundamental_re_adoption`, the ticket carries the
"},{"number":907,"text":"explicit selection of fundamental re-adoption by the human product
"},{"number":908,"text":"authority; the comparison with bounded evolution across product value,
"},{"number":909,"text":"feedback latency, authority risk, reversibility, total cost and retained
"},{"number":910,"text":"predecessor semantics; the bounded abort or re-entry condition; the
"},{"number":911,"text":"sideways reference line or prior implementation boundary treated as source
"},{"number":912,"text":"material; the module and interface adjudication surface; and explicit
"},{"number":913,"text":"classifications for inherited modules, interfaces, carriers, projections
"},{"number":914,"text":"and proof surfaces, each `carry_across`, `redundant` or `rewrite`
"},{"number":915,"text":"([SPEC_METHOD §7](SPEC_METHOD.md#fundamental-migration) defines the three).
"},{"number":916,"text":"Unclassified inherited implementation blocks closure (P6, P3).
"},{"number":917,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":948,"heading":"TICKETS/6. Implementation migration/Recurring realisation and library declaration","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F6.%20Implementation%20migration%2FRecurring%20realisation%20and%20library%20declaration","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"2a030f06afc7b69555d7aedaeeb4eea4585e3cfc29c26bd7fa773860f3f38a7a","start_line":918,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":918,"text":"### Recurring realisation and library declaration
"},{"number":919,"text":"
"},{"number":920,"text":"An implementation migration ticket declares whether the active boundary is
"},{"number":921,"text":"rebuilding a pattern locally, consuming an existing reusable library or
"},{"number":922,"text":"commonisation surface, or extending that surface before the local
"},{"number":923,"text":"implementation lands; `library_usage` records which (P2, P4a).
"},{"number":924,"text":"
"},{"number":925,"text":"The recurrence rule is ticket law for every implementation migration
"},{"number":926,"text":"ticket, whichever profiles the Product adopts (P2, P4a): the second
"},{"number":927,"text":"credible recurrence forces an explicit
"},{"number":928,"text":"library or commonisation review; the third local rebuild is not acceptable
"},{"number":929,"text":"by default. If review shows the same realisation pattern already exists in
"},{"number":930,"text":"two module boundaries or tickets, a third local rebuild blocks
"},{"number":931,"text":"implementation unless the ticket declares `library_usage: consume`,
"},{"number":932,"text":"declares `library_usage: extend`, or links an explicit do-not-commonise
"},{"number":933,"text":"design decision in `library_rationale`. The preferred order is
"},{"number":934,"text":"boundary-local cleanup, then a tenant-local reusable library or
"},{"number":935,"text":"commonisation surface, then shared or common propagation only through
"},{"number":936,"text":"separate design re-entry (P2, P3). A Product that adopts DESIGN_MODULE
"},{"number":937,"text":"also applies its refinement,
"},{"number":938,"text":"[§10 Recurrence extraction](DESIGN_MODULE.md#recurrence-extraction),
"},{"number":939,"text":"which makes the same rule a design-review obligation and states what
"},{"number":940,"text":"counts as a commonisation candidate; it adds no rival threshold.
"},{"number":941,"text":"
"},{"number":942,"text":"A reusable pattern discovered during the active ticket remains under the
"},{"number":943,"text":"second- and third-recurrence rules. Outside those rules and the current
"},{"number":944,"text":"claim's applicable hard stops it is repricing input: it does not block the
"},{"number":945,"text":"bounded claim or require a follow-up ticket unless the owning authority
"},{"number":946,"text":"admits that follow-up (P2; §7, Execution and verification authority
"},{"number":947,"text":"separation).
"},{"number":948,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":959,"heading":"TICKETS/6. Implementation migration/Multi-build-tenant review","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F6.%20Implementation%20migration%2FMulti-build-tenant%20review","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"c7cdb336b375244fe6b8e445d1d84abe8ea1633860ec59c454e9e183530bc8e9","start_line":949,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":949,"text":"### Multi-build-tenant review
"},{"number":950,"text":"
"},{"number":951,"text":"When the same work item is processed across several build tenants, review
"},{"number":952,"text":"of backlog and active tickets checks that each tenant has its own suffixed
"},{"number":953,"text":"ticket; each ticket names its `build_tenant`; each tenant ticket has its
"},{"number":954,"text":"own proof surface and closure law; one tenant's green proof does not stand
"},{"number":955,"text":"in for another tenant's closure; and reopening, repricing and successor
"},{"number":956,"text":"work remain tenant-local unless the upstream source, product or design
"},{"number":957,"text":"ticket itself must change (P3, P6;
"},{"number":958,"text":"§4, Multi-build-tenant independence).
"},{"number":959,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":999,"heading":"TICKETS/6. Implementation migration/Review disambiguation","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F6.%20Implementation%20migration%2FReview%20disambiguation","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"290bd8c07e9d6da416d59ec8b7b6729bac8b4008372ed3822b8008ba8fb99843","start_line":960,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":960,"text":"### Review disambiguation
"},{"number":961,"text":"
"},{"number":962,"text":"An implementation migration ticket makes the review problem concrete enough
"},{"number":963,"text":"that an implementor cannot land a rename, adapter, wrapper or happy-path
"},{"number":964,"text":"proof and claim source-truth migration (P6, P1). For a core-interface or
"},{"number":965,"text":"carrier migration the ticket should include a `Functional Review Criteria`
"},{"number":966,"text":"section, specific to the ticket, such that a reviewer should be able to
"},{"number":967,"text":"answer these generic questions:
"},{"number":968,"text":"
"},{"number":969,"text":"1. Did the change replace control-flow-owned meaning with carrier-owned,
"},{"number":970,"text":"   algebra-owned, event-owned or otherwise admitted source truth?
"},{"number":971,"text":"2. Did the change reduce or remove a semantic centre, or only rename and
"},{"number":972,"text":"   relocate it behind helpers?
"},{"number":973,"text":"3. Is the new law expressed as a typed or closed carrier, contract or
"},{"number":974,"text":"   transition family rather than an open dict, string protocol or
"},{"number":975,"text":"   config-shaped surface?
"},{"number":976,"text":"4. Is the main step readable as a pure transform over admitted truth, or
"},{"number":977,"text":"   does it still contain orchestration that decides the law procedurally?
"},{"number":978,"text":"5. Are effects pushed to the edge, such as event emission, manifest
"},{"number":979,"text":"   publication, file or output publication, or operator delivery, instead
"},{"number":980,"text":"   of being mixed into source-truth interpretation?
"},{"number":981,"text":"6. Do downstream consumers pattern-match or otherwise consume the admitted
"},{"number":982,"text":"   carrier directly, or do they reconstruct truth from payloads,
"},{"number":983,"text":"   `.get(...)`, fallback defaults, raw text or legacy files?
"},{"number":984,"text":"7. Are projections and reports derived from event or source truth, or can
"},{"number":985,"text":"   they still close independently as a second authority surface?
"},{"number":986,"text":"8. If deterministic gates, validation or other deterministic checks exist,
"},{"number":987,"text":"   do they inform the current state without structurally blocking the
"},{"number":988,"text":"   lawful constructive or probabilistic path that the admitted contract
"},{"number":989,"text":"   permits?
"},{"number":990,"text":"9. If the same realisation pattern already exists elsewhere, does the
"},{"number":991,"text":"   ticket explicitly consume or extend a reusable library or commonisation
"},{"number":992,"text":"   surface rather than rebuild it locally again?
"},{"number":993,"text":"
"},{"number":994,"text":"Passing tests do not satisfy this section by themselves. A slice that keeps
"},{"number":995,"text":"the same semantic centre alive behind typed wrappers, adapter-local policy,
"},{"number":996,"text":"old lists beside new algebra, fallback config or rehydrated dict payloads
"},{"number":997,"text":"still fails migration review even when public behaviour remains green
"},{"number":998,"text":"(P6).
"},{"number":999,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1034,"heading":"TICKETS/6. Implementation migration/Impacted interface review checklist","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F6.%20Implementation%20migration%2FImpacted%20interface%20review%20checklist","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"ade687d10055180012dea257e3350d7fb04f214fd02f09d61c7974f4bff360ed","start_line":1000,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":1000,"text":"### Impacted interface review checklist
"},{"number":1001,"text":"
"},{"number":1002,"text":"For a core-interface, carrier or authoritative-contract migration, the
"},{"number":1003,"text":"ticket includes an `Impacted Interface Review Checklist` before tests can be
"},{"number":1004,"text":"used as closure evidence. The checklist is a named walk of every live
"},{"number":1005,"text":"interface that can still bypass, reinterpret, replay or project the
"},{"number":1006,"text":"migrating truth path (P4b, P6).
"},{"number":1007,"text":"At minimum it should enumerate, where they exist: the source-carrier builder;
"},{"number":1008,"text":"closure, register and projection builders; the deepest semantic kernel and
"},{"number":1009,"text":"adapter boundaries; public wrappers and the bootstrap, replay, ingest,
"},{"number":1010,"text":"resume and query entrypoints; prompt, report, projection and read-model
"},{"number":1011,"text":"surfaces; constructor and materialisation paths; proof lanes and
"},{"number":1012,"text":"negative-proof fixtures.
"},{"number":1013,"text":"
"},{"number":1014,"text":"Each checklist item states what counts as closure for that interface, for
"},{"number":1015,"text":"example:
"},{"number":1016,"text":"
"},{"number":1017,"text":"- "`<conformance-module>::consume_projection` consumes the admitted carrier
"},{"number":1018,"text":"  or projection and does not import raw helper authority"
"},{"number":1019,"text":"- "`<query-module>::project_domain` exposes a read model only and does not
"},{"number":1020,"text":"  silently rebuild the carrier when publication is absent"
"},{"number":1021,"text":"- "`<gap-module>::build_canonical_gap` does not aggregate open payload rows
"},{"number":1022,"text":"  into an independent closure decision"
"},{"number":1023,"text":"
"},{"number":1024,"text":"Review rules (P6): a checked box asserts truth on the current tree, not
"},{"number":1025,"text":"intended direction; if review shows a checked interface item is false, the
"},{"number":1026,"text":"ticket is not closure-ready; an intentionally deferred interface either
"},{"number":1027,"text":"names its successor ticket or stays unchecked; compatibility shims do not
"},{"number":1028,"text":"satisfy the checklist unless explicitly justified as retained
"},{"number":1029,"text":"compatibility; for `inside_out_hard_break` the checklist describes the
"},{"number":1030,"text":"seam inventory before tests are used as closure evidence; for
"},{"number":1031,"text":"`fundamental_re_adoption` the checklist covers the inherited modules and
"},{"number":1032,"text":"interfaces being carried, dropped or rewritten, and implicit carry-forward
"},{"number":1033,"text":"does not count.
"},{"number":1034,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1063,"heading":"TICKETS/6. Implementation migration/Break order and break-to-closure map","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F6.%20Implementation%20migration%2FBreak%20order%20and%20break-to-closure%20map","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"3837ee8264b1eb9ff96205f05a6ccbd217370445687ea32aff2f0a9c33310845","start_line":1035,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":1035,"text":"### Break order and break-to-closure map
"},{"number":1036,"text":"
"},{"number":1037,"text":"An implementation migration ticket that touches a core interface includes
"},{"number":1038,"text":"a `Required Break Order` or an equivalent ordered execution section. The
"},{"number":1039,"text":"order starts at the authoritative source carrier and moves outward
"},{"number":1040,"text":"(P4b, P6;
"},{"number":1041,"text":"[SPEC_METHOD §7](SPEC_METHOD.md#hard-break-discipline)):
"},{"number":1042,"text":"
"},{"number":1043,"text":"1. discover the full best-guess interface family;
"},{"number":1044,"text":"2. publish or admit the new source carrier;
"},{"number":1045,"text":"3. deliberately sever one old authoritative seam and keep it broken;
"},{"number":1046,"text":"4. rebind the deepest semantic kernel to that carrier;
"},{"number":1047,"text":"5. remove or demote old producers;
"},{"number":1048,"text":"6. rebind old consumers;
"},{"number":1049,"text":"7. reprice projections, reports, prompts, delivery bindings and tests.
"},{"number":1050,"text":"
"},{"number":1051,"text":"When the migration has several old interfaces, the ticket also includes a
"},{"number":1052,"text":"`Break-To-Closure Map` stating which break closes which closure-law clause;
"},{"number":1053,"text":"without it a partial landing can look like a full landing (P6).
"},{"number":1054,"text":"
"},{"number":1055,"text":"Reviewers treat these as explicit defects: a typed wrapper that still
"},{"number":1056,"text":"carries old semantic authority; a new carrier added beside the old
"},{"number":1057,"text":"authoritative read model; a proxy or partial implementation that keeps the
"},{"number":1058,"text":"old interface alive behind a new name; constructor, replay, ingest, resume,
"},{"number":1059,"text":"bootstrap or public-wrapper paths that bypass admission; a projection or
"},{"number":1060,"text":"test that can pass without the new carrier; a fallback path that invents
"},{"number":1061,"text":"missing policy, identity, target or closure truth; a downstream proof that
"},{"number":1062,"text":"passes while upstream source-carrier work remains open (P6, P3).
"},{"number":1063,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1092,"heading":"TICKETS/6. Implementation migration/Mixed-state negative proof","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F6.%20Implementation%20migration%2FMixed-state%20negative%20proof","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"f1b4016c40a4d7522030fe43d8c1d25ca418ebe5e67c27b321cc50c3b961f091","start_line":1064,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":1064,"text":"### Mixed-state negative proof
"},{"number":1065,"text":"
"},{"number":1066,"text":"For a migration ticket, positive behaviour proof is not enough. The proof
"},{"number":1067,"text":"surface should include at least one negative or structural proof that
"},{"number":1068,"text":"the old path can no longer satisfy the closure law (P6, P5). Examples: the severed seam in the current
"},{"number":1069,"text":"break is rejected before downstream repair is accepted as progress;
"},{"number":1070,"text":"removing the new carrier makes advancement, closure, prompt assembly or
"},{"number":1071,"text":"projection fail closed rather than silently fall back; a legacy payload
"},{"number":1072,"text":"without the admitted carrier is rejected instead of rehydrated into current
"},{"number":1073,"text":"truth; old and new truth intentionally disagree in a fixture and the new
"},{"number":1074,"text":"truth wins or the run fails closed; a same-name carrier, published
"},{"number":1075,"text":"function, route, policy or projection source with different structure fails
"},{"number":1076,"text":"closed instead of being accepted as equivalent; required closure proof
"},{"number":1077,"text":"does not depend on undeclared local fixtures or mutable sibling workspaces.
"},{"number":1078,"text":"
"},{"number":1079,"text":"If the old path still works in normal execution within the declared
"},{"number":1080,"text":"affected scope, or remains reachable on the claimed acceptance path, the
"},{"number":1081,"text":"ticket remains open unless that path is explicitly specified as retained
"},{"number":1082,"text":"compatibility. A deterministically routed, non-overlapping product scope
"},{"number":1083,"text":"outside the declared affected scope remains governed by its own current
"},{"number":1084,"text":"authority and does not block the migration merely because its path still
"},{"number":1085,"text":"works (P3, P6).
"},{"number":1086,"text":"
"},{"number":1087,"text":"For a ticket with an `Impacted Interface Review Checklist`, the negative
"},{"number":1088,"text":"proof exercises the named public consumers that matter for closure. Proving
"},{"number":1089,"text":"that one legacy shim is bypassed is not sufficient when the live authority
"},{"number":1090,"text":"path already bypasses that shim through other helpers, loaders or rebuild
"},{"number":1091,"text":"paths (P4b, P6).
"},{"number":1092,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1102,"heading":"TICKETS/7. Authority, judgment, closure and state","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F7.%20Authority%2C%20judgment%2C%20closure%20and%20state","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"02ecd3b5b8cbf7fa38d06e7b9c8ab5cf0abf185a5fbb669510e34fe0d6330ea9","start_line":1093,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":1093,"text":"## 7. Authority, judgment, closure and state
"},{"number":1094,"text":"
"},{"number":1095,"text":"The generic law is tier 1: a constructor's self-review is construction
"},{"number":1096,"text":"output and the independent-assessment protocol is
"},{"number":1097,"text":"[EVALUATION §3](EVALUATION.md#3-independent-assessment); acceptance as the
"},{"number":1098,"text":"decision owner's disposition, and closure by stated condition rather than
"},{"number":1099,"text":"by reviewer approval, is [EVALUATION §5](EVALUATION.md#5-acceptance); reuse
"},{"number":1100,"text":"of a closed result is [ACTIVATION §7](ACTIVATION.md#7-closed-result-and-reuse).
"},{"number":1101,"text":"This section states what those laws require of work carriers.
"},{"number":1102,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1160,"heading":"TICKETS/7. Authority, judgment, closure and state/Execution and verification authority separation (UP-007)","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F7.%20Authority%2C%20judgment%2C%20closure%20and%20state%2FExecution%20and%20verification%20authority%20separation%20%28UP-007%29","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"1c3a94a3c83e769658d633172e58ff43d9e2f5f8738549726fe3e1f38e9b0376","start_line":1103,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":1103,"text":"### Execution and verification authority separation (UP-007)
"},{"number":1104,"text":"
"},{"number":1105,"text":"Authority to author or implement a change is not independent authority to
"},{"number":1106,"text":"verify it. What counts as independent, including that the reviewer is
"},{"number":1107,"text":"not the author of the reviewed subject, and the protocol an independent
"},{"number":1108,"text":"assessment follows are
"},{"number":1109,"text":"[EVALUATION §3](EVALUATION.md#3-independent-assessment). Where
"},{"number":1110,"text":"independent review is required, the reviewer identifies the exact
"},{"number":1111,"text":"subject, basis, scope, exclusions, evidence, verdict and unresolved
"},{"number":1112,"text":"findings (P6). Review
"},{"number":1113,"text":"findings must cite current authority and the code or proof paths they
"},{"number":1114,"text":"rest on, not only historical commentary (P6, P1).
"},{"number":1115,"text":"
"},{"number":1116,"text":"Self-review remains useful authoring evidence and cannot be relabelled as
"},{"number":1117,"text":"independent. Human authority may accept or reject the claim; it does not
"},{"number":1118,"text":"make implementer self-review independent. The boundaries at which this
"},{"number":1119,"text":"method requires independent assessment are this member's policy, which
"},{"number":1120,"text":"EVALUATION §3 names; a governing basis may add others, as that section
"},{"number":1121,"text":"states. Independent review is required at
"},{"number":1122,"text":"product, qualification, release and explicitly risk-bearing boundaries that
"},{"number":1123,"text":"claim it, not for every local implementation step (P6, P2).
"},{"number":1124,"text":"
"},{"number":1125,"text":"A claimed independent review may support promotion or closure only when its
"},{"number":1126,"text":"exact subject and verdict are durably traceable through an existing ticket,
"},{"number":1127,"text":"commentary, qualification or release-evidence carrier. A statement that
"},{"number":1128,"text":"review occurred, an unbound conversation summary or an unavailable draft is
"},{"number":1129,"text":"not the review verdict. This rule requires no separate receipt, carrier or
"},{"number":1130,"text":"review round (P6, P4b).
"},{"number":1131,"text":"
"},{"number":1132,"text":"A ticket's review verdict is bounded by the exact reviewed claim and its
"},{"number":1133,"text":"applicable hard stops. When a finding blocks current promotion, and what a
"},{"number":1134,"text":"valid observation outside that boundary does, are stated once at
"},{"number":1135,"text":"[EVALUATION §5 When a finding blocks promotion](EVALUATION.md#when-a-finding-blocks-promotion);
"},{"number":1136,"text":"this carrier applies that section to a ticket's review and adds no
"},{"number":1137,"text":"trigger (P2, P6).
"},{"number":1138,"text":"
"},{"number":1139,"text":"A direct or lawfully proxied human ruling receives a durable disposition
"},{"number":1140,"text":"before the next affected acceptance boundary. Its source wording stays
"},{"number":1141,"text":"distinct from agent interpretation. Opening a ticket records the
"},{"number":1142,"text":"obligation and does not satisfy it, and an agent cannot widen the ruling
"},{"number":1143,"text":"while recording it (P6, P4b).
"},{"number":1144,"text":"
"},{"number":1145,"text":"Where the agentic construction relation applies (ACTIVATION §1, bound to
"},{"number":1146,"text":"this method by [SPEC_METHOD §8](SPEC_METHOD.md#8-bounded-execution-in-this-method)),
"},{"number":1147,"text":"the active work item identifies the selected execution basis, the bounded
"},{"number":1148,"text":"affected relation set, the delegated construction and assessment authority,
"},{"number":1149,"text":"and the re-entry conditions. It may point to accepted design and existing
"},{"number":1150,"text":"evidence carriers rather than restate them. Ticket state, ticket prose or
"},{"number":1151,"text":"an admitted execution contract cannot widen that basis or substitute for
"},{"number":1152,"text":"the live-surface assessment the relation requires (P6, P0).
"},{"number":1153,"text":"
"},{"number":1154,"text":"The reviewable transition (ACTIVATION §7, Transition evidence) may be
"},{"number":1155,"text":"carried by an existing ticket, commentary, commit, qualification or
"},{"number":1156,"text":"release-evidence surface. No new ticket state, document type, review round
"},{"number":1157,"text":"or approval ceremony is required. This member carries selection and
"},{"number":1158,"text":"traceability; ACTIVATION §1 and SPEC_METHOD §8 own the execution semantics
"},{"number":1159,"text":"(P2, P6).
"},{"number":1160,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1248,"heading":"TICKETS/7. Authority, judgment, closure and state/Recorded judgment and owner-ruling continuity","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F7.%20Authority%2C%20judgment%2C%20closure%20and%20state%2FRecorded%20judgment%20and%20owner-ruling%20continuity","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"a4d9b8e04f0ca62538f6450df06f54b15ec2047f6442d9a765f484fe934d8617","start_line":1161,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":1161,"text":"### Recorded judgment and owner-ruling continuity
"},{"number":1162,"text":"
"},{"number":1163,"text":"A residual judgment that another activation needs is recorded once, with
"},{"number":1164,"text":"its owning work, in the existing carrier selected under §5. The record
"},{"number":1165,"text":"identifies the question; the exact subject and governing basis; the
"},{"number":1166,"text":"supporting computed facts and evidence; the responsible actor and its
"},{"number":1167,"text":"authority; the conclusion and its scope; the uncertainty; and a concrete
"},{"number":1168,"text":"revising observation that lets a consumer determine whether the conclusion
"},{"number":1169,"text":"still applies. A question settled by rule needs no invented J record (P4b,
"},{"number":1170,"text":"P6; C, J and O are
"},{"number":1171,"text":"the annotations of [SPEC_METHOD §4](SPEC_METHOD.md#computed-classification-and-treatment)).
"},{"number":1172,"text":"
"},{"number":1173,"text":"Later roles and resumed runs recover the result and check its
"},{"number":1174,"text":"applicability rather than re-author unchanged judgment. Reuse and
"},{"number":1175,"text":"invalidation are
"},{"number":1176,"text":"[ACTIVATION §7](ACTIVATION.md#7-closed-result-and-reuse): changed material
"},{"number":1177,"text":"inputs, a declared revising observation or a changed basis invalidate
"},{"number":1178,"text":"the affected result, preserving the original result and its successor
"},{"number":1179,"text":"relation and keeping only demonstrably independent results, and a new
"},{"number":1180,"text":"role or conversation alone invalidates nothing. For a recorded judgment
"},{"number":1181,"text":"the material inputs include its supporting computed facts and evidence,
"},{"number":1182,"text":"and its declared revising observation is the one the record states;
"},{"number":1183,"text":"reassessment covers what the change affects. The result may reference
"},{"number":1184,"text":"current C outputs; reuse cannot silently turn unknown facts into
"},{"number":1185,"text":"established premises (P4b, P5). Required independent assessment may consume valid C, but
"},{"number":1186,"text":"its assessor acquires sufficient exact evidence and supplies its own
"},{"number":1187,"text":"judgment under the actual independence condition; reusing the author's J
"},{"number":1188,"text":"cannot satisfy that condition (P6; EVALUATION §3).
"},{"number":1189,"text":"
"},{"number":1190,"text":"A direct or lawfully proxied owner ruling is recorded in its original
"},{"number":1191,"text":"wording, with its owner, exact subject and basis, permitted scope and
"},{"number":1192,"text":"effects, conditions and source, separately from agent interpretation. Later
"},{"number":1193,"text":"work consumes that same ruling while it applies; it neither widens the
"},{"number":1194,"text":"ruling nor requests unchanged authority again. New ambiguity or a
"},{"number":1195,"text":"materially changed decision returns only the affected question to its
"},{"number":1196,"text":"owner. J is not O, and recording either cannot create admission,
"},{"number":1197,"text":"acceptance, effects or continuation beyond the original grant (P6, P3).
"},{"number":1198,"text":"
"},{"number":1199,"text":"These results follow the lifetime of the existing run, sprint or durable
"},{"number":1200,"text":"ticket and its named result and evidence surface. They require no separate
"},{"number":1201,"text":"judgment registry, no ticket per judgment and no additional approval
"},{"number":1202,"text":"ceremony (P2).
"},{"number":1203,"text":"
"},{"number":1204,"text":"Repricing gives each affected obligation a disposition in that same
"},{"number":1205,"text":"carrier: retained, superseded, deferred or withdrawn, with its owning
"},{"number":1206,"text":"authority and applicable evidence links. Surviving work is preserved and
"},{"number":1207,"text":"changed dependencies are explained; unaffected history is not copied into
"},{"number":1208,"text":"a parallel ledger. An owner decision is presented as the short consequence
"},{"number":1209,"text":"delta needed to decide it, with the original ruling preserved separately.
"},{"number":1210,"text":"A general instruction to continue does not accept an undisclosed
"},{"number":1211,"text":"architectural or scope change (P4b, P6, P2).
"},{"number":1212,"text":"
"},{"number":1213,"text":"The four repricing dispositions are lifecycle states of an obligation,
"},{"number":1214,"text":"set by its owning authority. A state label is not an evaluation result and
"},{"number":1215,"text":"has no automatic core mapping. A material repricing decision is the separate
"},{"number":1216,"text":"owner decision that establishes one such state for an exact obligation,
"},{"number":1217,"text":"subject and basis. Its record names the chosen disposition, the decision
"},{"number":1218,"text":"owner and grant, the governing conditions, evidence, affected dependencies,
"},{"number":1219,"text":"remaining obligations and any conditions for revisiting the decision (P3,
"},{"number":1220,"text":"P4b, P6).
"},{"number":1221,"text":"
"},{"number":1222,"text":"A performed evaluation of that decision answers the predicate: **the named
"},{"number":1223,"text":"owner lawfully establishes the recorded disposition for this exact
"},{"number":1224,"text":"obligation, subject and basis, with every applicable condition satisfied
"},{"number":1225,"text":"and every surviving obligation preserved.** This is the repricing predicate
"},{"number":1226,"text":"owned here; it is not candidate acceptance under
"},{"number":1227,"text":"[ACTIVATION §3 Disposition](ACTIVATION.md#disposition), and it does not claim
"},{"number":1228,"text":"that the underlying work was delivered. The result retains the decision,
"},{"number":1229,"text":"its chosen state and its evidence, and refines the core values of
"},{"number":1230,"text":"[FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results) as follows:
"},{"number":1231,"text":"
"},{"number":1232,"text":"| Repricing result | Core value | Meaning for the repricing predicate |
"},{"number":1233,"text":"|---|---|---|
"},{"number":1234,"text":"| `repricing_established` | satisfied | the exact applicable owner decision, authority, evidence and preservation of surviving obligations establish the predicate |
"},{"number":1235,"text":"| `repricing_falsified` | falsified | a counterexample defeats the predicate, including a disposition outside the actor's grant or contrary to an applicable obligation |
"},{"number":1236,"text":"| `repricing_indeterminate` | indeterminate | admissible evidence cannot decide whether the decision meets an applicable condition; the undecided condition and needed evidence remain explicit |
"},{"number":1237,"text":"| `repricing_out_of_frame` | out_of_frame | a material relation or capability needed to evaluate the decision is undeclared in the frame; the missing relation or capability remains explicit |
"},{"number":1238,"text":"| `repricing_invalid_basis` | invalid_basis | the decision is evaluated on an absent, stale, ambiguous or mismatched required basis that cannot support the predicate |
"},{"number":1239,"text":"
"},{"number":1240,"text":"An evaluation that was not performed has no result. The evaluation records
"},{"number":1241,"text":"all applicable failure grounds and supplies no decision authority; the
"},{"number":1242,"text":"state changes only through the owner's authorised act. A lawful deferral
"},{"number":1243,"text":"may therefore yield `repricing_established` while the delivery claim remains
"},{"number":1244,"text":"failed or outstanding. An unauthorised `withdrawn` label cannot close an
"},{"number":1245,"text":"obligation. Neither retention nor a satisfied repricing predicate establishes
"},{"number":1246,"text":"delivery, and a superseded, deferred or withdrawn state cannot erase
"},{"number":1247,"text":"unresolved obligations or evidence (P5, P1, P6).
"},{"number":1248,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1291,"heading":"TICKETS/7. Authority, judgment, closure and state/Condition-based closure and reuse","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F7.%20Authority%2C%20judgment%2C%20closure%20and%20state%2FCondition-based%20closure%20and%20reuse","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"0a2cce28b1ba79c864157e0c98ccb38caee7f37f297a2dd4940a71964fc36987","start_line":1249,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":1249,"text":"### Condition-based closure and reuse
"},{"number":1250,"text":"
"},{"number":1251,"text":"A work claim is complete only when every applicable declared obligation is
"},{"number":1252,"text":"satisfied by valid evidence for its exact subject, basis and scope; every
"},{"number":1253,"text":"required judgment and owner ruling is present and applicable; and no active
"},{"number":1254,"text":"non-closure condition remains. A mandatory obligation whose applicability is
"},{"number":1255,"text":"unknown, or whose evidence is insufficient, withholds the dependent claim;
"},{"number":1256,"text":"evidence presence alone is not satisfaction. The existing owner decides any
"},{"number":1257,"text":"reserved acceptance (P6, P5).
"},{"number":1258,"text":"This condition is the
"},{"number":1259,"text":"[conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results) with the
"},{"number":1260,"text":"declared obligations as required coverage. This section owns the
"},{"number":1261,"text":"closure condition of a work claim;
"},{"number":1262,"text":"[SPEC_METHOD §4 Consistency gate](SPEC_METHOD.md#consistency-gate)
"},{"number":1263,"text":"applies it as the gate over a declared change span.
"},{"number":1264,"text":"
"},{"number":1265,"text":"Review evaluates these conditions; its occurrence is not the closing event.
"},{"number":1266,"text":"Where applicable law requires no independent review or reserved
"},{"number":1267,"text":"acceptance, a work claim is recorded as
"},{"number":1268,"text":"[ACTIVATION §1 Roles and delegation](ACTIVATION.md#roles-and-delegation)
"},{"number":1269,"text":"states in Recording a result without review, with the ticket as the
"},{"number":1270,"text":"existing carrier. The conditions that still apply include sprint-close
"},{"number":1271,"text":"law (§3) and the design profile's law (P6, P2).
"},{"number":1272,"text":"
"},{"number":1273,"text":"An unchanged obligation reuses valid applicable evidence and recorded J
"},{"number":1274,"text":"and O under the reuse rule of
"},{"number":1275,"text":"[ACTIVATION §7](ACTIVATION.md#7-closed-result-and-reuse). For a work
"},{"number":1276,"text":"claim, the changed material inputs and revising observations that rule
"},{"number":1277,"text":"names include a material counterexample, changed evidence and a stated
"},{"number":1278,"text":"revising observation of a recorded J; with a changed basis, each
"},{"number":1279,"text":"invalidates the affected claim and its dependent results before further
"},{"number":1280,"text":"reliance. An unrelated observation is retained as bounded repricing input;
"},{"number":1281,"text":"it does not reopen a satisfied claim or expand the work automatically.
"},{"number":1282,"text":"Closure recording preserves the exact evaluated scope, the satisfied
"},{"number":1283,"text":"conditions, the evidence and the remaining residuals (P4b, P2).
"},{"number":1284,"text":"
"},{"number":1285,"text":"Landing a candidate and releasing it are distinct from this condition; apply
"},{"number":1286,"text":"[EVALUATION §5](EVALUATION.md#landing-closure-and-release) and any explicitly
"},{"number":1287,"text":"declared Product acceptance gate. An open required review withholds the work
"},{"number":1288,"text":"claim that depends on its complete coverage, not an independently authorized
"},{"number":1289,"text":"landing merely because review is open. Keep the linked Bug items and their
"},{"number":1290,"text":"verification provenance current; a report's existence closes none of them.
"},{"number":1291,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1337,"heading":"TICKETS/7. Authority, judgment, closure and state/Test case authority","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F7.%20Authority%2C%20judgment%2C%20closure%20and%20state%2FTest%20case%20authority","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"b27ac901dd5b38dd7c610b0f8620ff080feaeee5a494e03ef84e7b883246d741","start_line":1292,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":1292,"text":"### Test case authority
"},{"number":1293,"text":"
"},{"number":1294,"text":"Tests are proof projections from admitted work authority. Every
"},{"number":1295,"text":"substantive test case should derive along this chain (P6, P2):
"},{"number":1296,"text":"
"},{"number":1297,"text":"```text
"},{"number":1298,"text":"ticket -> intake triage -> lawful re-entry point -> governing requirement,
"},{"number":1299,"text":"design, module, published function, carrier, or closure surface -> test expectation
"},{"number":1300,"text":"```
"},{"number":1301,"text":"
"},{"number":1302,"text":"Tests do not derive authority from the current implementation. An
"},{"number":1303,"text":"acceptance predicate also needs an applicable supported entry or state and
"},{"number":1304,"text":"an obligation under the governing operating or threat model. Existing test
"},{"number":1305,"text":"presence cannot authorise an excluded threat or retain a superseded guard.
"},{"number":1306,"text":"When that responsibility changes, the affected predicates are audited, and
"},{"number":1307,"text":"unsupported expectations are retired under the owning basis without
"},{"number":1308,"text":"inventing a replacement guard. An actual conflict in live authority
"},{"number":1309,"text":"requires re-entry, not a test-only waiver (P6, P2).
"},{"number":1310,"text":"
"},{"number":1311,"text":"Implementation behaviour is evidence. The code is never the arbiter of a
"},{"number":1312,"text":"test's expected result when code and test disagree (P6). When a ticket is
"},{"number":1313,"text":"fixed and a mismatch appears between implementation behaviour and test
"},{"number":1314,"text":"expectation, review reconciles the mismatch in this order:
"},{"number":1315,"text":"
"},{"number":1316,"text":"1. the ticket's `change_intent`, `change_class`, `re_entry_point`,
"},{"number":1317,"text":"   `target_truth`, `superseded_truth`, `closure_law`,
"},{"number":1318,"text":"   `evaluation_criteria` and `non_closure_conditions`;
"},{"number":1319,"text":"2. the ticket's intake triage and lawful owning re-entry;
"},{"number":1320,"text":"3. the governing requirement, design, module, published-function, carrier
"},{"number":1321,"text":"   or other cited authority surface;
"},{"number":1322,"text":"4. the test case expectation;
"},{"number":1323,"text":"5. the implementation.
"},{"number":1324,"text":"
"},{"number":1325,"text":"The implementation may show that a test is stale, incomplete or too
"},{"number":1326,"text":"narrow; it cannot by itself authorise changing the expected result.
"},{"number":1327,"text":"Changing a test only because the current code behaves differently is a
"},{"number":1328,"text":"ticket-method defect. A test that predates a lawful ticket repricing is
"},{"number":1329,"text":"updated or removed only after naming the governing ticket and the authority
"},{"number":1330,"text":"change that superseded the old expectation. If the ticket is stale,
"},{"number":1331,"text":"ambiguous or missing the authority needed to decide the expectation, the
"},{"number":1332,"text":"work re-enters triage (§4) before either the code or the test is treated as
"},{"number":1333,"text":"correct. A passing test is closure evidence only when its expectation
"},{"number":1334,"text":"traces back to the admitted ticket and its governing authority chain (P6,
"},{"number":1335,"text":"P4b). The general test authority law is ASSURANCE §3; this clause is its
"},{"number":1336,"text":"ticket-local rule.
"},{"number":1337,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1351,"heading":"TICKETS/7. Authority, judgment, closure and state/One-truth state projection and drift refusal (UP-009)","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F7.%20Authority%2C%20judgment%2C%20closure%20and%20state%2FOne-truth%20state%20projection%20and%20drift%20refusal%20%28UP-009%29","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"f357c47475b889816fa54923f6dab1ac20693f0e64c6e859bd9d60c58c67af73","start_line":1338,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":1338,"text":"### One-truth state projection and drift refusal (UP-009)
"},{"number":1339,"text":"
"},{"number":1340,"text":"Work state has one authority chain: goals own the bounded work wave, the
"},{"number":1341,"text":"ticket owns ticket state, milestone authority owns subordinate milestone
"},{"number":1342,"text":"state (§1), and accepted design owns realisation decisions. Comments,
"},{"number":1343,"text":"dashboards, registers, indexes and generated summaries are projections
"},{"number":1344,"text":"(P6, P3).
"},{"number":1345,"text":"
"},{"number":1346,"text":"Recency, visibility or repetition does not turn a projection into truth.
"},{"number":1347,"text":"Contradiction between the owning ticket, its required milestones, the
"},{"number":1348,"text":"current goals or the cited acceptance evidence blocks closure. Superseded
"},{"number":1349,"text":"evidence remains history and cannot be projected as current acceptance
"},{"number":1350,"text":"(P6, P4b).
"},{"number":1351,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1506,"heading":"TICKETS/8. Recommended shapes","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F8.%20Recommended%20shapes","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"a96542d5b5013b9716760128b49bdd910b1bcff4355af6ba8a38803b8561baee","start_line":1352,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":1352,"text":"## 8. Recommended shapes
