"},{"number":1353,"text":"
"},{"number":1354,"text":"These shapes are the recommended carriers of the fields and sections the
"},{"number":1355,"text":"rules above require; a project may bind another shape that carries the
"},{"number":1356,"text":"same fields (§2; P3, P4b).
"},{"number":1357,"text":"
"},{"number":1358,"text":"The sprint manifest, carrying the fields of §3:
"},{"number":1359,"text":"
"},{"number":1360,"text":"```md
"},{"number":1361,"text":"# SPRINT-2026-04-30 Operational Projection UX Iteration
"},{"number":1362,"text":"
"},{"number":1363,"text":"- id: SPRINT-2026-04-30-operational-projection
"},{"number":1364,"text":"- status: active
"},{"number":1365,"text":"- goal: operational-projection-ux
"},{"number":1366,"text":"- opened_at: 2026-04-30T09:00:00Z
"},{"number":1367,"text":"- updated_at: 2026-04-30T09:00:00Z
"},{"number":1368,"text":"
"},{"number":1369,"text":"## Authority
"},{"number":1370,"text":"
"},{"number":1371,"text":"- specification/GOALS.md#operational-projection-ux
"},{"number":1372,"text":"- specification/PRODUCT.md#operational-projection
"},{"number":1373,"text":"- <governing-design-surface>/OPERATIONAL_PROJECTION.md
"},{"number":1374,"text":"
"},{"number":1375,"text":"## Scope
"},{"number":1376,"text":"
"},{"number":1377,"text":"Iterate an operational projection surface for layout, readability,
"},{"number":1378,"text":"interaction affordance, and visual evidence quality.
"},{"number":1379,"text":"
"},{"number":1380,"text":"## Excluded Boundaries
"},{"number":1381,"text":"
"},{"number":1382,"text":"- no product truth changes
"},{"number":1383,"text":"- no data contract changes
"},{"number":1384,"text":"- no runtime or governance semantics changes
"},{"number":1385,"text":"- no new constructive carrier
"},{"number":1386,"text":"
"},{"number":1387,"text":"## Expected Change Classes
"},{"number":1388,"text":"
"},{"number":1389,"text":"- realization_refactor
"},{"number":1390,"text":"
"},{"number":1391,"text":"## Iterations
"},{"number":1392,"text":"
"},{"number":1393,"text":"- id: UXI-001
"},{"number":1394,"text":"  intent: improve relation-line readability
"},{"number":1395,"text":"  evidence_ref: screenshots/2026-04-30/UXI-001.png
"},{"number":1396,"text":"  debt: accessibility contrast check pending
"},{"number":1397,"text":"
"},{"number":1398,"text":"## Closure
"},{"number":1399,"text":"
"},{"number":1400,"text":"- closure_trigger: timebox, changed surface volume, or design-lead close request
"},{"number":1401,"text":"- closure_law: forensic walkthrough reviews each changed state against authority
"},{"number":1402,"text":"- proof_surface: screenshots plus walkthrough notes
"},{"number":1403,"text":"- deferred_compliance: screenshots, accessibility check, event-replay review
"},{"number":1404,"text":"- non_closure_conditions: product truth or data contract drift remains hidden
"},{"number":1405,"text":"- paydown_policy: open paydown tickets for accepted local debt; reprice authority drift
"},{"number":1406,"text":"```
"},{"number":1407,"text":"
"},{"number":1408,"text":"An ordinary ticket, carrying the required fields and triage metadata of §4:
"},{"number":1409,"text":"
"},{"number":1410,"text":"```md
"},{"number":1411,"text":"# T-001 Add Product Layer To SPEC_METHOD
"},{"number":1412,"text":"
"},{"number":1413,"text":"- id: T-001
"},{"number":1414,"text":"- type: feature
"},{"number":1415,"text":"- ticket_category: ordinary
"},{"number":1416,"text":"- status: active
"},{"number":1417,"text":"- goal: methodology-bootstrap
"},{"number":1418,"text":"- change_intent: make the product-definition layer explicit in the constitutional chain
"},{"number":1419,"text":"- change_class: product_reprice
"},{"number":1420,"text":"- re_entry_point: product
"},{"number":1421,"text":"- triaged_at: 2026-04-07
"},{"number":1422,"text":"- priority: high
"},{"number":1423,"text":"- created_at: 2026-04-07
"},{"number":1424,"text":"- updated_at: 2026-04-07
"},{"number":1425,"text":"
"},{"number":1426,"text":"## Context
"},{"number":1427,"text":"
"},{"number":1428,"text":"`SPEC_METHOD.md` included intent and requirements flow but omitted the explicit
"},{"number":1429,"text":"product-definition layer.
"},{"number":1430,"text":"
"},{"number":1431,"text":"## Acceptance
"},{"number":1432,"text":"
"},{"number":1433,"text":"- `PRODUCT.md` is part of the constitutional chain
"},{"number":1434,"text":"- bootstrap sequence includes `intent -> product -> requirements`
"},{"number":1435,"text":"- examples and reconstruction logic reflect the new layer
"},{"number":1436,"text":"
"},{"number":1437,"text":"## Links
"},{"number":1438,"text":"
"},{"number":1439,"text":"- comment: `.ai-workspace/comments/<agent-id>/...`
"},{"number":1440,"text":"
"},{"number":1441,"text":"## Bug items
"},{"number":1442,"text":"
"},{"number":1443,"text":"Only when findings exist; use one row per triaged finding. The source report
"},{"number":1444,"text":"owns the original assessment. The decision owner owns this item's priority
"},{"number":1445,"text":"and disposition.
"},{"number":1446,"text":"
"},{"number":1447,"text":"| ID | Source report/finding | Severity | Priority and reason | Cause group / owner | State | Repair subject / verification evidence | Disposition / retained destination |
"},{"number":1448,"text":"|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
"},{"number":1449,"text":"| <item> | <exact report and finding> | <unchanged grade> | <decision> | <cause and owner> | <open/fixed/verified> | <identity; tests; required review if any> | <exact decision and link> |
"},{"number":1450,"text":"```
"},{"number":1451,"text":"
"},{"number":1452,"text":"An implementation migration ticket, carrying the declaration, fields and
"},{"number":1453,"text":"checklist of §6:
"},{"number":1454,"text":"
"},{"number":1455,"text":"```md
"},{"number":1456,"text":"# B-010 Replace Mixed Gap Projection With One Authoritative Carrier
"},{"number":1457,"text":"
"},{"number":1458,"text":"- id: B-010
"},{"number":1459,"text":"- type: bug
"},{"number":1460,"text":"- ticket_category: implementation_migration
"},{"number":1461,"text":"- migration_strategy: inside_out_hard_break
"},{"number":1462,"text":"- library_usage: none
"},{"number":1463,"text":"- library_rationale: this migration is boundary-specific and does not establish a recurring realization pattern
"},{"number":1464,"text":"- status: active
"},{"number":1465,"text":"- goal: operator-gap-truth
"},{"number":1466,"text":"- change_intent: replace the mixed operator gap truth with one authoritative declared carrier
"},{"number":1467,"text":"- change_class: design_reframe
"},{"number":1468,"text":"- re_entry_point: design_surface
"},{"number":1469,"text":"- triaged_at: 2026-04-20
"},{"number":1470,"text":"- created_at: 2026-04-20
"},{"number":1471,"text":"- updated_at: 2026-04-20
"},{"number":1472,"text":"
"},{"number":1473,"text":"## Migration Declaration
"},{"number":1474,"text":"
"},{"number":1475,"text":"- affected_scope: gap projection on the declared operator-query acceptance path
"},{"number":1476,"text":"- excluded_or_disjoint_scopes: none
"},{"number":1477,"text":"- old_truth_path: fallback gap projection with synthetic convergence fields
"},{"number":1478,"text":"- new_truth_path: explicit declared-obligation projection plus separately classified fallback gaps
"},{"number":1479,"text":"- producers_old: `<gap-module>::build_fallback_gap`
"},{"number":1480,"text":"- producers_new: `<obligation-module>::collect_declared_obligations`, `<gap-module>::build_canonical_gap`
"},{"number":1481,"text":"- consumers_old: `<query-module>::project_gaps`, `<summary-module>::project_span`, `<review-surface>::render`
"},{"number":1482,"text":"- consumers_new: `<query-module>::project_gaps`, `<summary-module>::project_span`, `<review-surface>::render`
"},{"number":1483,"text":"- derived_surfaces:
"},{"number":1484,"text":"  - `<query-surface>::gaps`
"},{"number":1485,"text":"  - `<summary-surface>::span`
"},{"number":1486,"text":"  - `<proof-surface>::first_slice_negative`
"},{"number":1487,"text":"- closure_law: migration closes only when the old projection is no longer authoritative within the affected scope and mixed old/new proof does not count as acceptance
"},{"number":1488,"text":"
"},{"number":1489,"text":"## Migration Checklist
"},{"number":1490,"text":"
"},{"number":1491,"text":"- [ ] exact affected migration scope is named
"},{"number":1492,"text":"- [ ] excluded or disjoint Product and compatibility scopes are named with deterministic routing, or explicitly declared absent
"},{"number":1493,"text":"- [ ] old truth path is named explicitly
"},{"number":1494,"text":"- [ ] new truth path is named explicitly
"},{"number":1495,"text":"- [ ] producer set for the new truth is listed
"},{"number":1496,"text":"- [ ] consumer set for the new truth is listed
"},{"number":1497,"text":"- [ ] projection/read-model surfaces are listed
"},{"number":1498,"text":"- [ ] old truth path is removed or explicitly demoted from authority within the affected scope
"},{"number":1499,"text":"- [ ] mixed-state behavior is no longer accepted as closure evidence
"},{"number":1500,"text":"- [ ] tests proving mixed old/new behavior are removed or repriced
"},{"number":1501,"text":"- [ ] recurring realization patterns are checked against existing library/commonization surfaces
"},{"number":1502,"text":"- [ ] ticket declares library usage and names the governing library or rationale
"},{"number":1503,"text":"- [ ] if the work exists in more than one build tenant, this backlog/active ticket carries only one tenant lifecycle and any sibling tenant work lives on its own suffixed ticket
"},{"number":1504,"text":"- [ ] ticket wording, product wording, and proof claims are reconciled before closure
"},{"number":1505,"text":"```
"},{"number":1506,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1508,"heading":"TICKETS/9. "},{"number":1510,"text":"
"},{"number":1511,"text":"The default local-file carrier assumes that humans and agents can read the
"},{"number":1512,"text":"active ticket folder directly; that backlog remains searchable durable work
"},{"number":1513,"text":"without competing with the active lane for immediate attention; that `rg`
"},{"number":1514,"text":"is sufficient for finding active work; and that no database or board is
"},{"number":1515,"text":"required (P0, P2). Typical commands for that carrier:
"},{"number":1516,"text":"
"},{"number":1517,"text":"```bash
"},{"number":1518,"text":"rg -n "^#|^- status:|^- type:|^- goal:".ai-workspace/tickets/active
"},{"number":1519,"text":"rg -n "^#|^- status:|^- type:|^- goal:".ai-workspace/tickets/backlog
"},{"number":1520,"text":"rg -n "T-001|B-002".ai-workspace/tickets
"},{"number":1521,"text":"```
"},{"number":1522,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":1535,"heading":"TICKETS/9. Operating mode and relationships/Relationship to other surfaces","id":"urn:a-c:project:5bcf52450b2eb5c71c94b0ed1f28fa0723e570793522f6f36f095a7cf8b520d3/source/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md#TICKETS%2F9.%20Operating%20mode%20and%20relationships%2FRelationship%20to%20other%20surfaces","path":"build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","sha256":"d79c927af92420962f729eef172cbe1804d9e6c44b6e1a8c2a997d0ae2610958","start_line":1523,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology-3.1-rc3/stdo_representation/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/run/generation/corpus/build_tenants/a_c/representation/stdo-v3.1.0-rc.3/source/standards/TICKETS.md","lines":[{"number":1523,"text":"### Relationship to other surfaces
"},{"number":1524,"text":"
"},{"number":1525,"text":"Each surface answers one question (P3, P6). The goals surface: what broad work wave
"},{"number":1526,"text":"matters now. SPEC_METHOD: what constitutional change class and re-entry
"},{"number":1527,"text":"point govern the work. Sprints: what bounded execution batch is currently
"},{"number":1528,"text":"pricing proof, evidence and paydown. Tickets: what durable units of work
"},{"number":1529,"text":"exist and what state they are in. Comments: what was proposed, argued,
"},{"number":1530,"text":"decided, reviewed or handed off. POSTING_GUIDE: how comment-layer
"},{"number":1531,"text":"publications are structured and named.
"},{"number":1532,"text":"
"},{"number":1533,"text":"The separation prevents goals becoming an overloaded backlog; active work
"},{"number":1534,"text":"being diluted by every deferred ticket; comments becoming informal task
"},{"number":1535,"text":"status; and task boards becoming accidental authority (§2, §7).
"}]}]
